scope: Three Boredom Experiment plans (plans/boredom-experiment-index-entry-plan-2026-07-10.md, 281 lines; plans/boredom-experiment-index-entry-plan-v2-2026-07-11.md, 313 lines; plans/boredom-experiment-channel-schema-anchor-plan-2026-07-16.md, 201 lines) read in full and traced against corpus/index/Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study)/ (9 files, 5 unit .md, 0 unit records, 7 nodes, 0 edges reaching runtime). Plus the four other ontology-only entries — Virtual Learning Environments (King–Salvo) (9 files, 6 units, 18 nodes), Presence Theory (Foundations) (10 files, 4 units, 10 nodes), Social Presence in Virtual Worlds (Part III) (8 files, 3 units, 10 nodes), Rhetoric of Interactivity and Virtual Reality (Part III) (7 files, 2 units, 7 nodes) — and the plan that produced the last three, plans/new-media-presence-ingestion-phase1-report-2026-07-20.md (VLE has NO creation plan; it was built under plans/part-iii-reanalysis-and-draft-plan-2026-07-06.md with its own manifest recording "gates deferred"). Compiler behaviour verified directly in scripts/compile-corpus-index.py (collect_ontology_nodes L1180-1229; collect_tension_edges L1252-1273). Runtime counts recomputed from corpus/index/compiled-index.json (701 nodes, 64 tension edges, 1722 canonicalTerms).
what_the_plan_actually_specifies:
THE BOREDOM SERIES (three plans, 795 lines, one 9-file entry).

v1 (2026-07-10) is explicitly a handoff draft — "meant to be fed to a more capable model (Fable) for refinement and execution, not executed as-is" (:3-4). It grounds the repo's three structural patterns (§1 :22-30), states the universal rules (raw data never enters the tracked tree; provenance tags FE/FE-U/P/FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR>; S01-S08 anonymisation; `******` placeholders; bridge-pointers not duplicate digests; `<prefix>-NN-<slug>.md` with an OPTIONAL sibling .json :46-49), and states the ONE registration fact: add a TEXT_DIRS dict entry and the parser reads `## 3A. Canonical Node List` (:50-54). §3 inventories the raw mount and infers a 12-field CSV schema while flagging it "unverified" (:103-114). §4 raises O-11 (standalone entry vs expand vle-02) and proposes a 5-unit Pattern-A tree under prefix `bor-` (:139-154). §5 fixes controlled vocabulary and data-quality flags. §6 is a 7-phase pipeline (Phase 0 decisions → 1 column semantics → 2 file discovery → 3 metric extraction → 4 unit+JSON authoring → 5 corpus formalisation/compile → 6 cross-linking) with GATE G0 (:182) and GATE G1 (:214-215). §8 is a decisions ledger (O-9…O-15). §9 is 7 quality gates (:255-264).

v2 (2026-07-11) is EXECUTION-READY and supersedes v1. It resolves O-11 to a standalone entry, LOCKS the HMD column schema (12 fields, author-confirmed and byte-verified at a named file+line, §3.3 :131-148), enumerates all 24 subject×condition cells with per-cell exception flags ALT-FORMAT/CROP2/UNCROPPED/TYPO (§3.2 :97-129), discovers the cadence is ~2.99 Hz not the published 120 Hz and derives an eyes-open filtering rule from it (§3.4 :150-159), and carries a worked proof-of-pipeline: S05 eyes-closed 77.0% (1826/2371 rows) on Boring vs 11.6%/13.8%, HR 59, HRV ~138 — four channels agreeing (§7 :244-260). §6 keeps the phase structure, §10 lists 8 quality gates, §11 states a HARD CONSTRAINT that S-codes be derived at runtime and no name reach any committed file including script source (:311-313).

The anchor plan (2026-07-16) is a rescope. Phase 1 (:34-89) is an edge-correction operation on the VR Pedagogy cluster: delete 24 backwards `grounds-measure → boredomExperimentDataset` edges from per-unit CSVs and the regenerated global, with a live-list regeneration instruction, a precision guard for ped-sec-12, a non-orphaning check, a tally-block correction, and a compile-and-verify-the-delta step, gated at §1.5. Phase 2 (:93-186) builds the entry as "a compact primary-object entry — the lab/VR pole. Its value is the node itself + its outbound edges" (:96-97). Three hard gates open it (§2.0 :99-112): a PII gate that forbids `ls`/`find` inside Subjects/; an O-10 gate capping the entry at the vle-02 derivative level and forbidding the per-subject 24-row matrix; an O-9 gate declaring .mat/HMD/OBS/.fig "declared-but-unprocessed". §2.2 (:122-135) is a 7-row channel taxonomy table (modality/register/N/contents/status) authored from vle-02 and the untracked brief. §2.3 (:137-156) gives a file list under a new prefix `bex-`. §2.4 (:158-168) asks for outbound edges but does not say in what file or format, and sets the default for construct-correspondences to "omit". §2.5 repoints the 3 surviving bridges. §2.6 (:176-186) is the Phase-2 gate: TEXT_DIRS diff, §3A authored, compile, verbatim scan, then show-and-wait on (a) taxonomy (b) edges (c) node counts (d) a PII grep (e) the O-10 ceiling.

THE NEW-MEDIA PLAN (2026-07-20) that produced PTF/SVW/RIV is not a plan but a phase report with an embedded proposal. §6 (:111-133) groups 9 sources into three entries and says structure "follows the existing convention exactly … `_synthesis/` (citation-network, cluster-ontology, concept-matrix, debate-map), `units/`, and `bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md` — mirroring VR Pedagogy Secondary". §7 (:135-139) sequences Phases 2-4, each "gated on user go-ahead", with one substantive quality instruction: "verify every verbatim via `archon evidence find … --mode exact`". The Phase 2/3/4 execution reports (:144-305) define the actual deliverable per unit: Thesis/Aim · Structure · Constructs · Findings/Claims · Drafting loci · Relevance to the Part III passage, plus a `_synthesis/` of cluster-ontology.md (§3A), concept-matrix.csv, citations.md, drafting-loci.md, README.md. There is no gates section, no acceptance criteria, and no metrics artifact anywhere in the document.

defects.defect: The plan redefines the deliverable as a node: "Builds … as a compact primary-object entry — the lab/VR pole. Its value is the node itself + its outbound edges to the phenomenology; it is NOT a binding substrate." Once the unit of value is 'the node', the correct size of the entry is 1-10 nodes, and no amount of underlying data changes that. Nothing in the plan ever asks how many addressable records the source can yield.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study)/ — 9 files, 7 nodes, 0 unit records, 0 edges reaching runtime, for a ~92 GB, 8-subject, 3-condition, 7-channel dataset with 24 episodes × 7 instrument items already tabulated. Three plans totalling 795 lines produced 9 files because the third plan's target was seven table rows.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State the deliverable as a record population with a floor, not as a node: for a primary dataset, one addressable record per (subject × condition × instrument item) and one per derived per-cell metric, each with a stable id, a typed relation set and a locator. For this dataset that floor is 168 self-report records + 24×K channel-metric records, not 7 nodes.

defects.defect: The O-9 gate declares ch-eeg/.mat, ch-hmd telemetry, ch-obs video and ch-fig 'declared-but-unprocessed metadata only', and no instruction anywhere in the three plans says what must happen to the entry when that gate later clears. There is no re-open trigger, no owner, no invalidation date.
defects.consequence_observed: O-9 processing was executed the SAME DAY the entry was built (entry files 2026-07-16 10:17-12:23; commit b766783a5 at 16:20 adds scripts/boredom-o9/{ch_hmd,ch_fig,ch_eeg,ch_validate,ch_stats,common}.py, 764 lines, all 8 subjects, format variants handled, cross-validated, N=8 Friedman+Wilcoxon+Holm statistics including a significant result: pupil dilation Boring < Clinical in all 8 subjects, p=0.008). scripts/boredom-o9/.gitignore excludes out/; the README routes findings to an untracked tmp note. As of today the index still reads 'UNPROCESSED (O-9 deferred)' at book-level-ontology.md:49,:70,:77,:84 and manifest.json:26,:28,:29,:30,:45. The only significant statistical finding this dataset has produced is nowhere in corpus/index/.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every deferral must be a typed, dated record inside the entry with a named unblock condition and a mandatory 'on-clear' action list naming the exact files to rewrite. Derived aggregates keyed on anonymised ids are index content, not gitignored working output: the new plan must require that every script under scripts/ that produces index-bound aggregates writes them to a tracked, schema-validated file in the entry.

defects.defect: §2.4 'The anchor's OUTBOUND edges (the load-bearing relationships)' names three relations but never says which file they go in, what the row/object schema is, or how the compiler ingests them. The plan does not mention `tension-edges.json` or `*-edges.csv` anywhere in 201 lines; neither do v1 or v2 in their 594.
defects.consequence_observed: The author put them in _synthesis/manifest.json as `outbound_bridges` (3 objects, :33-37) and `inbound_anticipatory_bridges` (2 objects, :38-41). scripts/compile-corpus-index.py reads exactly two files per entry — <analysis_subdir>/book-level-ontology.md (falling back to cluster-ontology.md, L1218-1224) and <analysis_subdir>/tension-edges.json (L1267). manifest.json is never opened. Result: Boredom Experiment contributes 0 of the 64 tension edges in compiled-index.json. The same instruction shape produced 0 edges from Presence Theory, Social Presence and Rhetoric of Interactivity — none of the five entries in scope has a tension-edges.json.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: The new plan must carry a machine-readable reachability contract: an explicit table of (artifact → exact path → reader → runtime destination), and a rule that any relation not written in a reader-visible file DOES NOT EXIST. Edges must be authored in the file the compiler actually opens, with the field names the parser requires, and the plan must ship the parser's field list verbatim.

defects.defect: The only statement about the runtime in v1 (repeated as v2 §1 :58-62 and anchor §2.3 :154-156) says registration = add a TEXT_DIRS entry, then the parser reads §3A of the ontology file. It never states the corollary: that every OTHER file in the entry is invisible to the compiler. Executing agents reasonably assumed that a manifest, a unit .md, a .mmd and a bridge-sources pointer were part of the index.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Experiment: 8 of 9 files reach nothing. _synthesis/manifest.json (59 lines: channels[] spec, cohort_n, gates, 5 bridge objects, future-work channel list), _synthesis/graph-channel-map.mmd (51 lines, ~14 edges), bridge-sources/paper-digest-pointers.md, and all five units/bex-*.md are pure decoration at runtime; only the units[] string arrays inside node objects survive. Identical pattern in Presence Theory (bridge-to-part-ii.md 70 lines, drafting-loci.md, concept-matrix.csv, citations.md all unreachable) and in the other two new-media entries.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Open the new plan with a 'what reaches runtime' section derived by reading the compiler, listing every path it opens and every field it parses, and require the executing agent to re-derive that list from the code at execution time and paste the derivation into the entry's gates report. Anything the plan wants preserved must be routed into a reachable file or the plan must first extend the reader.

defects.defect: The Phase-2 GATE has five items: (a) show the channel taxonomy, (b) show outbound edges + repointed bridges, (c) TEXT_DIRS diff + compiled node counts before→after, (d) grep the entry for the 8 names → empty, (e) bex-01 carries only aggregates + 4 cases. Only (d) is machine-checkable. (c) says 'expect +1 entry, +N channel/construct nodes' — N is left unbound, so any N ≥ 1 passes. (a), (b) and (e) are 'show a human'. Nothing measures record count, record schema conformance, edge reachability, file-manifest conformance, locator coverage, or whether the entry's factual claims were verified against the artifact.
defects.consequence_observed: The entry passed its gate with 7 nodes, 0 structured records, 0 runtime edges, 4 of 7 channel definitions containing an unverified content claim, and 4 files that §2.3 specified simply absent. No quality-gates-report.md exists for this entry (it is one of the 25 of 27 without one). Gate item (e) is actively inverted: the plan's own no-duplication premise is violated by bex-01 (see separate finding).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every gate must be a command with a numeric threshold and a pass/fail exit code, written into a committed gates script, and its output must be persisted as quality-gates-report.md + metrics.json inside the entry. Minimum gate set: records ≥ floor, 100% of records id-unique and id-prefix-conformant, 100% carry a locator at the declared granularity, edges parse to non-zero under the real compiler, declared file manifest == on-disk file manifest, 0 unresolved `******`.

defects.defect: The PII gate says: "Do NOT `ls`/`find` inside `Subjects/` — a raw listing prints names into the transcript before any scrub; take structure/counts from `vle-02`/the brief." This conflates a transcript-hygiene concern with a repository-contents concern, and in doing so forbids the only path by which any channel fact could be verified against the artifact. It also directly forbids the mechanism v2 §11:311-313 designed and had already run (derive S-codes from the sorted directory listing in memory).
defects.consequence_observed: Channel contents were copied out of the plan's own §2.2 table instead of checked. The row `ch-obs | session video | raw | 8 | OBS posture/fidget/watch-glance` (anchor:133) shipped verbatim into the shipped canonical node at commit 48ac09a96 — book-level-ontology.md node 6: 'OBS session recordings (posture / fidget / watch-glance comportment) — the visible-Zeitvertreib surface channel that would supply a third behavioral surface' — plus manifest.json:29, the .mmd and bex-04. It was false: no body camera was ever recorded. It required a separate corrective commit (2f4e3ed97) eight days later. Because node definitions are the only text that reaches compiled-index.json, a fabricated fact went straight to runtime. scripts/boredom-o9/README.md later states the opposite policy outright: 'Raw-tree inspection … is authorized … Only dissertation-facing output must be anonymized.'
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Split the constraint in two: (1) NO PII in any tracked artifact or committed script (grep-enforced, keep this); (2) transcript hygiene handled by a name-blind enumerator — a committed script that lists the raw tree and emits only S-codes, hashes and counts. Then make 'every declared channel/dataset fact is verified against the artifact by a named command whose output is recorded' a hard gate. A gate that forbids verification is not a gate.

defects.defect: The O-10 gate states the entry 'does not commit the full per-subject 24-row matrix (that stays in the untracked tmp/ brief, referenced by pointer)'. The 24-row matrix IS the claim-level layer of this source: 8 subjects × 3 conditions × 7 items = 168 addressable, anonymised, already-collected data claims. The plan bans exactly the layer the programme's goal requires, and gives no route to unban it beyond 'explicit O-10 sign-off' with no owner and no date.
defects.consequence_observed: bex-01-selfreport-record.md carries 4 aggregate lines and 4 named cases — a hard ceiling of ~8 assertions for a 24-episode instrument. The entry's finest addressable unit is a channel; the finest locator anywhere in it is a subject code. And the ceiling is not even consistently applied: bex-01 reproduces vle-02's aggregate block anyway (see contradiction finding).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Consent scope must be modelled as a per-record field, not an entry-wide ceiling. Every record gets `use_scope: index-only | citable-pending-<gate> | citable`, so the full 168-record matrix can be indexed and addressed now while quotation in the dissertation stays blocked until the gate clears. Never let a downstream-use restriction reduce upstream indexing granularity.

defects.defect: v2 locked and byte-verified the 12-column HMD schema, the 24-cell file table with per-cell exception flags, the ~2.99 Hz cadence finding, the eyes-open filtering rule, and a four-channel corroborated S05 result — all inside a plan file. §6 Phase 4/5 was to move them into the entry; the anchor plan superseded v2 five days later and nothing in either plan required the verified facts to be migrated, escrowed, or even referenced.
defects.consequence_observed: grep across corpus/ and scripts/ for 1826, 2371, '2.99 Hz' and 'eyes-open' returns zero hits from the Boredom entry. The locked column schema, the 24-cell table, the exception flags and the S05 result exist only in plans/boredom-experiment-index-entry-plan-v2-2026-07-11.md. Worse, the built entry propagates a figure v2 had already shown does not describe the on-disk data: bex-03-gaze-arousal.md:7 and book-level-ontology.md:56 state 'gaze-deviation variance @ 120 Hz' as the channel's measure, with no note that the exported CSVs sample at ~3 Hz.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Verified facts are entry content, not plan content. Require that any fact a plan verifies (schema, offset, cell inventory, measured value) be written into the entry the moment it is verified, with its verification method and locus as fields, BEFORE any further phase runs. A plan supersession must include a migration checklist enumerating every verified fact in the superseded plan and its destination or an explicit discard rationale.

defects.defect: Both quality-gate lists (7 and 8 items) measure hygiene and process compliance: no real names, provenance tags present, caveats stated inline, all 24 cells listed, ontology parseable, compile clean, vle-02 not left dangling, no verbatim >25 words, backup taken, sign-off obtained. Not one measures the size, granularity, addressability or connectedness of the index that results. A 7-node descriptor passes every one of them.
defects.consequence_observed: The built entry passes essentially all of these (PII clean, FE-U/P tags present, ontology parses, compile clean, no long verbatims) while delivering 7 nodes and 0 records. The gates were satisfied by an artifact that does not serve the goal, which is the definition of a wrong-target metric.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Add a coverage tier to the gate set that is about the index, not the process: records-per-source floor, records-per-page floor for text sources, % of records with a locator at the declared granularity, % of records participating in ≥1 typed edge, % of edges whose target resolves to an existing id, and a diff-against-previous-build regression check. Hygiene gates stay, but they can no longer be the whole gate set.

defects.defect: "A sibling `<prefix>-NN-<slug>.json` (structured metadata) is optional but is the norm in FCM; VLE does not use it uniformly." The single most consequential word in the three plans is 'optional'. No field list, no id grammar, no required keys, no validation. v2 §4:169 asked for one .json; the anchor plan §2.3:149 asked for `bex-01-selfreport-record.md/.json`.
defects.consequence_observed: Zero .json unit records exist in corpus/index/Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study)/units/ (only 5 .md). The same optionality produced 0 structured unit records in all five ontology-only entries (VLE 6 units / 0 records; PTF 4 / 0; SVW 3 / 0; RIV 2 / 0). Across the whole corpus it is why 355 unit-record files exist in some entries and none in others, with 9 incompatible sub-schemas where they do exist.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Publish ONE record schema as a committed JSON Schema file, make it mandatory, and make schema validation a build step that fails the entry. Required fields at minimum: id, entry, unit, kind (claim|clause|definition|position|measure|datum), text, locator {page|page_range|line_range|bekker|timestamp|sentence_index|char_span|bbox}, verification {method, status, run_id}, provenance_tag, support_tier, supports[], supported_by[], contested_by[], use_scope.

defects.defect: The document that produced three of the five ontology-only entries has no gates section, no acceptance criteria, no metrics artifact and no definition of done. Its entire quality instruction is one clause in the Phase 2 bullet: 'verify every verbatim via `archon evidence find … --mode exact`'. Everything else — record counts, schema, ids, edges, node naming, coverage — is unstated.
defects.consequence_observed: Presence Theory (10 files), Social Presence (8 files), Rhetoric of Interactivity (7 files); 0 structured records, 0 edges, 0 quality-gates-report.md, 0 metrics.json across all three. 22 verbatim loci total for 9 sources spanning ~141 PDF pages. Two entries cover only 3 and 2 sources respectively.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: A phase report is not a creation plan. The new plan must forbid entry creation from a report: an entry may only be built from a versioned creation plan that carries the schema, the id grammar, the gate script and the coverage floors, and every entry must ship quality-gates-report.md + metrics.json as a build product.

defects.defect: The per-unit template is defined as 'Thesis/Aim · Structure · Constructs · Findings/Claims · Drafting loci · Relevance to the Part III passage'. 'Drafting loci' means quotes selected to serve one named dissertation passage. That purpose caps the record count at what the passage needs, regardless of what the source contains.
defects.consequence_observed: Rhetoric of Interactivity: 4 loci for a 47-page MA thesis (riv-01 §4 :35-38), 2 loci for a 14-page article; drafting-loci.md holds 6 bullets total. Presence Theory: 8 loci for 4 sources. Social Presence: 8 loci for 3 sources. Against the goal's ~50-500 records per source, these are two orders of magnitude short — and the shortfall is by design, not by neglect.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Separate two products that this plan fused: (1) the INDEX — exhaustive, source-driven, every claim and clause, target density stated as records-per-page; (2) the DRAFTING BANK — a selection view over the index, keyed to a passage. The drafting bank must be generated from the index, never authored instead of it. State explicitly that a unit whose record count equals the number of quotes the current chapter needs has failed.

defects.plan_line: plans/new-media-presence-ingestion-phase1-report-2026-07-20.md:135 ("verify every verbatim via archon evidence find … --mode exact")
defects.defect: The verification instruction requires running the tool but says nothing about persisting what it returns. `evidence find --mode exact` returns exact-match provenance INCLUDING a bounding box — the report itself records 'provenance: exact-1.00 (sim 1.00) · bbox ✓' at §4. The plan asks the author to record the verdict, not the payload.
defects.consequence_observed: The string 'bbox ✓' appears 45+ times across the three new-media entries as a checkmark. Zero bounding-box coordinates are stored anywhere in corpus/index/ (grep for coordinate quadruples returns only an unrelated HTML diagram). The audit's finding that 'nothing in 1,758 files carries a sentence offset, a character span, or a bbox' is here shown to be a discarded resource, not a missing one: the clause-level address existed at authoring time in every one of these 22 loci and was thrown away and replaced with a tick.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Mandate capture, not assertion: every quotation record must persist {doc_id, chunk_id, page, bbox[x0,y0,x1,y1], char_span, sim, mode, snapshot_id, run_timestamp} as fields returned by the retrieval tool. Ban the string 'bbox ✓' as evidence. Add a gate: % of quotation records carrying numeric bbox == 100, and a re-verification command that replays every record against the current snapshot.

defects.defect: The VLE entry has no creation plan in plans/; its manifest records the governing instruction verbatim: status = 'phase-3 registration build (Part III full run; gates deferred to post-run review)'. Gates were waived at build time by the plan that built it, and the post-run review never happened. There is also no mechanism binding the ontology file (the only file that reaches runtime) to the unit files it summarises.
defects.consequence_observed: 7 of VLE's 18 canonical nodes carry counts superseded by vle-01's own 2026-07-23/24 refresh: node 1 (install/hw 4.7 & 4.4 vs 0.6 & 0.9 → now 5.4 vs 0.9 and 2.2 vs 0.9); node 4 (D2 159/21, D3 36, 51 interactivity requests → now 166/16, 37, 57); node 5 (latency 27, navigation 25, darkness 4 'weakly attested', crash 24/install 22/hw 22 → now 25, 21, darkness ATTESTED 10, crash 29/install 26/hw 13 — a status contradiction, not just a count drift); node 6 (crash 17→3→4); node 7 (18 divergence candidates → 13, 12 unique); node 8 (4.3 vs 1.2 per-100 and ≈69% → 2.8 vs 1.5 and pooled 70.7%, 87/123, 'corrected 2026-07-23'); node 9 (E-SHA 67 → 91). Since only book-level-ontology.md compiles, 100% of VLE's runtime numbers are stale, and compiled-index.json:155 serves the stale E-SHA 67 today.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ban derived numbers in the runtime-reachable file. Node definitions must reference record ids, and any figure appearing in a node must be generated from the records at build time by the compiler or a pre-compile step, so it cannot drift. Add a gate that fails if any numeral in the ontology file is not traceable to a record. Never permit 'gates deferred'; a build with deferred gates is a draft and must not register.

defects.defect: No plan in scope requires a downstream-citation index or a propagation sweep when a number or a status changes. The anchor plan's §2.5 sweeps exactly three named bridges ('Clear their `****** UNVERIFIED` prefixes') and nothing else.
defects.consequence_observed: (a) The superseded VLE F7 figure '4.3 vs 1.2' now lives in 12 live files of the sibling VR Pedagogy Secondary entry — ped-sec-01.md, ped-sec-02.md, ped-sec-09.md + its edges.csv, ped-sec-25 edges.csv, ped-sec-26 .md/.json/edges.csv, ped-sec-18 edges.csv, ped-sec-34 .md/edges.csv — plus 4 rows of _synthesis/global-edges.csv and compiled-index.json. (b) Although the anchor was built 2026-07-16, 22 live locations in VR Pedagogy Secondary still assert it does not exist: _synthesis/phase0-overview.md:51-52, _synthesis/vr-pedagogy-construct-condition-concordance.json:1030 and .md:11,:76, _synthesis/graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd:8, bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md:15, and 16 unit .md/.json files carrying `****** UNVERIFIED: anchor entry not yet built`.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require a reverse-reference index built at compile time (record id → every file citing it) and make correction a transaction: change a record, and the build lists every dependent location and fails until each is updated or explicitly waived. Cross-entry assertions about another entry's existence must be expressed as an id reference resolved at build time, never as prose.

defects.defect: §2.3 gives an explicit file tree — _synthesis/{manifest.json, dataset-overview.md, channel-schema.md/.json, cluster-ontology.md, graph-channel-map.mmd} and units/{bex-00.md, bex-01.md/.json, bex-02.md, bex-03.md, bex-04.md} — but §2.6's gate never checks the built tree against it.
defects.consequence_observed: Built: dataset-overview.md ABSENT, channel-schema.md ABSENT, channel-schema.json ABSENT, bex-01-selfreport-record.json ABSENT; cluster-ontology.md silently renamed book-level-ontology.md; an unplanned bridge-sources/paper-digest-pointers.md added. Four specified artifacts missing and one renamed, with no warning anywhere — the compiler's book-level→cluster fallback (compile-corpus-index.py L1218-1224) masked the rename, and nothing detected the absences.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship the file manifest as data (a manifest.expected.json in the plan) and gate on set equality between expected and on-disk paths. Also: pick ONE ontology filename corpus-wide and make the compiler's fallback emit a warning rather than silently accepting a second dialect.

defects.defect: The plan states a no-duplication discipline ('does not commit the full per-subject matrix'; bex-01 = 'instrument SPEC + aggregates + 4 cases ONLY') without ever defining duplication operationally or providing a check. The entry then asserts the rule as fact.
defects.consequence_observed: _synthesis/manifest.json:7 — 'the study's findings are registered as vle nodes 10-14 there and are NOT duplicated here' — and book-level-ontology.md:8 and bex-00:7-8 repeat it. But bex-01-selfreport-record.md reproduces vle-02's entire aggregate block and all four cases: 'Boring 7.0 · Clinical 6.0 · Interesting 4.5', '5/8 · 6/8 · 5/8', '16/24', 'two under 40 seconds', '6/8 (depletion carryover)', and the S07/S05/S04/S03 case texts, all present in both files. The entry's own defining claim is false about its own contents.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace prose no-duplication rules with single-sourcing by id: one canonical record per fact, everywhere else a reference. Add a duplicate-content gate (normalised-shingle overlap between any two unit files above a threshold fails the build) so 'not duplicated' is a measured property, not an assertion.

defects.defect: The plan observed that the compiler strips parentheticals from node names and accepted it, while the same phase authored concept-matrix.csv column headers using the UNSTRIPPED names. Nothing specifies that the node name is a join key and must be byte-identical wherever it appears.
defects.consequence_observed: compiled-index.json holds 'Reality of the virtual', 'Second Life', 'Ontology of the virtual', 'Virtual rhetoric', 'Design-as-rhetoric'; the sibling concept-matrix.csv headers read 'Reality of the virtual (the digital is real)', 'Second Life (inhabited virtual world)', 'Ontology of the virtual (problematizing similitude and difference)', 'Virtual rhetoric (VR as persuasion; the moving lever)', 'Design-as-rhetoric (the authored environment)'. The unit×concept grid — 10+10+7 columns of real analytic content — cannot be joined to the index by name. Naming is also incoherent across entries: bex node names are full em-dash phrases ('ch-selfreport — per-video self-report channel') while the new-media entries use short stripped labels.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Give every node and every record a stable machine id separate from its display label (e.g. `svw:c-002`), require all cross-file references to use the id, and forbid the parser from being the thing that decides a canonical name. Add a gate: every concept-matrix column / edge endpoint resolves to an existing id.

defects.defect: Both plans instruct the author NOT to build connections. New-media Phase 3: 'all bridge content stays in Presence Theory (Foundations)/_synthesis/ and references the Uexküll entry read-only (by node # + unit id). No cross-entry edges built.' Anchor §2.4: for construct-correspondences, 'Decide at build time whether these earn their place; default is to omit and let Part III carry the lab↔literature link at the outline/LIT-SLOT level.'
defects.consequence_observed: Presence Theory (Foundations)/_synthesis/bridge-to-part-ii.md is a 70-line analytic bridge that produces zero graph edges; README.md:23 records 'No cross-entry edges built'. Boredom Experiment authored 3 outbound relations into an unread manifest and omitted the optional construct-correspondences entirely. Across the five entries in scope: 0 edges reach runtime, against a stated goal of indexing 'every point of connection'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Invert the default: a relation that an author can state in prose MUST be emitted as a typed edge; omission requires a recorded rationale. 'Read-only reference by node # and unit id' is already an edge — require it to be written as one. Add a gate: every cross-entry reference appearing in prose has a corresponding edge row.

defects.defect: The plan documented that Mantovani & Riva is a scanned/image PDF whose 11 pages share an identical page-level text_hash and warned 'run verify-quote before trusting any verbatim', then scheduled ptf-01 as a full unit anyway with no blocking gate on unverifiable sources.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Presence Theory (Foundations)/_synthesis/README.md:7 — 'ptf-01 … ⚠ OCR-only source: all verbatims `****** UNVERIFIED:`' — and drafting-loci.md carries the same exception. Two canonical nodes ('Ontology-dependence of presence criteria', 'Naive realism vs. cultural constructivism') rest on a source whose every quotation is unverified, and the handoff notes these Part III presence units are already cited in the dissertation. riv-02 similarly ships with venue/year `****** UNVERIFIED` (RIV README:14,:24).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Add a source-admissibility gate before any unit is authored: text layer sanity (distinct per-page hashes, ligature check, extraction word-count vs page count) and a citation-completeness check (venue, year, pagination anchored). A source failing it is quarantined with a remediation task, not authored around. Record per-source `text_quality` and per-record `verification.status`, and gate on % unverified == 0 for any record marked citable.

defects.defect: Prefixes are chosen inline per plan with no registry and no uniqueness check. v1/v2 chose `bor-`; the anchor plan silently switched to `bex-` with no note, no rationale and no rescope-log entry (the rescope log :196-201 records only the edge-binding change).
defects.consequence_observed: `bor-` was taken three days after v2 by Boredom Secondary (Part III), which uses `bor-sec-NN` across 40+ units. Had v2 executed, `bor-01` and `bor-sec-01` would have collided in a flat id space. The rename went unrecorded, so v1/v2 remain on disk describing an entry under a prefix that does not exist — the audit's id-prefix-violation (10) and id-collision (10) categories have their root here.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Maintain a committed prefix/id registry (prefix → entry → id grammar → allocated ranges) and require the plan to reserve its prefix in that file as step 0, with a gate that fails on collision. Ids must be globally unique across the whole index, not per entry.

defects.defect: '`tmp/Dissertation/Part_III/reanalysis/boredom-experiment-brief.md` — full record; **stays untracked**, reference by pointer.' The plan makes an untracked, gitignored path the canonical home of the entry's substance and never asks whether such a pointer is resolvable from the index.
defects.consequence_observed: The pointer appears in manifest.json:15, bex-00:23,:71, bex-01:6, and bridge-sources/paper-digest-pointers.md:15. Every one of them is unresolvable from a clone of this repository; the entry's 'analysis home' does not exist in the tracked tree. The same pattern now hides the O-9 results (scripts/boredom-o9/README.md routes findings to tmp/Dissertation/Part_III/reanalysis/boredom-o9-physiological-findings.md and a gitignored out/).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Classify every reference target as in-tree | external-stable | external-volatile, gate that no in-index record depends on an external-volatile target for its content, and require that anything named 'the canonical record' or 'analysis home' be in-tree. Where consent forbids committing raw text, commit the structured, anonymised record and mark it use-scoped — do not push it out of the tree.

defects.defect: v1 declares itself 'DRAFT / handoff-ready … meant to be fed to a more capable model (Fable) for refinement and execution, not executed as-is'. The series then runs plan → superseding plan → rescoping plan with no supersession record inside the entry and no invalidation of the earlier documents.
defects.consequence_observed: Three plans, three architectures (5 units under `bor-`; 5 units under `bor-`; 5 units under `bex-` with a different file set), one 9-file product, and two live plan files in plans/ that describe an entry that was never built. The entry itself carries no pointer to which plan governs it — manifest.json:6 says only 'Phase-2 anchor build (rescoped plan)'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: One plan per entry, versioned, with a `governing_plan` + `plan_version` + `plan_sha` field written into the entry manifest, and a required SUPERSEDED-BY banner plus fact-migration checklist on any plan that is replaced.

defects.defect: '`boredom-ontology.md` contains a parseable `## 3A. Canonical Node List`; `compile-corpus-index.py` runs clean and `compiled-index.json` node counts are verified, not assumed.' At N=1 (one dataset, one entry) this gate has no comparison class: any non-zero node count is 'verified'. It measures that the parser did not crash.
defects.consequence_observed: 7 nodes passed. The identical gate shape passed 10 nodes for a 4-source entry, 10 for a 3-source entry and 7 for a 2-source entry. Repeated across 27 entries it produced the audit's count-mismatch category (66 defects) because 'verified' meant 'a number was read', not 'the number equals an independently derived expectation'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every count gate must compare against an independently derived expected value computed from the source artifacts (files on disk, pages, rows), not against the build's own output. Emit expected vs actual vs delta into metrics.json and fail on any non-zero unexplained delta.

defects.defect: §2.2 presents 7 channel rows but never states the entry's channel arity as a checkable fact, and mixes cohort sizes inside a single N column ('3/8', 12, 8, '—') without a field distinguishing raw-availability N from published-derivation N.
defects.consequence_observed: bex-00-corpus-overview.md:6 says the subjects were recorded with 'five measurement channels … plus a per-video 7-item self-report' while the taxonomy table 20 lines below lists seven channels; manifest.json declares ontology_nodes 7. The cohort-N confusion the plan was trying to prevent is partly reproduced: ch-gaze is registered N=12 in an entry whose subject universe is S01-S08.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Arity and cohort must be fields, not prose: every dataset channel record carries n_raw, n_published, cohort_id, and the entry manifest carries channel_count computed from the records. Gate: every count stated in prose is generated from a field.

defects.defect: 'Re-run the verbatim scanner (no ≥25-word verbatim; self-report numerics are data, not prose).' The instruction names no scanner path, no invocation, and no output artifact; the same is true of v1:214 and v2:238.
defects.consequence_observed: No scanner output, no gates report and no metrics file exists in the entry (9 files, none of them a report). The Boredom Experiment is one of the 25 of 27 entries with no quality-gates-report.md and one of the 26 with no machine-readable metrics.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Name the exact command for every check, require its stdout to be captured verbatim into quality-gates-report.md with a timestamp and exit code, and emit metrics.json with the numeric results. A check whose evidence is not persisted did not happen.

defects.plan_line: plans/new-media-presence-ingestion-phase1-report-2026-07-20.md:186 and the node lists it produced
defects.defect: Nothing in any plan states that node names and aliases are flattened into a GLOBAL greedy-match term list (build_canonical_terms, compile-corpus-index.py L1276+, sorted by length descending). Authors therefore chose names for readability.
defects.consequence_observed: compiled-index.json canonicalTerms (1,722 entries) now contains the bare proper noun 'Second Life' and generic phrases 'Physical / spatial presence', 'Virtual rhetoric', 'Reality of the virtual', plus from the Boredom entry 'EEG channel', 'HMD channel', 'OBS channel', 'figure channel', 'exposure protocol', 'stimulus corpus'. Same defect class as the VR Pedagogy leak of bare 'technological' and 'control'. Conversely all 27 nodes of the three new-media entries carry ZERO aliases, so no genuine synonym capture occurs.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define the term list explicitly: an `index_terms` field distinct from `display_name`, with a stoplist rule (no single common English word, no bare proper noun without a qualifier, minimum specificity), a required minimum alias count per node, and a gate that diffs new terms against a common-word list and fails on hits.

defects.defect: The vle-05 addition updated manifest.json, appended 4 nodes and cross-tagged 5 existing nodes, but the plan never required the entry's own navigational apparatus to be updated with it.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Virtual Learning Environments (King–Salvo)/_synthesis/book-level-ontology.md:6 'Map of the entry' still lists units vle-00 … vle-04; vle-05 is absent from the map although 9 nodes reference it and it is the entry's newest source.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Generate all navigational/index-of-contents blocks from the manifest at build time; forbid hand-maintained file lists inside entries.

defects.defect: 'compiler harvests nodes only from `_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md` `## 3A. Canonical Node List` (falls back book-level→cluster; verified `compile-corpus-index.py` L1197–1207)'. The fallback direction is stated backwards (the compiler tries book-level-ontology.md FIRST, then cluster-ontology.md, L1218-1224) and the cited line range is wrong — L1197-1207 is the table-format branch. v1:273 similarly cites 'TEXT_DIRS ~lines 35–103; header-ontology parser ~lines 483–745'.
defects.consequence_observed: Harmless here only because the author happened to write book-level-ontology.md, which the compiler prefers; the plan's stated filename (cluster-ontology.md) would also have worked via the fallback, so the error was invisible. But the plan asserts a verified line range that does not contain what it claims, which makes every such citation in the series untrustworthy.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Cite compiler behaviour by function name and by a reproduction command (e.g. a one-liner that prints the paths the compiler opens for a given entry), never by line number. Require the executing agent to run that command and paste the output into the gates report.

unspecified_gaps: Which files the compiler actually reads. No plan states that only <analysis_subdir>/book-level-ontology.md (or cluster-ontology.md) and <analysis_subdir>/tension-edges.json are opened, so authors invented placements: Boredom put relations in manifest.json, the new-media entries put them in prose and a concept-matrix.csv, other entries put them in book-level-ontology.json or a .mmd. 8 of Boredom's 9 files reach nothing.
The record schema. 'Optional sibling .json' (v1:46-49) with no field list produced zero records in all five entries in scope and nine mutually incompatible sub-schemas elsewhere in the corpus.
Edge file location and field names. The word tension-edges.json does not appear in 795 lines of Boredom planning, nor in the new-media plan. Zero edges from all five entries.
Id grammar and a prefix registry. bor- → bex- rename unrecorded; bor- subsequently taken by Boredom Secondary.

Locator granularity. No plan ever states the required address precision. Authors defaulted to whatever the source made easy: page ranges (new-media), subject codes (Boredom), nothing at all in half the units.
Persistence of retrieval provenance. 'verify with evidence find --mode exact' never said 'store what it returns'; 45+ 'bbox ✓' ticks, zero coordinates.
Target record density. No records-per-source or records-per-page floor anywhere, so 6 loci for a 47-page thesis passed.
What to do when a deferral clears. O-9 cleared the same afternoon the entry shipped and nothing reopened the entry; four channels are still marked unprocessed.
Where derived outputs live. No plan says index-bound aggregates must be tracked; scripts/boredom-o9/.gitignore excludes out/ and the significant p=0.008 result never entered the index.
Whether an untracked path may be an entry's canonical home. It became one (tmp/Dissertation/... referenced from 5 places in the Boredom entry).
An operational definition of duplication. The no-duplication rule was asserted in three files and violated in a fourth in the same entry.

Node name semantics. Nothing says the name is a join key, that parentheticals are stripped by the parser, or that names+aliases feed a global greedy-match list. Result: concept-matrix headers no longer join to compiled names; generic phrases leak corpus-wide; three entries have zero aliases.
Which ontology filename is canonical. Plans say cluster-ontology.md, builds produce book-level-ontology.md, and the compiler silently accepts both.
Verification of dataset/source facts against the artifact. No plan requires it; the anchor plan forbids the inspection that would supply it, and a fabricated ch-obs content claim shipped to runtime.

Source admissibility. No text-layer or citation-completeness precondition, so an OCR-degraded source (ptf-01, identical per-page text_hash) and a source with unverified venue (riv-02) were authored into canonical nodes.
A downstream-citation index. None exists, so a corrected VLE figure left 12 stale live copies in a sibling entry and a built anchor left 22 'not yet built' assertions live.
Gate evidence artifacts. No plan requires quality-gates-report.md or metrics.json; none of the five entries has either.
Plan supersession and fact migration. No banner, no checklist, no governing_plan field in the entry; v2's byte-verified schema, 24-cell table and worked S05 result were stranded.
Consent modelling. O-10 was applied as an entry-wide content ceiling rather than a per-record use_scope field, permanently capping granularity.

Entry profile selection. Nothing tells an author how a 2-source rhetoric pair, a 4-source theory cluster and a 92 GB instrumented dataset should differ in structure; all three converged on the same 7-10 node ontology-only shape.
design_inputs: Open the plan with a REACHABILITY CONTRACT derived by reading scripts/compile-corpus-index.py at execution time: a table of (file path → reader function → runtime destination), plus the command that prints, for a named entry, exactly which paths the compiler opens. Executing agents must paste that output into the entry's gates report before authoring. State the rule in one line: content not in a reader-visible file does not exist.

Ship ONE mandatory record schema as a committed JSON Schema. Required fields: id (globally unique, prefix-registered), entry, unit, kind (claim | clause | position | definition | measure | datum | quotation), text, locator {page | page_range | line_range | bekker_pair | timestamp | sentence_index | char_span | bbox}, verification {method, command, status, run_id, snapshot_id, timestamp}, provenance_tag (FE | FE-U | FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> | P), support_tier (adopt the Dissertation entry's proven 8-tier taxonomy: T1 textually-confirmed … T7 overreach), supports[], supported_by[], contested_by[], use_scope (index-only | citable-pending-<gate> | citable). Validation failure fails the build.

Adopt as the working reference implementation the two schemas that already work on disk: the Dissertation entry's 982-record claim schema (100% line-anchored, 8-tier support taxonomy, 76% in an explicit supports/supported_by graph, 235 cached verbatims with insertion_anchor) and Veri(dis)similitude's 157-row schema (stable unique ids, tier, closed-vocabulary reuse disposition, declared-enum RODA anchors, volatility flags). Do not design a new one; port these and re-target them from the user's own prose to sources.

Mandate persistence of retrieval provenance, not assertion of it. Every quotation record must carry {doc_id, chunk_id, page, bbox[x0,y0,x1,y1], char_span, sim, mode, snapshot_id, run_timestamp} exactly as `archon evidence find --mode exact` returns them. Ban the token 'bbox ✓' as evidence. Gate: % of quotation records with numeric bbox == 100. This alone converts the programme's finest locator from a page number to a clause box, and the evidence shows the payload was already being produced and discarded.

Declare a locator granularity per source class and gate on it: born-digital PDF → bbox + char_span; scanned/OCR → page + verified quote hash + quarantine flag; classical text → Bekker line pair (Aristotle already records 2,323); video → timestamp ± frame id (RDR2 already records 1,040 frame ids and 529 timestamps); tabular dataset → (subject, condition, item) tuple. Gate: 100% of records carry the declared granularity for their class, 0% carry a coarser one.

Set numeric coverage floors per source class and fail below them: text source ≥ 1 claim record per 2 pages AND ≥ 1 quotation record per 4 pages; monograph ≥ 150 records; article ≥ 40; MA thesis ≥ 60; tabular dataset ≥ 1 record per (subject × condition × instrument item). Compute expected values from the artifact (page count, row count) and emit expected/actual/delta into metrics.json.

Invert the edge default. Every relation an author can state in prose MUST be emitted as a typed edge row in the file the compiler reads; omission requires a recorded rationale in the entry. Delete the 'default is to omit' and 'no cross-entry edges built' instruction patterns outright. Gate: every cross-entry reference occurring in prose has a matching edge; every edge target resolves to an existing id.

Fix the edge schema before authoring: publish the exact field names the compiler requires (node_a/node_b), ship a parse-and-count command, and gate that the entry's edge file yields non-zero edges under the real compiler. The audit's 4-of-11 zero-yield tension-edges.json files (pole_A/pole_B, wendt_position/against, label/description-only) are all this one omission.

Maintain a committed prefix and id registry (prefix → entry → id grammar → allocated ranges → status). Reserving the prefix is step 0 of any entry build; collision fails the build. Ids are globally unique across the whole index, never per-entry.

Separate PII rules from verification rules. Rule 1: no participant name in any tracked artifact or committed script (grep-enforced, already proven by scripts/boredom-o9/common.py, which derives S01-S08 at runtime from sorted directory order and persists only S-codes). Rule 2: transcript hygiene is handled by a committed name-blind enumerator emitting only codes, hashes and counts. Explicitly forbid any gate that blocks verification of the artifact itself.

Model consent as a per-record field, never as an entry-wide content ceiling. use_scope gates quotation in the dissertation; it must not gate indexing, addressing or record count. Concretely: the Boredom Experiment's 168-cell self-report matrix (8 subjects × 3 conditions × 7 items) is indexed now as 168 records with use_scope = citable-pending-O-10.

Require verified facts to be written into the entry at the moment of verification, before any subsequent phase runs, with method and locus as fields. v2's locked 12-column HMD schema (byte-verified at a named file and line), the 24-cell file table with per-cell exception flags, the ~2.99 Hz cadence measurement and the S05 four-channel corroboration must all be entry records, not plan prose.

Make deferrals first-class records: {id, scope, blocking_reason, unblock_condition, owner, review_date, on_clear_actions[list of exact files to rewrite]}. Add a build check that fails when a deferral's unblock condition is demonstrably satisfied (e.g. a producing script exists under scripts/) while the entry still declares it deferred.

Require that any script producing index-bound aggregates writes them to a tracked, schema-validated file inside the entry. Forbid gitignoring derived, anonymised index content. Retrofit target: the O-9 N=8 statistics (pupil dilation Boring < Clinical, all 8 subjects, p=0.008, Friedman + Wilcoxon + Holm) plus per-cell HR/HRV/cognitive-load/gaze-variance/eyes-closed-% aggregates for all 24 cells.

Ban derived numerals from the runtime-reachable ontology file. Node definitions reference record ids; every figure shown is generated from records at build time. Gate: no numeral in the ontology file lacks a record-id provenance. This is the direct fix for VLE's 7 stale nodes, which are 100% of what VLE serves to runtime.

Build a reverse-reference index at compile time (record id → every file citing it) and make correction transactional: changing a record lists all dependents and fails the build until each is updated or explicitly waived. Retrofit targets: the superseded '4.3 vs 1.2' figure in 12 live VR Pedagogy files plus 4 global-edges.csv rows, and the 22 live 'anchor entry not yet built' assertions about an entry built 2026-07-16.

Express cross-entry existence claims as id references resolved at build time, never as prose. Any `****** UNVERIFIED: … not yet built` string must be a typed placeholder record that the build resolves or reports; a placeholder whose target now exists fails the build.

Add a source-admissibility precondition before any authoring: text-layer sanity (distinct per-page text hashes, ligature integrity check for the known pypdfium2 fi/ff/fl dropout, extracted-words-per-page floor) and citation completeness (author, venue, year, pagination anchor). Record per-source text_quality; quarantine failures with a remediation task rather than authoring around them. Retrofit: ptf-01 (identical text_hash on all 11 pages, all verbatims UNVERIFIED) and riv-02 (venue/year UNVERIFIED).

Make page-offset verification mandatory and multi-anchor. Record pdf_page_offset with at least two independent anchor observations at different depths in the document and a non-constancy check across the range; gate that every locator resolves under the recorded offset. The new-media plan's 'printed page = PDF + 386 (heads: PDF p.1→387, p.21→407)' is the right method — make it required, add the second anchor and the drift test. Retrofit: Aristotle (33 of 34 unit records carry pdf_pages from a superseded linear offset, errors to 47 pages; bekker-index 101 of 188 loci off by >2 pages) and Rickert (declared offset 20, actually drifting 18→15).

Separate the INDEX from the DRAFTING BANK. The index is exhaustive and source-driven; the drafting bank is a generated selection view keyed to a passage. Forbid authoring a bank instead of an index. Gate: an entry whose record count equals the number of quotes the current chapter needs fails.

Give every node and record a stable machine id distinct from its display label, require all cross-file references (concept matrices, edge endpoints, unit cross-links) to use the id, and stop letting the parser decide canonical names. Retrofit: the three new-media concept-matrix.csv files whose column headers no longer join to their own compiled node names after parenthetical stripping.

Specify the global term list explicitly: `index_terms` distinct from `display_name`, a stoplist rule (no bare single common English word, no unqualified proper noun, minimum specificity), a minimum alias count per node, and a gate that diffs newly added terms against a common-word list. Retrofit: 'technological', 'control' (VR Pedagogy), 'Second Life', 'figure channel', 'exposure protocol', 'EEG/HMD/OBS channel', 'stimulus corpus'.

Ship the expected file manifest as data (manifest.expected.json) and gate on set equality with the on-disk tree. Pick one ontology filename corpus-wide and make the compiler's book-level→cluster fallback emit a warning rather than silently accepting a second dialect. Retrofit: Boredom's four specified-but-absent artifacts and its silent cluster→book-level rename.

Every gate is a command with a numeric threshold and an exit code, collected in a committed per-entry gates script; its stdout, exit codes and timestamps are persisted to quality-gates-report.md and metrics.json inside the entry. No entry registers without both. Retrofit target: 25 of 27 entries currently have neither.

Replace prose no-duplication rules with single-sourcing by id plus a measured duplicate-content gate (normalised shingle overlap between any two unit files above threshold fails the build). Retrofit: bex-01 vs vle-02, where three files assert non-duplication that a fourth file falsifies.

Require an entry-profile declaration before building, chosen from a fixed set with different floors and required artifacts: PRIMARY-DATASET (record per measurement cell + per derived metric; channel taxonomy is metadata, not the deliverable), MONOGRAPH, ARTICLE-CLUSTER (per-source records + cross-source debate/tension edges), SMALL-PAIR (N ≤ 3: no cross-source statistics, full per-source claim/clause extraction, edges outbound to larger entries mandatory), and OWN-PROSE. Record the profile in the manifest and select gate thresholds from it.

Declare which gates are vacuous at N=1 and substitute per-source gates for them. At N=1 or N=2 every cross-source metric (debate axes, citation network, concordance coverage, inter-source contest counts) is undefined; the plan must say so and require in their place: claim-record floor, clause-locator coverage, verification coverage, and outbound-edge count into an entry with N > 3. Retrofit: Rhetoric of Interactivity (N=2) and Social Presence (N=3), which currently bind no cross-unit gate at all.

One plan per entry, versioned, with governing_plan + plan_version + plan_sha written into the entry manifest. Superseding a plan requires a SUPERSEDED-BY banner on the old file and a fact-migration checklist enumerating every verified fact in it with a destination or an explicit discard rationale. Retrofit: three Boredom plans, two describing an entry that was never built, none referenced from the entry.

Cite compiler behaviour by function name plus a reproduction command, never by line number, and require the executing agent to run the command and paste the output. Retrofit: anchor plan's 'verified compile-corpus-index.py L1197–1207' (wrong branch, fallback direction stated backwards) and v1's 'parser ~lines 483–745'.

Carry forward the cohort/provenance discipline as typed fields rather than prose cautions: n_raw, n_published, cohort_id, register, and a commensurability flag on any construct crosswalk (the 'parallel, not commensurable' rule in bex-02). These are exactly the qualifiers a claim-level index needs to prevent a published derivation being read as raw-data availability.

Mandate a post-build consistency sweep as a gate, not as a step: after any entry is created or renamed, grep the whole index for assertions about its prior state (`not yet built`, `****** UNVERIFIED`, superseded prefixes, superseded counts) and fail on any hit. Retrofit: 22 live hits for the Boredom anchor, 12 live hits for the superseded VLE F7 figure.
what_to_preserve: The anchor plan's Phase 1 (§1.1-§1.5, lines 38-89) is the best-specified operation in all three plans and it verifiably worked: regenerate the live list rather than trusting the cached one (:40-42); a precision guard for the one unit carrying two edges to the same target (:47-49); a non-destructive check that no unit is orphaned by the deletion (:50-51); edit the per-unit source of truth then regenerate the aggregate (:44-46); fix the tally block including a confirmed miscount and an ambiguous fold (:62-72); back up, recompile, and verify the delta by reading compiled-index.json (:78-83). Today VR Pedagogy's cluster-ontology.md §7 reads 1,129 dedup edges, 0 grounds-measure, 49 bridges-to-vle, 17 contests — exactly as specified. Port this operation wholesale as the template for any corrective pass.

v2's data-fact locking discipline (§3.1-§3.4): a LOCKED table where every cell is enumerated with an explicit exception flag (ALT-FORMAT, CROP2, UNCROPPED, TYPO), a closing accounting line ('21 clean + 3 exceptions … No silent gaps; all 24 cells accounted for'), and a schema whose verification locus is named to the line (KitFeen_HMD_Boredom_Crop.csv line 380). This is the correct shape for a source-inventory record; make it a required artifact rather than plan prose.

v2 §7's worked proof-of-pipeline: prove the extraction end-to-end on one unit with independent cross-channel corroboration before scaling to the full set. Keep it as a mandatory Phase-0 deliverable for any extraction pipeline.

v2 §11's HARD CONSTRAINT (:311-313): S-codes derived at runtime from sorted directory order, in memory, never persisted, not even as a hardcoded table in the script's own source. scripts/boredom-o9/common.py implements exactly this and processed all 8 subjects with zero PII leakage — proof that the anonymisation constraint is fully compatible with full processing, and that the anchor plan's escalation to 'do not even list the directory' was unnecessary.

v1 §3's inference honesty: state inferences AS inferences ('This inference is unverified and must be either confirmed … or explicitly caveated … do not encode it as ground truth', :110-114) and name the single most important open item explicitly. Preserve as a required `status: inferred | confirmed | contested` field on every record.

The numbered decisions ledger (v1 §8, v2 §9) carried across plan versions with a recommendation per open item and a resolution row per closed item. Keep it, but move it into the entry as records with owners and dates rather than leaving it in the plan.

The cohort-N heterogeneity discipline (anchor §2.2 :124-126, realised in manifest.json cohort_n and repeated in bex-00/-02/-03): keeping P1 EEG N=3, P2 gaze N=12 and raw self-report N=8 explicitly distinct, with the standing caution that a published-channel derivation is not the same cohort as the raw record. Promote from prose to fields.

The 'parallel, not commensurable' rule for construct crosswalks (bex-02 :12-15, anchor §2.4 :166-167): an EEG workload band and a self-report boredom item may be related without being equated. Keep as a typed edge attribute.

The new-media plan's citation-offset method: 'printed page = PDF + 386 (heads: PDF p.1→387, p.21→407)' and 'Thesis body page ≈ PDF−4 (single-anchor: TOC "Rhetoric of Sensation" = thesis p.22 ↔ PDF pp.26–28)'. Recording the offset AND the observations that establish it is exactly right; make it mandatory and require a second anchor plus a drift check.

The `****** UNVERIFIED:` placeholder convention, used honestly and visibly (riv-02 venue, ptf-01 OCR verbatims, the three pre-build bridges). Keep it — but make it a typed record the build can resolve and count, not a bare string.
The anchor plan's rescope log (:196-201) preserving the superseded draft in plans/.backups/. Keep the practice; extend it with a supersession banner on the plan and a fact-migration checklist.

The anchor plan §1.2's refusal to repoint edges at a target that does not yet exist ('Repointing them now would aim an edge at a non-existent path — the very defect being cleaned', :53-56). This is the correct referential-integrity instinct; generalise it into a build-time rule that every edge target must resolve to an existing id.

The bridge-pointer convention (v1 :44-45, v2 :53-54): material another entry canonically owns gets a pointer, never a duplicate digest. The principle is right — it needs an operational definition of duplication and a single-sourcing-by-id mechanism to become enforceable.
Backing up before edits to timestamped .backups/ and showing the compiled node/edge delta before → after at every gate. Keep both; add machine-readable capture of the delta.

gates_assessment.gate: v1 §9 / v2 §10 — 'No real subject names anywhere in corpus/index/ … only S01–S08' (v1:255, v2:290); operationalised as anchor §2.6(d) 'grep -ri the entry for the 8 names → empty' (:184-185)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Works — a grep is well-defined for one entry.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Still works and scales; a per-record grep is trivial.
gates_assessment.verdict: KEEP but reclassify. The only genuinely machine-checkable gate in 795 lines, and it holds (no participant name appears in the entry). But it measures hygiene, not index quality, and it was allowed to justify the far stronger §2.0(1) prohibition on inspecting the raw tree, which is what caused a fabricated ch-obs fact to reach runtime. Keep the grep; sever it from the inspection ban.

gates_assessment.gate: v1 §9 / v2 §10 — 'compile-corpus-index.py runs clean and compiled-index.json node counts are verified, not assumed' (v1:261-262, v2:294)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Vacuous. No expected value is stated, so any node count ≥ 1 satisfies 'verified'. 7 nodes passed.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Actively harmful: at 500 records per source a build could silently register 7 and still 'verify' its counts. This gate cannot detect the exact failure it exists to detect.
gates_assessment.verdict: REPLACE. Must compare against an expected value derived independently from the source artifacts, and emit expected/actual/delta to metrics.json with a non-zero delta failing the build. This gate shape is the root of the audit's 66 count-mismatch defects.

gates_assessment.gate: anchor §2.6(2) — 'verify node/term deltas in compiled-index.json (expect +1 entry, +N channel/construct nodes)' (:180-181)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: N is unbound; +1 node passes.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Unchanged — an unbound expectation cannot fail.
gates_assessment.verdict: FAIL AS WRITTEN. A gate with a free variable in its threshold is not a gate. Bind N before the build from the record inventory.

gates_assessment.gate: anchor §2.6(4) GATE — 'show and WAIT for sign-off: (a) channel taxonomy; (b) outbound edges + repointed bridges; (c) TEXT_DIRS diff + node counts; (d) PII grep; (e) O-10 ceiling' (:183-186)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Four of five items are 'show a human a thing'. Item (e) is asserted, not checked, and is in fact false (bex-01 duplicates vle-02's aggregates and cases).
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Collapses entirely. A human cannot eyeball 500 records per source; 'show the taxonomy' does not scale past one screen.
gates_assessment.verdict: REPLACE WITH SCRIPTED GATES. Human sign-off should approve a gates REPORT with numeric pass/fail lines, not raw artifacts. No gate here measures record count, schema conformance, edge reachability, file-manifest conformance or locator coverage — all five of which failed silently in this entry.

gates_assessment.gate: v1 §9 — 'File-discovery table accounts for all 8 subjects × 3 conditions (24 cells), with explicit MISSING-CROP/ALT-FORMAT/PARTIAL-SESSION flags — no silent gaps' (v1:259-260); v2 §10 equivalent (:293)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Excellent — this is the one coverage gate in the whole series, with a computable denominator (24) and a no-silent-gaps rule.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Generalises perfectly: replace 24 cells with the record floor for the source class and the same shape works.
gates_assessment.verdict: KEEP AND GENERALISE — the model for every coverage gate the new plan needs. Its tragedy is that it was never evaluated: the entry it gated (bor-02) was never built, and the anchor plan's replacement gate set dropped it entirely.

gates_assessment.gate: v2 §10 — 'The 3 Hz cadence caveat and the eyes-open filtering rule are stated inline in bor-02' (:292)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Would have worked (a grep for the caveat text).
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Needs promotion from a document-level string check to a per-record field (sampling_rate, filter_rule).
gates_assessment.verdict: NEVER EVALUATED — and its absence caused a live defect. bor-02 was never built; the replacement entry states 'gaze-deviation variance @ 120 Hz' as the channel's measure (bex-03:7, book-level-ontology.md:56) with no note that the exported CSVs sample at ~2.99 Hz, a fact v2 had already measured. A gate attached to an artifact that is later cancelled must migrate with the fact, not die with the artifact.

gates_assessment.gate: v1 §9 / v2 §10 — 'No verbatim >25 words from any published source' + anchor §2.6(3) 're-run the verbatim scanner' (v1:264, v2:296, anchor:182)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Passes trivially — the entry contains almost no quotation at all.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Directly hostile to the goal. A clause-level index must carry the clause; a blanket length ceiling with no fair-use/quarantine distinction pushes exactly the material the goal requires out of the index. This is the same policy that made In-Game (ig-10-deep.json:434-441) and Uncomfortable Situations (us-03-radcliffe.json:110,:234) suppress verbatim text.
gates_assessment.verdict: REDESIGN. Replace a global word ceiling with a per-record policy: store the clause with its span and a redaction_policy field (public | internal-only | quote-limited), so the index remains complete while distribution is controlled. No scanner path or output artifact was ever named, so this gate produced no evidence in any of the five entries.

gates_assessment.gate: v1 §9 / v2 §10 — 'Every HMD-derived numeric claim carries FE-U; every theory-linking claim carries P' (v1:256, v2:291)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Works and was honoured — the tags are present and consistent throughout the entry.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Scales well and is exactly the right shape once tags are record fields rather than inline prose markers. The audit found tag values elsewhere degenerate into 162 uncontrolled stance values with 195 nulls (Boredom Secondary) precisely because they were never enumerated.
gates_assessment.verdict: KEEP, CONTROL, AUTOMATE. Enumerate the vocabulary in the schema as a closed set, make the field required, and gate on 100% populated with 0 out-of-vocabulary values.

gates_assessment.gate: anchor §1.5 Phase-1 GATE — '(a) deletion diff (24 rows, both per-unit + global); (b) each of the 24 retains a bridges-to-part-iii edge; (c) tally correction; (d) compiled-index edge count before→after; (e) the 3 bridges still placeholders' (:85-89)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Fully defined — every item has a computable answer against a known denominator (24, and the specific 3).
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Generalises cleanly to any bulk edge operation.
gates_assessment.verdict: BEST GATE IN THE SERIES — PRESERVE. Item (b) is a genuine non-destruction invariant, item (d) a real before/after delta. Its one gap is that it verified nothing about the rest of the corpus: 22 live locations elsewhere in the same entry still assert the anchor does not exist. Add a post-operation corpus-wide invariant sweep.

gates_assessment.gate: v2 §6 Phase 5 / §10 — GATE G1: 'show the diff + compiled output; wait for sign-off before committing' + 'Timestamped backup taken before editing any existing tracked file' (:236-239, :297)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: The backup half is real and was honoured (.backups/ directories exist throughout). The sign-off half has no artifact-level acceptance criteria at all.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Human review of a claim-level diff is infeasible; without scripted criteria the gate degenerates to 'someone said yes'.
gates_assessment.verdict: SPLIT. Keep the backup requirement verbatim. Replace bare human sign-off with sign-off on a scripted gates report. Note the observed failure mode: v2 stalled at G1 awaiting sign-off and was superseded five days later, stranding a byte-verified 12-column schema, a 24-cell inventory and a four-channel-corroborated result in a plan file where none of it reaches the index.

gates_assessment.gate: new-media plan — 'verify every verbatim via archon evidence find … --mode exact' (:135)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Ran, and the results are real: 22 loci across three entries recorded as exact-1.00.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Would scale as a command, but the gate captures the verdict and discards the payload, so at 500 records per source it would produce 500 ticks and still zero addresses.
gates_assessment.verdict: HALF-RIGHT, HALF-WASTED. Verification ran and was honest (ptf-01's OCR failures were flagged rather than hidden). But the bbox and char span the tool returned were recorded as 'bbox ✓' 45+ times and never stored. Change the gate from 'verify' to 'verify and persist the provenance object', and gate on 100% numeric-bbox coverage.

gates_assessment.gate: new-media plan — entry-level quality gates
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: There are none. The document has no gates section, no acceptance criteria and no definition of done.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Nothing to evaluate.
gates_assessment.verdict: ABSENT. Three of the five ontology-only entries were built with no gate of any kind; none has quality-gates-report.md or metrics.json. Any new plan must forbid entry creation from a phase report and require a versioned creation plan carrying schema, id grammar, gate script and coverage floors.

gates_assessment.gate: VLE — governing instruction recorded in its own manifest: 'phase-3 registration build (Part III full run; gates deferred to post-run review)' (corpus/index/Virtual Learning Environments (King–Salvo)/_synthesis/manifest.json:6)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Gates explicitly waived at build time.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Same.
gates_assessment.verdict: CATASTROPHIC PRECEDENT. The deferred review never happened; 7 of 18 nodes now carry counts their own units superseded on 2026-07-23/24, and since the ontology file is the only file that compiles, 100% of what VLE serves to runtime is stale — including the E-SHA 67 figure now live in compiled-index.json:155 and the 4.3-vs-1.2 figure copied into 12 live files of a sibling entry. 'Gates deferred' must be prohibited: a build with deferred gates is a draft and must not register.

summary:
Three plans totalling 795 lines produced a 9-file entry because the third plan changed what was being built. v1 (2026-07-10) and v2 (2026-07-11) planned a data entry: five units under prefix `bor-`, a byte-verified 12-column HMD schema, a 24-cell subject×condition file inventory with per-cell exception flags, a measured ~2.99 Hz cadence and the eyes-open filtering rule it forces, and a worked four-channel proof (S05 eyes-closed 77.0%, 1826/2371 rows). The anchor plan (2026-07-16) redefined the deliverable in one sentence — "its value is the node itself + its outbound edges" (:96-97) — and shipped a 7-row channel taxonomy authored from vle-02 and an untracked brief rather than from the data.

The v1→v2 move was a genuine correction: every blocking decision closed, the column schema moved from "inferred, NOT confirmed" to author-confirmed and byte-verified, the P1/P2 papers found already digested in-tree, all 24 cells enumerated with no silent gaps, and a load-bearing result demonstrated end-to-end. The v2→anchor move was a retreat, and the plans show it. The stated trigger (§ Rescope rationale :10-31) concerns the VR Pedagogy cluster's 24 misdirected `grounds-measure` edges — an edge-direction problem that has nothing to do with the HMD layer. The three hard gates that shrank the entry were all already answered: O-10 was declared explicitly non-blocking in v2 §9:282-286; the PII constraint was solved in v2 §11:311-313 by runtime-derived S-codes; and O-9 was the very thing v1/v2 existed to resolve. The anchor plan's PII gate then went further than any predecessor — "Do NOT `ls`/`find` inside `Subjects/`" (:101-105) — which forbade the mechanism v2 had designed and already run, and forbade the only path to verifying what the channels contain. Two consequences follow directly. The false row `ch-obs … OBS posture/fidget/watch-glance` (:133) shipped verbatim into a canonical node definition at commit 48ac09a96 and needed a corrective commit eight days later. And O-9 processing was completed the same afternoon the entry was built (commit b766783a5, scripts/boredom-o9/, 764 lines, all 8 subjects, N=8 Friedman+Wilcoxon+Holm, pupil dilation Boring < Clinical in all 8, p=0.008) with `out/` gitignored and findings routed to an untracked note — so the index still declares four of seven channels "declared-but-unprocessed" while the dataset's only significant statistical result exists nowhere in corpus/index/.

"Full treatment on the cluster template" (D3) is the wrong target for this entry, but the right answer is more granular, not less. This is not a cluster of sources; it is a single instrumented dataset. The cluster template's apparatus — debate axes, citation network, cross-source concordance, contests/extends edges — is undefined at N=1 and would be padding. What the entry needs is a PRIMARY-DATASET profile whose atom is a measurement cell: 168 self-report records (8 subjects × 3 conditions × 7 items, already tabulated in the untracked brief) plus per-cell derived metrics for all 24 cells from the O-9 scripts, each with a stable id, a typed relation set, and a (subject, condition, item) address. That is roughly 300-400 addressable records against today's 7 nodes, and every input for it already exists on disk. The instruction that forbids it is the O-10 gate's entry-wide content ceiling (:106-109), which must be replaced by a per-record `use_scope` field: consent governs quotation in the dissertation, never granularity of indexing.

The other four ontology-only entries fail the same way for different reasons. VLE has no creation plan at all; its manifest records "gates deferred to post-run review" (manifest.json:6), the review never ran, and 7 of its 18 nodes now carry counts its own units superseded on 2026-07-23/24 — including E-SHA 67 (now 91), D2 159/21 (now 166/16), darkness "weakly attested (4)" (now ATTESTED, 10), and 4.3 vs 1.2 per-100 (now 2.8 vs 1.5). Because only book-level-ontology.md compiles, 100% of VLE's runtime figures are stale, and the superseded 4.3-vs-1.2 has propagated into 12 live files of VR Pedagogy Secondary plus four global-edges.csv rows and compiled-index.json. Presence Theory (4 sources), Social Presence (3) and Rhetoric of Interactivity (2) were built from a phase REPORT with no gates section, no acceptance criteria and no definition of done; their unit template's terminal product is "drafting loci" keyed to one Part III passage, which caps them at 22 verbatim loci for 9 sources across ~141 pages. They need a SMALL-PAIR / ARTICLE profile: exhaustive per-source claim and clause extraction with mandatory outbound edges into larger entries, explicitly waiving the cross-source gates that are vacuous at N=2-4.

The single highest-value finding is not about size. Those 22 loci were each verified with `archon evidence find --mode exact`, which returned a bounding box — the report says so at §4. The plan required recording the verdict, not the payload. The string "bbox ✓" appears 45+ times across the three entries; zero coordinates are stored anywhere in corpus/index/. The clause-level address the entire programme is missing was in hand at authoring time, for every quotation, and was replaced with a checkmark. A new plan that mandates persisting {doc_id, chunk_id, page, bbox, char_span, sim, snapshot_id} on every quotation record, and gates on 100% numeric-bbox coverage, converts the corpus's finest locator from a page number to a clause box using tooling that already works.

scope: plans/vr-pedagogy-secondary-cluster-index-plan-2026-07-15.md (244 lines, read in full) and its parent plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md (239 lines, read in full), audited against corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/ (127 non-backup files: 45 .md, 41 .json, 36 .csv, 5 .mmd; 34 unit folders, 34/34 complete trios, 0 id collisions, 0 dangling ids). Cross-read: scripts/compile-corpus-index.py, scripts/normalize-edges.py, src/god-agent/retrieval/smart-retrieval-layer.ts, corpus/index/compiled-index.json, the Boredom Secondary cluster-ontology.md exemplar, and the Biocca et al. 2003 source PDF for quotation verification.
summary: A well-executed plan produced the most defective entry because the plan optimised for a target that is not the goal.
