Every gate in section 8 measures prose completeness and coverage; none measures reachability, fidelity, or evidentiary backing. The entry scores 34/34 on its own rubric while 126 of its 127 files reach nothing: the compiler reads exactly one file (_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md, section 3A) and harvests 60 nodes. The 1,129-row global-edges.csv, 2,260 per-unit edge rows, 94-cell concordance, 79-lemma appendix, 10-debate map, 18 contested readings, 5 graphs and all 34 unit trios are read by no code in the repo. normalize-edges.py has a hardcoded 6-pipeline whitelist this cluster is not in, and collect_tension_edges looks for a tension-edges.json the plan never mentions, so all 10 debate axes yield 0 runtime edges. CRITICAL 1: the plan hand-authored its frozen vocabulary with TRAILING parentheticals at lines 118-127 (presence (spatial/physical), immersion (technological), IVR (HMD), conventional instruction (control)), then at 186-187 ordered those exact labels rendered as '#### N. Name' node headings. _parse_header_section (compile-corpus-index.py:687) captures any trailing parenthetical, :734-736 assigns it to the greek slot when no lemma exists, and build_canonical_terms (:1286) exports greek into the corpus-wide term list. Result: 19 of 60 node names truncated and the bare words technological and control entered a greedy substring matcher (smart-retrieval-layer.ts:268, length>=4 substring test, +0.10 boost) that fires on every registered text corpus-wide, plus a protectedTerms whitelist. The Boredom exemplar the plan told the author to copy has ZERO parentheticals in its 20+ headings, so imitation was safe; this plan's own section 3 vocabulary was the sole source of the breaking form. CRITICAL 2: global-edges.csv is specified only as concat + dedup (template:116,:173) with no key; the executor keyed on source+relation+target+locus and two distinct bridges-to-vle edges (ped-sec-06 CAMIL-usability, ped-sec-34 vle-01-F7) with locus n/a and different notes collapsed into one. The fabricated quotation is structural: section 0 line 31-32 gates quotation LENGTH for copyright and never FIDELITY, so ped-sec-29's quoted 'sense of being in the place' (the source reads 'being in the virtual place', Biocca p.456) is 6 words, inside the 12-word allowance, tagged FE as the source's own published claim, and passes every gate; the verbatim detector that lines 204 and 223 order run does not exist in scripts/. Worst of all the concordance, which the plan calls the primary-object anchor (line 112), was required to carry page anchor plus one-line note plus direction of effect per cell (lines 129-130) but was derived by a mechanical co-occurrence join over edges as the artifact itself states; 316 of its 348 cell-unit assertions (90.8%) have no authored construct-under-condition edge, and its JSON shipped as row/column/units instead of the mandated construct/condition/sources with id, locus and note. The gate could not catch this because it asks only that every unit appear in at least one cell, which the join satisfies by construction. For the claim-level goal the numbers are decisive: 99,531 words of authored prose yielded about 1,300 addressable records (~76 words per record) against the ~58 words per record the Dissertation entry already achieves, and the finest locator anywhere in the entry is a page number because line 32 asks for page numbers and nothing finer.
what_the_plan_actually_specifies: The plan instantiates a reusable TEMPLATE. Section P fills seven parameters (SOURCE_DIR corpus/pedagogy/, CLUSTER_NAME, PREFIX ped-sec-, PURPOSE, two ANCHORS, ANCHOR_EDGE_NAMES, CONCORDANCE_HINT). Section 0 sets anchor discipline (bridge never duplicate), three provenance tags (FE, FAITHFUL-AUTHOR, P/anticipatory-application) and a copyright rule: no 25-word-or-longer verbatim, 12-word-or-shorter anchor phrases with page numbers permitted. Section 1A groups 23 sources into strands A-E; 1B records one exclusion (Synnott) and one OCR-LOW flag (Lombard); 1C is a provisional 23-row unit table fixing id/slug/author/year/pp/strand/depth, with the template declaring manifest.json authoritative thereafter (template:78-79). Section 2 fixes the folder layout: a _synthesis dir of about 12 named artifacts plus 5 .mmd, bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md, one folder per unit holding an .md/.json/-edges.csv trio, and units/ped-sec-00-corpus-overview.md. Section 3 declares the payoff artifact: a construct-by-media-condition concordance with 14 frozen row labels and 8 frozen column labels, each cell to carry sources plus page anchor plus one-line note plus direction of effect, JSON shaped construct/condition/sources with id, locus, note. Section 4 fixes controlled vocabulary: 11 object types, about 18 edge relations across standard/cluster/primary-object/bridge families, 9 themes, 8 seeded debate axes. Section 5 runs five phases: Phase 0 re-extracts every PDF with pdftotext into a session scratchpad and writes phase0-overview.md plus manifest.json; Phase 1 emits per-unit metadata JSONs; Phase 2 dispatches one agent per unit with the txt path, frozen axes, vocabulary, edge floors (map 12, deep 20), a prose section skeleton, word-count targets (1500-3000w theory, 1000-2500w empirical, 400-1000w map) and a quality exemplar; Phase 3 authors the synthesis layer in the main loop in waves 3A-3E with cluster-ontology.md required to carry a header-format Canonical Node List; Phase 4 writes bridge pointers and a 25-edge-max cross-pipeline graph. Section 6 is Phase 5 compiler wiring: back up the compiler and compiled-index.json, add one TEXT_DIRS dict entry with ontology_format header and analysis_subdir _synthesis, run the compiler, verify counts by reading, run the verbatim detector, then GATE G1 (show diff, counts and one sample trio, wait for sign-off, never commit before G1). Section 7 mandates the Agent tool not Workflow, budgets 23 metadata agents in batches of about 8 plus 23 deep agents, warns that hooks no-op about 1 in 8 subagents and requires post-batch existence checks, and routes mid-run deviations to manifest planCorrections. Section 8 is an eight-item markdown checkbox gate list at N=23. Section 9 records six G0 decisions marked CONFIRMED with the instruction to execute as stated and not re-open. Section 10 lists key paths.

defects.defect: The plan hand-authors its frozen canonical vocabulary with TRAILING PARENTHETICAL QUALIFIERS -- construct rows 'presence (spatial/physical)', 'immersion (technological)', 'cognitive load (extraneous vs germane)' (lines 119-122) and media-condition columns 'IVR (HMD)', 'conventional instruction (control)', 'SEM / process model (no media contrast)' (lines 125-126) -- and declares them frozen vocabulary (line 118). Phase 3 at lines 186-187 then orders those same labels rendered as '#### N. Name' headings under the Canonical Node List. The compiler header parser at scripts/compile-corpus-index.py:687 matches a regex that strips any END-ANCHORED parenthetical into a 'parenthetical' group; lines 734-736 then assign greek = parenthetical whenever no greek_lemma or german_lemma field exists, which is always true for a non-classical domain. The plan asserts a fact about the compiler that is false twice over: the parenthetical is not inert, and the 3A heading does not scope the harvest for header format at all (parse_header_ontology at :513-550 splits the ENTIRE file on '#### N.', unlike the table path which does restrict to 3A at :220-228). The exemplar the plan points at (plan line 242, corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md) has ZERO parentheticals in its headings, so 'replicate the Boredom structure exactly' was safe advice; the breaking form came only from this plan's own section 3 label list.
defects.consequence_observed: 19 of 60 nodes for this entry in corpus/index/compiled-index.json are corrupted: names truncated and qualifiers moved to the greek slot -- Presence/spatial-physical, Immersion/technological, Cognitive load/extraneous-vs-germane, IVR/HMD, Conventional instruction/control, SEM process model/no media contrast, CAMIL/full-name, Witmer & Singer Presence Questionnaire/PQ-ITQ, Cognitive presence/CoI component, Teaching presence/CoI component, Gunawardena Social Presence Scale/SPRES, Short Williams & Christie theory/1976, Presence Questionnaire subscales/Control-Sensory-Distraction-Realism, Methods-not-media/Clarks distinction, Simulator Sickness Questionnaire/SSQ, Deployment context/home-classroom-lab, Intimacy-immediacy/SPRES sub-factors, Automatic-interaction assumption/Pitfall 1, Cognitive-only restriction/Pitfall 2. build_canonical_terms (:1286) exports the greek field, so all 19 fragments entered the 1,722-entry global canonicalTerms list. src/god-agent/retrieval/smart-retrieval-layer.ts:268 greedy-matches any term of length 4 or more as a raw substring of the query and applies a +0.10 relevance boost, so the bare English words technological and control now fire on any query in ANY registered text corpus-wide; line 811 additionally injects the whole list into a protectedTerms whitelist. Damaged file: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md headings at lines 182,194,212,266,290,302,314,332,338,344,350,356,374,398,404,416,422,442,452,458, propagating into corpus/index/compiled-index.json globally.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Forbid parenthetical qualifiers in any identifier that reaches an addressable slot. State the node-heading grammar as a testable production: '#### <int>. <Name>' where Name matches ^[^()]+$. Move every qualifier into an explicit qualifier bullet. Add a REGISTRATION CONTRACT TEST as a gate artifact: after compiling assert (a) compiled node count equals authored count, (b) every compiled name string-equals its authored heading, (c) greek and transliteration slots are EMPTY for every non-classical entry, (d) the set of canonicalTerms contributed by this entry minus the set of authored names is empty. Fail the build on any diff. Never let a plan assert what a parser does; make it assert what the compiled output must equal.

defects.defect: The only quotation rule in the plan is a COPYRIGHT-LENGTH rule: no 25-word-or-longer verbatim, paraphrase plus 12-word-or-shorter anchor phrases with page numbers (echoed at gate line 221 and template:44-45). There is no fidelity requirement anywhere: nothing obliges the author to confirm that a quoted string occurs in the source, nothing records a character offset or searchable span, and the gate at line 223 plus section 6 line 204 reference a verbatim detector that does not exist -- scripts/ contains 19 .py files and no verbatim or quotation detector (only substitute-quote-ids.py). The rule is structurally inverted for the goal: it makes SHORT quotations both maximally likely and entirely unchecked, and short clause-level quotation is exactly what a claim/clause index must carry.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/Biocca Burgoon & Harms - Robust Theory of Social Presence (2003)/ped-sec-29-biocca-burgoon-harms-robust-theory.md line 7 asserts, inside a sentence tagged (FE, p.456-457) and therefore presented as the source's own published claim, that spatial/telepresence is the 'sense of being in the place'. The source PDF reads: sense of 'being in the virtual place' (corpus/pedagogy/Biocca, Frank, et al. - Toward a More Robust Theory and Measure of Social Presence (2003).pdf, extracted lines 40-41), and separately: beyond the 'sense of the place' that spatial presence measures (line 44). The shipped string occurs nowhere in the source; it is a conflation of two adjacent quoted phrases with the word virtual silently dropped. At 6 words it sits inside the 12-word allowance so the length gate passes, there is no fidelity gate, and the named detector does not exist. The defect is undetectable by every gate the plan defines.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Separate the copyright constraint from the fidelity constraint and gate both. (1) Every quoted span at any length is stored as quote_id, unit_id, source_doc, page, char_start, char_end, exact_text, sha256 of exact_text, extracted from a PERSISTENT normalized source text rather than typed by an agent. (2) Make quotation MACHINE-VERIFIABLE: a gate script re-reads the persisted source at the recorded offsets and asserts byte equality; any mismatch fails the build. (3) Ban quotation marks in hand-typed prose; quotations may only be interpolated from the quote registry by id (scripts/substitute-quote-ids.py already exists, wire it). (4) Forbid the FE provenance tag on any sentence containing a quoted span lacking a verified quote_id. (5) Never name a gate tool the plan has not verified exists; cite its path and exact invocation.

defects.defect: Section 6 defines compiler wiring as adding ONE TEXT_DIRS dict entry with ontology_format header and analysis_subdir _synthesis. That single entry causes the compiler to read exactly one file, _synthesis/cluster-ontology.md (compile-corpus-index.py:1217-1227). The plan never asks whether any OTHER artifact it commissions has a reader. It does not: collect_tension_edges (:1254-1273) looks for analysis_subdir/tension-edges.json, a filename the plan never mentions in sections 2, 5, 6 or 8, so the entry has none; scripts/normalize-edges.py lines 36-41 hardcode a six-pipeline whitelist (phantasia, rickert, bt, bcap, uexkull, aristotle) that this cluster is not in, so global-edges.csv is read by nothing; and repo-wide grep finds zero readers for concept-matrix, concordance, terminology-appendix and debate-map. The plan commissions about 12 named synthesis artifacts plus 3 files per unit and wires 1.
defects.consequence_observed: Of 127 files in corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/, exactly ONE reaches runtime. Unreachable: _synthesis/global-edges.csv (304 KB, 1,129 deduplicated rows), all 34 per-unit -edges.csv (2,260 rows), all 34 unit .md and .json, _synthesis/debate-map.md and .json (10 documented debates), _synthesis/vr-pedagogy-construct-condition-concordance.md and .json (94 cells), _synthesis/vr-pedagogy-terminology-appendix.json (79 lemmas), _synthesis/concept-matrix.csv (34x34), _synthesis/contested-readings.md (18 CRs), _synthesis/citation-network.md and .json, _synthesis/vr-pedagogy-secondary-literature-network.md and .json, _synthesis/vr-pedagogy-scholarly-evolution.md, all 5 .mmd, and bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md. compiled-index.json contains 64 tensionEdges total and ZERO from this entry (all come from Aristotle, Heidegger, Uexkull and Rickert). The 10 debate axes survive only as flat ontology node NAMES (headings 51 through 60 in cluster-ontology.md) with no poles, no sources and no resolution.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Invert the wiring step: specify the RUNTIME SCHEMA FIRST and derive the authoring format from it. (1) Enumerate by file path and function name every reader that exists today and the exact shape each requires: compile-corpus-index.py collect_ontology_nodes, collect_tension_edges (needs node_a/node_b), build_canonical_terms; normalize-edges.py PIPELINES. (2) For every commissioned artifact name its reader on the same line; if none exists either commission the reader as a deliverable or drop the artifact. (3) Make tension-edges.json with node_a/node_b a first-class Phase-3 deliverable. (4) Add the new entry to normalize-edges.py PIPELINES as part of wiring. (5) Gate on REACHABILITY with a hard number: reachable_records divided by authored_records must be at least 0.95, computed by a script that loads compiled-index.json and the edge store and resolves authored ids. Replace 'compiler runs clean' (line 223) with 'N authored records in, N addressable records out'.

defects.defect: Section 3 defines the concordance as the cluster's whole payoff (line 112 calls it the primary-object anchor; lines 113-114 say the lookup Part III needs is which construct behaves how under which medium) and specifies each cell as source(s) treating that construct under that condition, with page anchor plus one-line note including direction of effect, with JSON shaped construct/condition/sources containing id, locus and note (lines 129-130; template:176-177). The GATE at lines 218-219 measures only coverage: every construct row maps to at least one VLE node where one exists, and every unit appears in at least one cell. Coverage is trivially satisfiable by a mechanical join over the per-unit edge files, which is exactly what the executor did. The plan never forbids a derived cell, never requires a per-cell provenance tag, and never requires the cell locus to trace to an authored edge. Section 4 line 140 does define the correct relation (construct-under-condition) but section 3 never says the concordance must be BUILT FROM it.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/vr-pedagogy-construct-condition-concordance.md lines 4-6 state its own derivation: cells list units whose data speaks to that construct under that condition, defined as co-occurrence of a treats-construct and a tests-condition edge in the same unit. Measured: 348 cell-unit assertions across 94 cells; only 32 are backed by an authored construct-under-condition edge in global-edges.csv, so 316 (90.8%) are unbacked co-occurrence artifacts and only 23 of 94 cells have even one backed unit. The join manufactures false claims: the cell Presence (spatial/physical) by Home vs classroom setting lists ped-sec-07, but ped-sec-07's only authored home-vs-classroom construct-under-condition edge is learning outcomes retention and transfer (Mayer et al. - Promise and Pitfalls (2022)/ped-sec-07-mayer-promise-pitfalls-edges.csv line 14); the source reports nothing about presence under that contrast. Separately the shipped JSON violates the plan's own declared schema: cells are row/column/units only, so the sources array with id, locus and note is gone and NO page anchor, NO note and NO direction of effect survives in either the .json or the .md. The single field the plan called indispensable is absent from 100% of cells and no gate noticed.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Gate the concordance on EVIDENTIARY BACKING, not coverage. (1) Every cell-source assertion must carry unit_id, quote_id or page span, direction (positive/negative/null/ns), effect size or null, and provenance, and must derive from exactly one claim record; the cell is a VIEW over claim records, never hand-built or join-built. (2) Add the gate unbacked_assertions equals 0, computed by joining the concordance against the claim store on id. (3) Forbid mechanical co-occurrence derivation explicitly and by name, since it is the cheapest way to pass a coverage gate. (4) Declare the JSON schema as a committed JSON Schema file and validate every artifact against it in the gate script; a prose sentence describing a schema was not enforceable and was not enforced.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:116 and :173 (invoked by plan:185, gated at plan:216)
defects.defect: global-edges.csv is specified only as all per-unit edges concatenated and deduped (line 116) and as concat plus dedup (line 173), and the gate counts deduplicated global edges (plan line 216). The DEDUPLICATION KEY is never stated. Neither plan says which columns constitute identity, whether the note column is part of identity, or what to do when two genuinely distinct edges share source, relation and target. Template line 164 requires loci to carry page anchors on both sides where applicable; the escape clause 'where applicable' permits n/a loci on bridge edges, which is exactly where the collision lands.
defects.consequence_observed: The executor keyed on source, relation, target and locus. 2,260 per-unit rows became 1,129 global rows; 1,131 distinct full rows collapsed to 1,129, silently discarding two NON-duplicate edges with distinct notes: ped-sec-06 bridges-to-vle vle-01-deployment-survey with locus n/a and the note about CAMIL's usability discussion at p.952-953 predicting low-usability breakage in presence and agency; and ped-sec-34 bridges-to-vle vle-01-deployment-survey with locus n/a and the note about vle-01's F7 finding (F1-PRESENCE 4.3 vs 1.2 per-100, APP vs VID). Both survive in corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/Makransky & Petersen - CAMIL (2021)/ped-sec-06-makransky-camil-edges.csv and in .../VanderMeer et al. - VR Collaborative Learning Review (2023)/ped-sec-34-vandermeer-vr-collaborative-learning-review-edges.csv but are absent from _synthesis/global-edges.csv. Five further triples with divergent notes survived only because their loci happened to differ; the same key would have destroyed them too.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Give every record a STABLE UNIQUE ID at authoring time and never dedupe on content. Each edge or claim record carries an id of the form unit-eNNN assigned by the authoring agent; the global store is a concatenation keyed on id; duplicate detection is a REPORT listing id pairs with identical source, relation, target, locus and note that a human resolves, never a silent drop. Add the gate count of global records equals the sum of per-unit record counts, as an exact equality, so any loss fails the build. The Veri(dis)similitude entry with 157 claim rows and stable unique IDs already proves the pattern works in this corpus.

defects.defect: The plan states that cluster-ontology.md MUST carry the header-format Canonical Node List and calls it the compiler input (echoed at template:114 and :168-172). This asserts that the 3A heading scopes what the compiler harvests. For ontology_format header, the format this plan selects at line 200, that is false. parse_header_ontology (compile-corpus-index.py:513-550) splits the ENTIRE file on the pattern for '#### N.' or bold-number headings with no section restriction; only the TABLE path restricts to 3A (lines 220-228). Any numbered fourth-level heading anywhere in the document, including in narrative prose, silently becomes an ontology node and its name a global canonicalTerm.
defects.consequence_observed: Latent but live in corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md, a 540-line file with seven narrative second-level sections at lines 16, 41, 75, 91, 129, 150 and 158 preceding the 3A heading at line 176. It escaped injection only because the author happened to confine all 60 fourth-level headings to 3A. The companion audit finding that three clusters (Phantasia, RDR2 Secondary, Emotion) were authored in a prose ontology dialect no parser reads and register with zero nodes and no warning is the same class of defect: the plan describes the compiler rather than testing it.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: The new plan must not describe parser behaviour in prose. Replace with (a) a committed fixture file plus an assertion that compiling it yields an exact expected node list, run BEFORE any authoring begins as a Phase-0 hello-world registration step rather than at Phase 5, and (b) a rule that the machine-readable node list lives in its own file containing nothing else, so document structure cannot leak into the harvest. Also gate compiler warnings equals 0; the compiler already prints warnings at line 1355 that nothing checks.

defects.defect: Section 8 is headed 'Quality gates (N = 23)' and hard-codes the derived numeral: at least 276 deduplicated global edges, annotated as 12 times N. N is frozen at plan-authoring time into a literal, so when N changes the gate does not. The template states the general form 12N (template:219) but the instantiated plan substitutes the constant, and section 7 line 209 likewise hard-codes 23 metadata agents and 23 deep agents. Nothing recomputes section 8 from manifest totalAnalyticalUnits, which template lines 78-79 declare authoritative. Compounding this, section 9 line 226 marks the G0 decisions CONFIRMED and instructs the executor to execute as stated and not re-open, which discourages re-gating when scope moves.
defects.consequence_observed: N drifted from 23 to 34. _synthesis/manifest.json records totalAnalyticalUnits 34 and a planCorrections entry documenting 11 sources added post-Phase-1 by mid-session prose exchange, explicitly described as not a formal G0 re-vote. The correct floor became 408; the plan's checkbox still reads 276. Every downstream numeral is likewise stale: the plan's section 1A strands A-E never mention the Strand F (ped-sec-25 through 34) that now holds 10 of 34 units; section 3's social presence / co-presence construct row had no source at all at G0 sign-off and was retro-grounded; line 215 still says 23 unit trios on disk. The gate passed only because the actual count of 1,129 exceeded both numbers by accident.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Never write a derived constant into a gate. Express every threshold as an expression over a machine-read value (at least 12 times manifest.totalAnalyticalUnits) and make the gate a SCRIPT that reads the manifest rather than a markdown checkbox a human ticks. Add an explicit SCOPE-CHANGE PROCEDURE: any change to N re-runs the gate script and requires re-sign-off. Forbid 'do not re-open' phrasing on any decision a later phase can invalidate.

defects.defect: Section 1C fixes unit identity -- id, slug, folder name and author string -- from a Phase-minus-1 metadata SKIM (template line 54 specifies pdftotext of the first three pages), before any source is read. Line 90 assigns ped-sec-14, slug colin-vr-desktop-2d, author 'Colin et al.', year 2022. Section 2 lines 105-110 then derive the on-disk folder name and all three filenames from that string, and template lines 78-79 say only that the manifest is authoritative thereafter; they never require a corrected identity to be back-propagated into the storage handles, and never require the author string to be verified against the article's own title page at all.
defects.consequence_observed: Colin is Robin Colin Alexander BARRETT's middle name. corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/manifest.json planCorrections entry 1 documents the executor catching this at Phase 1 and then DECLINING to fix it, stating it kept id, slug and folder as Phase 0 assigned them to match the plan's own section 1C table so cross-references stay stable. The plan's frozen table was treated as more authoritative than the source. On disk today, after commit d6e910a2d fixed only citation prose and metadata, the folder is still 'Colin et al. - VR Desktop-3D and 2D (2022)/' and the files are still ped-sec-14-colin-vr-desktop-2d.md/.json/-edges.csv, while all 30 provenance tags inside those files read FAITHFUL-Barrett et al. and bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md line 57 reads 'Barrett et al. 2022' -- a permanent internal contradiction. The same freeze produced three unresolved citation-year errors (ped-sec-04 version of record 2010 not 2009; ped-sec-05 2015 not 2014; ped-sec-13 2021 not 2020) and one mis-linkage (ped-sec-09 to ped-sec-16 should be an external cite to Merchant 2014), all documented in _synthesis/citation-corrections-2026-07-16.md and all still unapplied per its line 52.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Decouple the storage handle from the bibliographic fact. (1) Assign every unit an OPAQUE permanent id (ped-sec-14) that never encodes author, year or title, and name folders and files by that id alone. (2) Put author, year and title only in the manifest, as data. (3) Make Phase 1 include a mandatory BIBLIOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION against the article's own title page and DOI or copyright line, recording the version-of-record year, and gate that every unit has verified_bibliography true. (4) Require any correction file to be APPLIED, not merely written; gate that no citation-corrections file with unresolved recommendations exists at G1.

defects.defect: All eight gates are markdown checkboxes in the plan file. Nothing produces an artifact recording that they were evaluated, no gate is expressed as a runnable command, and several are not measurable as written: line 222 asks that 5 Mermaid graphs render without naming a renderer; line 221 asks for provenance tags throughout without defining the unit of text; line 223 asks that the verbatim detector be clean when no such script exists in scripts/. The plan also never requires gate results to be written to disk, so the evidence of evaluation is a transient chat message at G1 (line 205).
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/ contains NO quality-gates-report.md and no machine-readable metrics file, consistent with the corpus-wide finding that only 2 of 27 entries have a gates report and only 1 has machine-readable metrics. Independently measurable violations shipped unflagged: the units/ directory is EMPTY although section 2 line 110 and section 1C line 101 require units/ped-sec-00-corpus-overview.md; contested-readings.md contains 18 CRs against a stated band of 8-12 (line 216); the concordance JSON violates the schema at line 130; the concordance carries no page anchors although line 129 requires them. The gate list nonetheless passes because nothing ever evaluated it.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every gate must be a named script with an exit code, and the gate run must WRITE _synthesis/quality-gates-report.json containing gate_id, expression, expected, observed and pass for each, plus _synthesis/metrics.json. G1 shows that file. Add gates for what nobody checked: file-manifest completeness (every path section 2 names exists and is non-empty), schema validation of every JSON against a committed JSON Schema, and authored_records equals reachable_records. Delete any gate that cannot be written as an expression over measured values.

defects.defect: Phase 2 sets the unit of production as a PROSE DOCUMENT sized in words (theory and framework units 1,500-3,000w; empirical and review units 1,000-2,500w; map units 400-1,000w) and the unit of structure as a fixed nine-part narrative skeleton (lines 181-184: Thesis/Aim, Structure, Constructs, Conditions and design, Findings/Claims, Concordance feed, Analytical role, and a closing 'Not treated:' line). The only per-record floors are edge counts (map 12, deep 20, line 178). Nothing defines a CLAIM record, a claim id, a claim-to-claim support relation, a support tier, or any locator finer than a page (lines 32 and 129). The plan therefore caps granularity by construction: the finest addressable thing it can produce is an edge whose locus is a page range.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/ contains 99,531 words of authored markdown prose and yields roughly 1,300 addressable records (60 ontology nodes, 1,129 global edges, 94 concordance cells, 79 lemmas, 10 debates), which is about 76 words per record; only 60 of those reach runtime, about 1,659 words per runtime-addressable record. Against the goal this is an order of magnitude short: the Dissertation entry already achieves one claim record per about 58 words with 100 percent line-anchoring, an 8-tier support taxonomy and 841 typed edges, and Veri(dis)similitude achieves one structured claim per 59 words. Every locator in this 127-file entry is a page number or page range; not one sentence offset, character span or bbox exists because the plan never asked for one. The prose that WOULD support claim-level extraction was written -- the audit found about 1,277 provenance-tagged assertions in this entry's prose against only 233 structured readings, 5.5 times more -- but the plan gave it nowhere structured to go.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make the CLAIM the unit of production and the prose a rendering of it, reversing the current order. (1) Define a claim record schema: claim_id, unit_id, claim_text, claim_type, page, char_start, char_end, quote_id or null, support_tier from T1 textually-confirmed through T7 overreach, premises, supports, supported_by, contested_by, provenance, volatility. This is the Dissertation entry's proven schema generalised from the user's own prose onto sources. (2) Set the floor in RECORDS PER SOURCE-WORD: one claim record per 60 source words or fewer, roughly 50-500 records per article. (3) Delete all prose word-count targets, which currently reward volume. (4) Require a persistent normalized source text so char offsets are stable and re-verifiable.

defects.defect: Phase 0 extracts every PDF to a SESSION-SCOPED scratchpad (line 167 specifies a scratchpad path; line 239 notes the prior session's extraction did not persist). The plan knows the scratchpad is ephemeral -- it re-extracts precisely because of that -- yet still specifies an ephemeral destination and never requires the normalized text to be committed. It also never records the extraction tool version or a checksum of the extracted text.
defects.consequence_observed: The text that every page anchor, every 12-word-or-shorter quotation and every FAITHFUL tag in this entry refers to no longer exists. No claim in corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/ can be re-verified without re-extracting and hoping for byte-identical output, which is the same failure that rendered the In-Game entry's 995 line-range anchors worthless when /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt was deleted. It also made the ped-sec-29 fabricated quotation undiagnosable from the entry's own materials: I had to re-extract the source PDF to prove it. The known pdfium ligature-corruption hazard in this repo further means a future re-extraction may not reproduce the original text at all.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Commit the normalized source text as a build artifact under the entry at _sources/<unit_id>.txt alongside a sidecar recording extractor, extractor_version, sha256, extracted_at and page_offset_map. Every locator must be an offset into THAT committed file. Gate the re-computed sha256 against the recorded one, and gate that every recorded char_start and char_end resolves inside the committed text. Require an explicit page-offset verification step sampling at least 5 loci per source and confirming the recorded page matches the printed page; no plan in this repo requires this, which is why Aristotle carries 33 of 34 units with pdf_pages off by up to 47 pages and Rickert's declared offset is both wrong and non-constant, drifting from 20 to 18 to 15.

defects.defect: Section 7 budgets 23 metadata agents in batches of about 8 plus 23 deep agents, knows that pre and post-task hooks intermittently no-op a subagent about 1 in 8 times (template:208-209), and mitigates only with an EXISTENCE check: after each batch verify all three files exist per unit and self-author gaps (lines 210-211). Existence is not conformance. Nothing checks that a produced file has the required keys, the required floors, the frozen vocabulary or non-placeholder content; and the instruction to self-author gaps directs the orchestrator to fabricate a unit WITHOUT the source text in context, the highest-risk path to unverified content in the entire plan.
defects.consequence_observed: All 34 folders carry complete trios (verified: zero missing members), so the existence check passed, and the entry still drew 36 defects, the most of any entry in the corpus. Conformance failures shipped inside existing files: the concordance JSON violating the plan's own schema, 316 unbacked concordance assertions, the ped-sec-29 fabricated quotation, and 19 node headings in the breaking form. The check the plan specified could not see any of them.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace existence checks with per-unit CONFORMANCE validation run immediately after each agent returns: schema-validate the unit JSON, assert record-count floors, assert every vocabulary value is in the frozen enum, assert every quote_id resolves against the committed source text, assert no placeholder strings. Re-dispatch failures to a fresh agent WITH the source; never let the orchestrator self-author a unit it has not read. Emit a per-unit pass/fail row into the gates report.

defects.defect: The plan requires every unit to carry at least one treats-construct edge, Strand-C and Strand-D units at least one tests-condition edge, and every unit at least one bridges-to-vle or bridges-to-part-iii edge (line 184), gated at line 220. The bridge relations are defined at lines 141-143 as always tagged anticipatory-application, that is, OUR speculative link, explicitly never presented as the source's own claim (template:41-42). The gate therefore mandates a minimum quantity of the cluster's own unfalsifiable interpretation per unit, including for units where no such link exists. It measures authorial productivity, not indexed content.
defects.consequence_observed: All 34 units satisfy it (zero units lack a bridge edge), producing 49 bridges-to-vle plus 68 bridges-to-part-iii, that is 117 anticipatory edges or 10.4 percent of the 1,129-row global store, every one P-tagged speculation about an anchor. A further 24 grounds-measure edges to the never-built Boredom Experiment anchor were authored and then RETIRED wholesale, recorded in _synthesis/graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd lines 10-11. Plan lines 20 and 132 authorised authoring edges to an anchor the plan itself flags as NOT YET BUILT, making dangling references a planned output.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Floor the SOURCE-DERIVED record count (FE and FAITHFUL claims with verified quotes) and CAP the interpretive one, for example P-tagged records at most 0.15 times the FE plus FAITHFUL count. Forbid authoring any edge whose target entry does not exist; record intent rows in a separate pending-bridges.json that a later build resolves, so an unbuilt anchor never pollutes the edge store.

defects.defect: The 25-edge cap on graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd (line 192, gated at line 222) caps a rendering, not the data. A cap on a diagram is satisfiable by aggregation, which destroys exactly the unit-level detail the index exists to hold, and the plan offers no rule about acceptable aggregation. The requirement that 5 Mermaid graphs render is likewise unmeasurable as written since no renderer is named.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd lines 4-6 state it was aggregated at STRAND level with edge labels giving the count of unit-level bridge edges, explicitly to stay within the 25-edge Phase-4 cap, shipping 8 edges over 6 strand nodes. The 117 unit-level bridge edges are visible only as integer labels. The cap achieved its stated number by deleting the information.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Cap diagrams if you like, but never let a diagram cap constrain the data layer, and state that explicitly. Require the graph to be GENERATED from the record store by a committed script with a documented aggregation rule, so it can never diverge from the data and never becomes an authoring target.

defects.defect: Every quantitative gate is a cluster-level aggregate. At N=1, a single article and the granularity a claim/clause plan must support, the 12-times-N edge floor becomes 12 (trivially met, meaningless); 8-12 documented debates and 8-12 contested readings are cross-source constructs and are unsatisfiable from one source; at least 10 intra-cluster citations is unsatisfiable because zero sibling units exist; at least 50 lemmas is an arbitrary constant unrelated to N; and the concordance gates are satisfied by placing the single unit in one cell. The plan defines no N=1 behaviour and no N/A semantics, so an executor at N=1 must either fabricate cross-source content or silently skip gates.
defects.consequence_observed: Not directly observable in this 34-unit entry, but the same gate structure is what allowed 18 contested readings to ship against a stated band of 8-12 with nothing flagged, and it is the structural reason no single-source entry in the corpus carries a gates report. The corpus-wide result -- only 2 of 27 entries with a quality-gates-report.md and only 1 with machine-readable metrics -- is consistent with gates that cannot be evaluated honestly at the granularities actually used.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define N=1 behaviour explicitly for every gate. Replace cluster-aggregate gates with per-source INTRINSIC gates meaningful at N=1: records per source-word, quote-verification rate which must be 1.0, span-resolution rate which must be 1.0, enum-conformance rate which must be 1.0, reachability ratio at least 0.95, and unbacked-assertion count which must be 0. Mark genuinely cross-source gates (debates, contested readings, intra-cluster citations) as N/A below N=3 and record them as N/A in the gates report rather than letting them silently pass or forcing fabrication.

defects.defect: Section 4 declares 11 object types (CONSTRUCT, MEDIA-CONDITION, THEORY-MODEL, TERM, DEBATE-AXIS, INTERLOCUTOR, AUTHOR, THEME, READING/CLAIM, VLE-NODE, DATASET-CHANNEL) as a controlled vocabulary but never says where the type is recorded, never binds it to the compiler's type field, and never requires validation against the enum. The compiler's _parse_header_section writes type as node_type or centrality (line 759), so the same output slot silently accepts either an object type or a centrality tier depending on which bullet the author supplied.
defects.consequence_observed: All 60 nodes for this entry carry a domain type (CONSTRUCT, MEDIA-CONDITION, THEORY-MODEL, TERM, DEBATE-AXIS) in the compiled type field, while other registered entries carry centrality words there, so the corpus-wide ontologyNodes type field is not comparable across entries and cannot be filtered on. Ten DEBATE-AXIS nodes (headings 51 through 60) are the only runtime trace of the debate map, flattened into name strings with poles, sources and resolutions discarded.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Bind every controlled vocabulary to a named field in a committed JSON Schema with an enum, validate on build, and gate invalid_enum_values equals 0. Never reuse one output field for two vocabularies; if the compiler does so today, fix the compiler as part of wiring and say so in the plan.

unspecified_gaps: The dedup key for global-edges.csv (template:116, :173; gated plan:216) is never stated, so the executor invented source+relation+target+locus and silently lost 2 non-duplicate edges.

Whether any artifact other than cluster-ontology.md has a reader. Section 6 lines 194-205 wires one TEXT_DIRS entry and the plan never enumerates consumers, so 126 of 127 files were authored into a void.

tension-edges.json, the file collect_tension_edges requires and the ONLY channel by which a debate or tension reaches runtime, is named nowhere in sections 2, 5, 6 or 8. The executor could not have known to write it; the entry's 10 debate axes yield 0 runtime edges.

design_inputs: Define the CLAIM RECORD as the atomic deliverable and generate all prose from it, not the reverse. Exact schema: claim_id, unit_id, source_doc_sha256, claim_text, claim_type from an enum, page, char_start, char_end, quote_id or null, support_tier from T1 textually-confirmed through T3 interpretive-flagged to T7 overreach, premises list of claim_id, supports list, supported_by list, contested_by list, provenance from {FE, FAITHFUL-author, P}, volatility, reuse_disposition. This is not new work: it is the Dissertation entry's proven 982-record schema (100 percent line-anchored, 8-tier, 76 percent in an explicit supports graph, 841 typed edges) redirected from the user's own prose onto sources, cross-checked against Veri(dis)similitude's 157-row implementation.

Set the production floor in records per source-word, not words per unit: one claim record per 60 source words or fewer, roughly 50-500 records per article, matching the 58-59 words per record already demonstrated by the Dissertation and Veri(dis)similitude entries. Delete every prose word-count target; plan line 179 currently mandates 1500-3000w, 1000-2500w and 400-1000w, and that instruction is what produced 99,531 words carrying only about 1,300 records.

Require a CLAUSE-LEVEL LOCATOR on every record: char_start and char_end into a committed normalized source text. Nothing in the 1,758-file corpus carries a sentence offset, character span or bbox today; a page number is the finest locator anywhere. Gate that every recorded span resolves and that re-slicing it byte-equals the stored exact_text.

Commit the normalized source text as a first-class build artifact at _sources/<unit_id>.txt with a sidecar recording extractor, extractor_version, sha256, extracted_at and page_offset_map. Forbid ephemeral scratchpad extraction (plan lines 167 and 239). Gate on sha256 stability. This one change also resurrects the roughly 1,000 orphaned clause pointers in the In-Game entry by the same mechanism.

Make quotation MACHINE-VERIFIED, not length-limited. Store quote_id, source_doc, char_start, char_end, exact_text and sha256; interpolate quotes into prose only by quote_id; gate byte equality against the committed source on every build. Keep the copyright cap as a SEPARATE additional constraint. The ped-sec-29 case proves a 12-word allowance with no fidelity check is a fabrication licence: the shipped 'sense of being in the place' versus the source's 'being in the virtual place', tagged FE, passed every gate.

Forbid the FE provenance tag (the source's own published claim) on any sentence containing an unverified quoted span, and require a support_tier on every claim so interpretive material is separable at query time. The Dissertation entry's T1/T3/T7 split of 277/477/22 is the working model.

Specify the node-heading grammar as a testable production and ban parenthetical qualifiers in every addressable identifier: '#### <int>. <Name>' with Name matching ^[^()]+$; qualifiers move to an explicit qualifier bullet. This is the single instruction that would have prevented the 19-node corruption and the corpus-wide canonicalTerms pollution.

Require a REGISTRATION CONTRACT TEST as a Phase-0 gate before any authoring: compile a committed fixture and assert the compiled output exactly equals an expected node list. Re-run it as a G1 gate on the real entry asserting (a) compiled node count equals authored count, (b) every compiled name string-equals its authored heading, (c) greek and transliteration are empty for non-classical entries, (d) the entry's canonicalTerms minus the authored names is empty. This catches heading corruption, whole-file harvest leakage and global term pollution in one check.

Enumerate every EXISTING READER by file path and function before commissioning any artifact. Today: scripts/compile-corpus-index.py collect_ontology_nodes (reads _synthesis/cluster-ontology.md or book-level-ontology.md only), collect_tension_edges (reads _synthesis/tension-edges.json, requires node_a and node_b), build_canonical_terms (exports name, transliteration, greek and aliases); scripts/normalize-edges.py PIPELINES (hardcoded 6-entry dict). Every commissioned artifact must name its reader on the same line, or the plan must commission the reader as a deliverable, or the artifact must be dropped.

Make tension-edges.json with the compiler's required node_a and node_b keys a mandatory Phase-3 deliverable with a committed JSON Schema. Four of eleven existing tension-edges files yield zero runtime edges purely because no plan ever stated this schema; this plan produced zero because it never named the file at all.
Add the new entry to scripts/normalize-edges.py PIPELINES as an explicit numbered wiring step alongside the TEXT_DIRS edit, and gate that the edge store is loadable by it.

Replace the compile gate (plan line 223, compiler runs clean) with a REACHABILITY gate: reachable_records divided by authored_records at least 0.95, computed by a script that loads compiled-index.json plus the edge store and resolves authored ids. At 60 of 1300 this entry scores 0.046 and would fail immediately. Also gate compiler_warnings equals 0; the compiler already prints warnings nothing reads.

Assign every record a STABLE UNIQUE ID at authoring time (unit-cNNN for claims, unit-eNNN for edges, unit-qNNN for quotes). Never deduplicate on content. The global store concatenates on id; near-duplicate detection produces a REPORT for human resolution, never a silent drop. Gate count(global) equals sum(count(per-unit)) as an exact equality; this alone prevents the two-edge loss and makes the corpus-wide count-mismatch category of 66 defects structurally impossible.

Express every threshold as an expression over machine-read values (at least 12 times manifest.totalAnalyticalUnits), never a precomputed literal, and implement gates as a script that writes _synthesis/quality-gates-report.json with gate_id, expression, expected, observed and pass, plus _synthesis/metrics.json. G1 presents that file. Only 2 of 27 entries have a gates report today and only 1 has machine-readable metrics; make it structurally unavoidable.

Define N=1 behaviour explicitly for every gate, because a claim-level plan will be run on single articles. Today at N=1 the section 8 gates are variously vacuous or unsatisfiable: 12-times-N becomes 12 edges (meaningless), 8-12 documented debates and 8-12 contested readings are impossible from one source, at least 10 intra-cluster citations is impossible with zero siblings, and at least 50 lemmas is arbitrary. Replace with per-source intrinsic gates (records per source-word, quote-verification rate 1.0, span-resolution rate 1.0, enum-conformance 1.0, reachability at least 0.95, unbacked assertions 0) and mark cross-source gates N/A below N=3 rather than letting them silently pass.

Derive the concordance and every other matrix or view as a GENERATED VIEW over claim records, never as an authored artifact. Every cell-source assertion must resolve to exactly one claim_id and must carry page_or_span, direction, effect_size or null, and provenance. Gate unbacked_assertions equals 0. Explicitly forbid mechanical co-occurrence joins by name: 316 of 348 assertions (90.8 percent) in this entry are co-occurrence artifacts and 71 of 94 cells have no backing at all.

Commit a JSON Schema file for every artifact type and validate on build. A schema described in a prose sentence (plan line 130, construct/condition/sources with id, locus, note) was not followed and could not be checked; the shipped shape row/column/units dropped the locus and note fields entirely. This directly addresses the corpus-wide schema-violation category of 49 defects.

Decouple storage handles from bibliographic facts: folders and filenames use the opaque id only (ped-sec-14/), while author, year and title live in the manifest as data. Add a mandatory Phase-1 bibliographic verification against the title page and DOI or copyright line, recording the VERSION OF RECORD year, and gate that every unit has verified_bibliography true. Gate that no unresolved citation-corrections file exists at sign-off; this entry has one with four unapplied corrections in _synthesis/citation-corrections-2026-07-16.md.

Add a mandatory PAGE-OFFSET VERIFICATION step: sample at least 5 loci per source and confirm the recorded page matches the printed page; record pdf_page_offset and whether it is constant. No plan in the repo requires this, which is why Aristotle carries 33 of 34 units with offsets wrong by up to 47 pages and Rickert's declared offset is both wrong and drifting from 20 to 18 to 15.

Replace batch existence checks (plan lines 210-211) with per-unit CONFORMANCE validation on agent return: schema-validate, assert record floors, assert frozen-enum membership, assert every quote_id verifies, assert no placeholder strings. Re-dispatch failures to a fresh agent WITH the source text; forbid the orchestrator from self-authoring a unit it has not read. All 34 folders here passed the existence check and the entry still drew 36 defects.

Floor source-derived records and CAP interpretive ones (P-tagged at most 0.15 times FE plus FAITHFUL), reversing plan lines 184 and 220 which mandate a minimum quantity of the cluster's own speculation per unit and produced 117 anticipatory bridge edges, 10.4 percent of the store, plus 24 more authored then retired.

Forbid authoring any edge whose target entry does not exist. Route intended cross-entry links to a separate pending-bridges.json that a later build resolves, eliminating planned dangling references; the corpus carries 44 dangling-reference defects and this plan authorised them explicitly at lines 20 and 132 for an anchor it flags NOT YET BUILT.

Resolve the content-filter tension head-on and state the policy in the plan: a claim/clause index REQUIRES the clause, so verbatim suppression as practised at In-Game ig-10-deep.json lines 434-441 and Uncomfortable us-03-radcliffe.json lines 110 and 234 is incompatible with the goal. Specify instead that exact_text is always stored in the record layer with a redact_on_render flag, so copyright and policy constraints govern DISPLAY, never storage or verification.

Add a SCOPE-CHANGE PROCEDURE and remove do-not-re-open phrasing (plan line 226) from any decision a later phase can invalidate: any change to the unit set re-runs the gate script against the manifest and requires fresh sign-off. N drifted 23 to 34 here with an entire unplanned strand added and every section 8 numeral left stale.

Require the entry to declare, in a committed _synthesis/reachability.json, exactly which of its files are runtime inputs and which are human-only documentation, so that 126 of 127 files reaching nothing is visible at build time rather than discoverable only by a 106-agent audit.

Make the Not-treated requirement (plan line 182, template line 158) a first-class NEGATIVE-EVIDENCE record type with its own id and schema rather than a trailing prose line. It is rare in the corpus and directly serves the every-weakness half of the goal.

Bind the object-type vocabulary (plan lines 136-138) to a named schema field with an enum and stop letting the compiler write either an object type or a centrality tier into the same type slot (compile-corpus-index.py line 759), which currently makes ontologyNodes type non-comparable across entries.
what_to_preserve: The two-stage human gate: G0 on the spec before any authoring and G1 before commit, with an explicit never-commit-before-G1 (plan lines 205 and 224). The shape is right; it failed only because G1 was told to show a TEXT_DIRS diff and node counts rather than a machine-readable gates report.
Mandatory timestamped backups of the compiler and compiled-index.json before edits (plan lines 196 and 224). The .backups/ directory exists and is populated.

The three-tier provenance vocabulary FE / FAITHFUL-AUTHOR / P plus anticipatory-application (plan line 31, template lines 38-42). It is genuinely load-bearing, is followed consistently in the shipped edges, and maps cleanly onto the claim schema's provenance field.

The UNVERIFIED no-stall convention (plan lines 9-10): an executing agent records the gap and continues rather than blocking. Keep it, but require every marker to be a structured record with an owner rather than a prose string.

manifest.json planCorrections for mid-run deviations (plan line 211). It worked: the ped-sec-14 surname discovery, the Cook et al. scope correction, the 11-unit expansion and the mislabelled De Back/Terry PDF are all fully documented. Keep it and make it machine-readable and gate-visible.

Pre-extracting every source to text and handing agents the text path, never the PDF (plan lines 166-171, template lines 138-140). Correct for cost and for the known multi-page-image API-400 failure. Only the destination needs to change from scratchpad to committed artifact.
An explicit exclusion register with a stated reason (plan lines 62-69 and section 9.1) and the discipline of leaving the source file in place. The manifest excluded key works.

The OCR-LOW detection procedure: a pdftotext word-count sanity check with a documented fallback path (plan lines 167-170 and section 1B). It correctly identified Lombard and Ditton at 0 words, and manifest ocrAudit records the check, the range of 4,281 to 21,903 words, and the reasoning for the lowest non-zero count.

The anchor discipline bridge-never-duplicate with named bridge relations and pointer-only anchor files (plan lines 27-32 and 190-192). It is the right principle for avoiding the two-incompatible-registries problem seen in the Uncomfortable entry.

Frozen controlled vocabularies for the concordance axes with each source's own term recorded in the note (plan lines 118-127 and 130). Freezing the vocabulary is correct and produced a perfectly consistent 34x34 concept-matrix, 34 distinct unit ids and zero dangling references; only the label FORM and the missing enum validation were wrong.

The Not-treated requirement: every unit must name salient canonical nodes the source does NOT touch (plan line 182, template line 158). This is negative evidence, it is rare, and it directly serves the every-weakness goal.

Pointing each agent at a concrete quality exemplar (plan line 178, the bor-sec-13-slaby-other-side trio). Exemplar-driven authoring is effective; the exemplar simply has to be one that is itself schema-valid and reachable.

Authoring the synthesis layer in the main loop rather than via subagents (plan line 185, template line 167), using the Agent tool rather than Workflow, with an explicit per-phase budget (plan line 209).

The TEMPLATE-plus-instance split itself: a reusable invariant procedure plus a filled parameter section. It is the right architecture for a repeatable programme, provided the invariant half carries the schemas and gates rather than prose descriptions of them.
