summary:
This is the best plan in the programme and it produced the best entry, and the controlled comparison is unambiguous about why. Every gate the plan wrote as a countable, per-unit, machine-checkable predicate held: 55/55 units carry the full .md+.json+-edges.csv trio, 0 edge-floor violations against the 12/20/35 rubric, 1,897 deduplicated edges against a floor of 550, 11 debates against 8-12, 72 lemmas against 50, 65 intra-cluster citations against 10, no encoding corruption, no dangling bor-sec-* reference, no double concept registry, and all 55 units covered by the ontology. The planCorrections discipline is the single best artifact in the entire 27-entry corpus: 7 recorded corrections including one that catches the plan contradicting itself (line 208 scopes the bridges-to-fcm floor to Strand A, line 261 scopes it to Strand A/B) and refuses to fabricate three edges rather than pass the broader wording. That mechanism must be carried forward verbatim.

Everything the plan did NOT write as a countable per-unit predicate drifted, and the drift is systematic rather than accidental. The decisive proof is internal to this one plan. At line 24 it enumerates the FCM target ids literally (fcm-04-first-form ... fcm-07-particular-profound); 68 of 68 bridges-to-fcm edges resolve, 100%. At lines 170-171 it names the relation grounds-measure and describes its target as "a Boredom Experiment dataset channel" without enumerating any ids; 37 edges resolve to 27 distinct free-text strings and 0 of 37 resolve, even though that dataset entry now exists on disk with stable ids bex-00 through bex-04. At line 171 it names bridges-to-part-iii with no target vocabulary at all; 128 edges resolve to 122 distinct free-text strings. Enumerate the id space and it resolves; name a relation and it dangles. That is the whole finding, replicated three times inside one file.

The same mechanism explains the sub-item chaos the audit filed. Line 204 lists the unit JSON key names (readings[], constructs[], measures[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], sections[]) and never specifies one record schema. Result: 8 incompatible readings shapes, 5 constructs shapes, 7 measures shapes, 6 concepts shapes, 5 interlocutors shapes, 5 tensions shapes, 6 sections shapes — 42 mutually incompatible shapes across 2,924 sub-items. Line 165 defines READING/CLAIM as an object type in the controlled vocabulary but the plan nowhere says a reading is a record with an id, so 296 of 463 readings have no id at all, 9 of 55 agents invented their own (C1..C22, F1..F8), and those collide across 6 units. The plan defines stance nowhere, so stance carries 162 distinct values and 195 nulls.

The deepest defect is that the plan produces an entry the runtime cannot see. Section 6 (lines 228-243) wires only cluster-ontology.md into TEXT_DIRS, and the compiler reads exactly two files per entry: the ontology .md (collect_ontology_nodes, lines 1181-1230) and _synthesis/tension-edges.json (collect_tension_edges, lines 1253-1274). The plan's own folder layout (lines 119-132) never mentions tension-edges.json. So 1,897 edges, 2,924 sub-items, 91 concordance cells, 11 debate axes and 211 tensions reach runtime as zero; 68 ontology nodes reach runtime — 2.3% of the structured content — addressed by English display name because the prescribed header format has no id slot. Section 6's gate (line 240) says "verify node counts... (do not assume)" and node counts were verified, which is exactly why nobody noticed that node counts are the only thing that compiles.

On granularity: reading three unit analyses in full, the prose carries roughly 95, 150 and 102 discrete, separately-addressable, locus-bearing propositions in 2,186 / 2,749 / 2,432 words, against 7, 8 and 9 JSON readings. Ratio ~14.5x for readings, ~2.1x against all structured sub-items. Extrapolated: ~6,300 claim-level propositions already written into this entry's prose against 463 structured readings. Against source text the entry stores one claim record per 1,009 source words (463 readings / 1,038 pages), 17x coarser than the two entries the audit named as claim-level (Dissertation 1/58 words, Veri(dis)similitude 1/59 words). The 55 unit .md files are 137,928 words of claim-dense prose in which 17 of 55 units blew through the plan's own word bands (lines 198-199) upward, because the schema had nowhere to put what the analysts found and the prose did.
what_the_plan_actually_specifies:
A five-phase, agent-parallel cluster build for ~44 secondary-literature PDFs, written explicitly (line 6) so a cheaper model can execute Phases 0-4 with minimal judgment.

PHASE 0 (lines 183-191): pdftotext every PDF to a scratch dir (mandatory; agents get the .txt, never the PDF); apply the section 1B de-dup/haystack table (2 exact dups dropped, 1 proceedings dup dropped, 1 Yakobi merge, GazeMotive extracted from a 781pp proceedings); write phase0-overview.md and manifest.json carrying the section 1C unit table (id, slug, folder, author, year, title, pp, strand A-G, depth) plus themes, debate_axes, crossPipelineTargets, excluded/deduped.

PHASE 1 (lines 193-195): per-source metadata-only JSON headers — bib header, discipline, strand, <=60-word abstract paraphrase, section structure, expected constructs/measures/interlocutors, bridges-to-fcm and grounds-measure candidates, OCR confidence.

PHASE 2 (lines 197-208): one agent per unit, two-pass on books/long reviews. Three files per unit. (a) .md paraphrastic synthesis, humanities 1,500-3,500w / STEM 1,000-2,500w, no >=25-word verbatim, anchor phrases <=12 words plus page, with a fixed 7-section outline (header / Thesis / Structure / Constructs / Measures-or-Reading-of-FCM / Findings / Constructs-treated table / Analytical role). (b) .json mirroring the RDR2 shape: a named key list {id, slug, citation, discipline, strand, depth, thesis, sections, constructs, measures, readings, concepts, interlocutors, tensions, bridges{fcm, dataset_channels}, extraction{tool,date,ocr_confidence}}. (c) -edges.csv with columns source,relation,target,locus,note and hard edge floors map>=12, deep>=20, deep-long>=35, plus per-unit relation obligations (>=1 treats-construct always; >=1 operationalizes-measure for STEM; >=1 bridges-to-fcm for Strand A).

PHASE 3 (lines 210-221), authored by the orchestrator in-loop, not by subagents (line 254): 3A cluster-ontology.{md,json} with a compiler-parseable "## 3A. Canonical Node List" in FCM header format; 3B global-edges.csv (concat + dedup) and debate-map with 8-12 documented axes; 3C concept-matrix.csv and contested-readings.md; 3D the construct x measure concordance (the declared "primary-object anchor", 11 canonical construct rows and 12 canonical measure columns spelled out verbatim at lines 147-157) and a >=50-lemma terminology appendix; 3E citation-network, external-hub network, 5 Mermaid graphs, scholarly-evolution narrative.

PHASE 4 (lines 223-226): bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md pointing units at FCM units and dataset channels, pointers only, plus a cross-pipeline Mermaid graph hard-capped at 25 edges; all bridge edges tagged anticipatory-application.

PHASE 5 / section 6 (lines 228-243): add one dict entry to TEXT_DIRS in scripts/compile-corpus-index.py with ontology_format "header" and analysis_subdir "_synthesis"; run the compiler; verify node counts in compiled-index.json rather than assuming; re-run the verbatim detector; take timestamped .backups of the compiler and compiled-index; GATE G1 — show the TEXT_DIRS diff, compiled counts and one sample unit trio, and wait for user sign-off before committing.

ORCHESTRATION (lines 245-254): Agent tool not Workflow; budget 1 + 44 + 44 + ~6 agents; a stated reliability lesson that the pre/post-task hook no-ops ~1/8 subagents, mitigated by pre-extracting text, harvesting successes, self-authoring gaps, and verifying all three files exist per unit before synthesis; each deep agent receives the .txt path, its id/slug/strand/depth, the section 4 controlled vocabulary, the section 3 concordance axes, the edge floors and the bridge targets.

GATES (lines 256-265): eight checkbox clauses — trio presence for ~44 units; >=550 deduplicated global edges, 8-12 debates, 8-12 contested readings, >=50 lemmas, >=10 intra-cluster citations; concordance completeness (every construct row -> >=1 FCM node, every measure column -> >=1 dataset channel, every unit in >=1 cell); per-strand bridge obligations; no >=25-word verbatim plus provenance tags; 5 Mermaid graphs with the cross-pipeline one <=25 edges; parseable 3A and clean compile with verified counts; backups plus G1 sign-off.

A DEVIATION-RECORDING OBLIGATION is implied by manifest.planCorrections, which the executing agents used and populated with 7 entries.

defects.defect: The unit JSON is specified as a bag of parallel arrays. There is no record type in the entire plan — not in the section 4 controlled vocabulary (lines 165-167), not in the Phase 2 spec — that is defined as an addressable object with a stable id. The atom of the index is therefore the SOURCE, not the claim. The plan's object-type list includes READING/CLAIM (line 165) but only as an edge endpoint category, never as a record with identity, so nothing forces a claim to become a row.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/ — 463 readings across 55 units, of which 296 (63.9%) carry no id field at all; zero namespaced reading references (bor-sec-NN.C1 style) exist anywhere in the entry's 189 files; readings are referenced by no edge, no concordance cell, no ontology node, no debate axis. 1,038 source pages produce one claim record per 1,009 source words, versus 1 per 58 (Dissertation) and 1 per 59 (Veri(dis)similitude) in the two entries the audit identified as genuinely claim-level.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define ONE mandatory record type before any phase: a Claim record with fields {claim_id (globally unique, prefixed <entry-prefix>-<unit-nn>-C<nnn>), text, claim_type (enum), locus{page, page_end, section_id, sentence_index, char_start, char_end}, verbatim_span OR verbatim_hash, support_tier (enum), stance (enum), provenance_tag (enum), asserted_by (unit_id), supports[], supported_by[], contested_by[]}. State that the claim record, not the unit, is the unit of production, and that every other artifact addresses claims by claim_id.

defects.defect: The unit JSON spec names seven collection keys (sections, constructs, measures, readings, concepts, interlocutors, tensions) and gives a per-field schema for exactly one of them — measures, at line 205 ('populate measures[] richly (signal, apparatus, sample N, key result)'). For readings, concepts, interlocutors, tensions and sections the plan supplies a key name and nothing else. 55 independent agents therefore each invented a record shape.
defects.consequence_observed: Measured across the 55 unit JSONs: readings 8 incompatible shapes (257 x {claim,locus,stance,tag,type}; 167 x {id,locus,text}; 12 x {loci,summary,target_fcm_unit}; 8 x {claim,page,provenance}; plus 4 more); constructs 5 shapes (locus vs loci vs present); measures 7 shapes including a camelCase/snake_case split (45 x sampleN/keyResult vs 38 x sample_n/key_result); concepts 6 shapes including 87 bare strings; interlocutors 5 shapes including 146 bare strings; tensions 5 shapes including 46 bare strings; sections 6 shapes including 57 bare strings. Aggregate: 2,924 sub-items in 42 mutually incompatible shapes. No consumer can join them.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship the plan with a literal JSON Schema file per record type (claim, locus, edge, term, tension, actor) plus one worked exemplar record per type, and require every unit JSON to validate against it. Add a Phase-2 exit gate that runs the validator and refuses the unit on any validation error. Forbid bare strings in any array. Fix the case convention (snake_case) in the schema, not in prose.

defects.defect: The section 4 controlled vocabulary controls object types and edge relations but not FIELD VALUES. There is no enum for stance, support tier, treatment, role, or reuse disposition anywhere in the 287 lines. The provenance tag vocabulary at lines 31-35 (FE / FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> / P / anticipatory-application) is the only closed value set in the plan, and it is stated in prose rather than as a field constraint.
defects.consequence_observed: readings[].stance carries 162 distinct values across 463 records with 195 nulls — from clean tokens ('extends','contests','concedes') to free-text essays ('internal inconsistency (our observation of the source, not a claim it makes about itself)', 'concedes (disconfirms hypothesized direction; self-qualifies magnitude)'). 108 of the 162 values occur exactly once. readings[].type is 'READING/CLAIM' in 264 and null in 199. readings[].tag has 42 values with 201 nulls, and even the one closed vocabulary the plan DID state leaks: 'FAITHFUL-Elpidorou, p.4' and 'FAITHFUL-Darling, pp.6-9 (two direct FCM citations only; remainder is Being and Time)' smuggle loci into the tag field.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every typed field gets an explicit enum in the plan, with the complete allowed value list inline, plus a rule that any value not in the enum must be filed in a per-entry vocabulary-extension file with a one-line justification — never inlined. Split free-text commentary into a separate note field so the typed field stays joinable. Make null illegal on stance, support_tier and provenance_tag.

defects.defect: The plan specifies an id scheme for exactly one level — the unit (bor-sec-NN, zero-padded, slug = first-author surname). It specifies no id scheme, no prefix rule and no uniqueness scope for anything BELOW the unit. It also does not forbid agents from inventing one.
defects.consequence_observed: 9 of 55 agents invented sub-unit ids. bor-sec-02, -45, -46, -48, -49 and -53 all independently minted C1..C22; bor-sec-50 and -52 both minted F1..F8. 37 distinct id values collide, C1 through C9 colliding six ways. Because the ids are unprefixed, 'C1' is ambiguous across six units and cannot be dereferenced. The 46 units that did NOT invent ids left 296 readings permanently unaddressable. Separately, 4 agents (bor-sec-02, -46, -48, -53) reached for sub-unit addressing in the other direction and put section markers in the edge CSV source column, producing 119 global-edge rows whose subject is the string '§4', '§2', 'n.8' or 'Intro'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State the full id grammar for every level with a worked example: <prefix>-<unit>-C<nnn> for claims, -S<nnn> for sections, -T<nnn> for tensions, -Q<nnn> for quoted spans, and require every id to be globally unique across the whole corpus/index tree. Add a build-time uniqueness check across ALL entries, not just within one. Explicitly forbid unprefixed local counters.

defects.defect: The bridge relations are defined by naming the relation and describing the target in prose: 'grounds-measure -> a Boredom Experiment dataset channel; bridges-to-part-iii -> the dissertation'. No target id space is enumerated. Line 252-253 then instructs the orchestrator to give each deep agent 'the bridge targets (FCM unit list + dataset channel list)' — a dataset channel list the plan never provides anywhere in its 287 lines.
defects.consequence_observed: Perfect internal control. bridges-to-fcm, whose target ids ARE enumerated literally at line 24, resolves 68/68 (100%) to real fcm-* unit files. grounds-measure resolves 0/37 (0%): 37 edges point at 27 distinct free-text strings such as 'Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study) -- pupillometry channel', 'Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study): EEG channel', '****** UNVERIFIED: Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study)'. The target entry exists at corpus/index/Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study)/ with five stable ids bex-00-corpus-overview .. bex-04-stimulus-corpus, and not one edge names any of them. bridges-to-part-iii is worse: 128 edges, 122 distinct targets, 95% singletons.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: For every cross-entry relation, the plan must carry the literal target id list inline (as line 24 does for FCM), or a command that generates it, and must state that a bridge edge whose target is not in that list is invalid. Where the target entry does not yet exist, require a placeholder id from a declared reserved namespace (e.g. bex-TBD-eeg-fa) — never free text — so a later resolution pass is a mechanical id substitution.

defects.defect: Section 6 wires the entry into the compiler by adding one TEXT_DIRS entry with ontology_format 'header'. The plan assumes this makes the entry visible to the runtime. It does not. scripts/compile-corpus-index.py reads exactly two files per registered entry: the header/table ontology .md (collect_ontology_nodes, lines 1181-1230) and _synthesis/tension-edges.json (collect_tension_edges, lines 1253-1274). It never opens a unit .json, a -edges.csv, global-edges.csv, the concordance, the debate map, the citation network, the terminology appendix or the concept matrix. The gate at line 240 ('verify node counts in compiled-index.json (do not assume)') asks the executor to verify the one number that IS produced, which conceals that it is the only number produced.
defects.consequence_observed: Of the entry's content, 68 ontology nodes reach corpus/index/compiled-index.json — 2.3% of the 2,924 structured sub-items. 1,897 deduplicated edges reach runtime as ZERO. 91 concordance cells, 11 debate axes, 72 lemmas, 65 citation links, 463 readings, 211 tensions, 138 measures: all zero. The entry is simultaneously the largest single contributor of ontology nodes in the corpus (68 of 701) and one of the largest bodies of unreachable analysis on disk.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make reachability a first-class phase deliverable, not a wiring afterthought. The new plan must (a) state, per artifact it commissions, which compiler/runtime function will read it and on which line, (b) require that any artifact with no named reader is either not built or accompanied by the loader change that reads it, and (c) require a post-build reachability report: records_on_disk vs records_in_compiled_index per artifact, with a hard gate that no artifact may ship at 0% reachability.

defects.defect: The prescribed _synthesis folder layout enumerates 14 artifacts and does not include tension-edges.json — the one edge file the compiler actually ingests (collect_tension_edges, compile-corpus-index.py:1253-1274, reading node_a/node_b). The plan instead routes all disagreement content into debate-map.{md,json} and contested-readings.md, neither of which any parser in the repo opens.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/ has no tension-edges.json. compiled-index.json tensionEdges (64 total, from 7 other entries) contains zero rows from this entry, despite the entry holding 211 unit-level tensions, 11 fully documented debate axes with poles/status/resolution/live_objection, and 13 contested readings. This is the same failure that cost Uncomfortable 15, Wendt 12, In-Game 12 and Grammar 37 tension edges — but here the file was never even created, because the plan never named it.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Name every compiler-ingested file explicitly in the folder layout, with its exact filename and the exact key names the compiler expects (node_a, node_b, ...), quoting the parsing function and line. Add a gate: 'compiled-index.json tensionEdges count for this entry > 0'.

defects.defect: Section 3 specifies the concordance record as 'Each cell = the source(s) that treat that construct with that measure, with a page anchor and a one-line note. The .md renders as a matrix; the .json is {construct, measure, sources:[{id, locus, note}]}'. The section 8 gate for the concordance (line 260) checks only row/column/unit COVERAGE — every construct row maps to an FCM node, every measure column to a dataset channel, every unit appears in >=1 cell. It never checks the cell's internal schema.
defects.consequence_observed: _synthesis/boredom-construct-measure-concordance.json contains 91 cells, all of shape {construct, measure, units[], n}. The specified sources:[{id, locus, note}] is gone: 0 of 91 cells carry a locus, 0 carry a note. The plan's declared 'primary-object anchor' and 'the payoff' (line 141) is a bare presence matrix — to learn why bor-sec-30 sits in the (attentional disengagement x EEG alpha/theta) cell you must open and read a 2,749-word .md. The deviation is NOT recorded in manifest.planCorrections (all 7 corrections concern sources, authorship and the Strand-A/B contradiction), so it is silent drift on the plan's own highest-value artifact.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Any artifact the plan calls its anchor gets (a) a literal record schema, (b) a gate that validates the record schema and not merely the coverage, and (c) a required evidence pointer per cell — at claim level, cells must cite claim_ids, not unit_ids, so the cell IS the evidence rather than a pointer to prose.

defects.defect: All eight gate clauses measure EDGES, DEBATES, LEMMAS, CITATIONS, GRAPHS and FILE PRESENCE. Not one measures claims, readings, or any per-source extraction density. There is no floor on readings[], constructs[], measures[], or on claims-per-page. The only per-unit numeric floors in the plan (lines 206-207) are edge counts.
defects.consequence_observed: Readings per unit range 0 to 30 with no gate reaction. Three units ship ZERO readings and pass every gate: bor-sec-21-raffaelli (2,581w of analysis, 0 readings), bor-sec-29-miyauchi-kawasaki (1,302w, 0), bor-sec-40-jaques-predicting-affect (1,412w, 0). Two more ship 1 (bor-sec-25 at 3,439w, bor-sec-26 at 2,965w). Meanwhile bor-sec-52 ships 30. The entry averages 8.4 readings per source — one claim record per 2.24 source pages — and the gate list registers this as full compliance.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make claim density the primary gate and express it per unit of SOURCE, not per entry: minimum claims per source page (floor declared by document type), minimum claims per declared section, and a coverage gate (every section of the source has >=1 claim). Add a distribution gate that fails on outliers — no unit below X% of the entry median claims/page — so one under-extracted source cannot hide inside a healthy aggregate.

defects.defect: The word bands for the unit .md (humanities 1,500-3,500w, STEM 1,000-2,500w) are stated in the Phase 2 spec but appear in no gate in section 8, so nothing checks them.
defects.consequence_observed: 18 of 55 units violate the bands; 17 of the 18 overshoot. Strand C/D/E/F units run to 3,439w (bor-sec-25) and 3,219w (bor-sec-36) against a 2,500w cap; Strand G runs to 4,216w (bor-sec-52) against 3,500. None is recorded in planCorrections. The direction matters: analysts consistently wrote MORE prose than the band allowed because the JSON schema had nowhere to put what they found. The overshoot is the measurable signature of the granularity ceiling.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Either enforce prose caps with a gate, or — better for the claim-level target — delete prose word bands entirely and replace them with claim-record budgets. Prose length should be an OUTPUT of how many claims were extracted, not an independently specified quantity that competes with them.

defects.defect: The edge CSV is specified as 'columns source,relation,target,locus,note'. The plan names the columns and never says what may legally appear in source or target, nor that source must be a unit id, nor that locus must have a stated format.
defects.consequence_observed: 119 of 1,897 global-edge rows (6.3%) have a non-id subject: '§4' x27, '§2' x20, '§3' x17, '§1' x13, '§3.1' x8, '§3.3' x7, '§5' x6, '§3.2' x5, 'n.8' x4, 'Intro' x2, and 8 more — all from four units (bor-sec-53 x40, -46 x31, -48 x26, -02 x22). These are agents reaching for sub-unit subjects the plan did not give them. Separately, locus is unconstrained: 1,700 rows carry a page-shaped locus, 197 carry 'n/a' or a provenance tag ('P/anticipatory-application') in the locus column.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Specify the edge record as a typed object, not a CSV of unnamed strings: {edge_id, subject_id, relation (enum), object_id, locus (structured object), provenance_tag (enum), note}. Require subject_id and object_id to be resolvable ids from declared namespaces, and add a build-time referential-integrity check that fails the build on any unresolvable endpoint.

defects.defect: '3B global-edges.csv (concat + dedup all unit edges)' specifies neither the dedup key nor a reconciliation requirement. Nothing in the plan requires the aggregate to be reconciled against its inputs or the loss to be reported.
defects.consequence_observed: 1,918 rows exist across the 55 per-unit CSVs; global-edges.csv has 1,897. 18 distinct (source,relation,target,locus) tuples present in unit files are absent from the aggregate — e.g. bor-sec-12's bridges-to-fcm rows to fcm-05/06/07 and bor-sec-48's to fcm-03. Whether these are intentional dedup or silent loss is unrecoverable, because no reconciliation was required and none was recorded. This is the count-mismatch defect class (66 instances corpus-wide) reproduced in the best entry.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every derived aggregate must declare its derivation key, and every aggregation step must emit a reconciliation record: {inputs_n, outputs_n, dropped_n, drop_reason_histogram, dropped_ids[]}. Gate: dropped_n must equal the sum of the reason histogram, and any drop_reason of 'unknown' fails the build.

defects.defect: The quantitative core of the gate list is entirely cluster-aggregate: '>= 550 deduplicated global edges, 8-12 documented debates, 8-12 contested readings, >= 50 terminology lemmas, >= 10 intra-cluster citations'. Every one is a property of a MULTI-SOURCE cluster. There is no per-source equivalent for any of them.
defects.consequence_observed: At N=1 five of these clauses collapse. Intra-cluster citations are zero by construction (a single article cannot cite a cluster sibling); debates and contested readings require cross-source disagreement and go to zero or become author-invented; the 550-edge floor is meaningless against a single article's ~35 edges; two of the five required Mermaid graphs (citation-network, discipline-cluster) render empty. In this very entry debate-map.json already flags 3 of its 11 axes as constructedByCluster — assembled by the analyst rather than found in the sources — which is the N=1 failure mode showing up at N=55.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every gate must be expressed as a per-source predicate meaningful at N=1, with cluster-level gates listed separately and marked 'applies only when N>1; record SKIPPED-N1 otherwise'. Per-source substitutes: claims/page floor, section coverage, locus completeness, verbatim-verification rate, internal contradiction count, support-graph connectivity within the source.

defects.defect: Section 8 is a checklist inside the PLAN document. The plan never requires the entry to emit a machine-readable gate result. There is no instruction anywhere to write quality-gates-report.md or a metrics JSON into the entry directory.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/ has no quality-gates-report.md and no metrics file. The only gate evidence that survives is what the analyst volunteered inside boredom-construct-measure-concordance.json (rowToFcmGate, columnToChannelGate, unitCoverageGate as prose strings such as 'SATISFIED 55/55') and inside citation-network.json ('gate: 4'). That is author initiative, not plan compliance, and it is unparseable. Corpus-wide only 2 of 27 entries have a gates report and only 1 has machine-readable metrics.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require _audit/gates.json in every entry with one object per gate: {gate_id, statement, measured_value, threshold, verdict (PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED-N1), measured_by (the exact command), measured_at}. Require the measuring command to be reproducible from the repo, and make the final phase 'run the gate script and commit its output', not 'confirm the checkboxes'.

defects.defect: Per-strand bridge obligations are hard-coded to the strand letters the plan itself invented at Phase 0 ('Every Strand-A/B unit carries >=1 bridges-to-fcm edge; every Strand-D/E unit carries >=1 grounds-measure edge'). Strands C, F and G carry no relational obligation at all. The plan has no rule for what happens when the unit population changes shape during execution.
defects.consequence_observed: Strand G grew from 2 planned book units (lines 82-85, 'Treat each as one unit') to 11 per-chapter units (bor-sec-45..55) under user instruction. The gate list did not follow. 7 of the 11 Strand-G units (bor-sec-45, -46, -47, -49, -50, -52, -53) carry zero bridges-to-fcm and zero grounds-measure, and no gate notices — 20% of the entry with no relational floor whatsoever. Separately the same line contradicts line 208 (Strand A only), which the executing agent caught and recorded as planCorrection #7, correctly refusing to fabricate edges for bor-sec-15/17/19.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Express relational obligations as predicates over record PROPERTIES, not over hand-assigned group labels: 'any claim whose claim_type is interpretive must carry >=1 supports edge to a textually-confirmed claim'. If group labels are used, require the gate table to be regenerated from the manifest whenever the unit population changes, and add a gate that every unit is covered by at least one obligation.

defects.defect: phase0-overview.md is commissioned once at Phase 0 with a 'final unit count' and never designated a live artifact that must be reconciled at Phase 5. No gate in section 8 checks cross-artifact consistency between phase0-overview.md, manifest.json and disk.
defects.consequence_observed: _synthesis/phase0-overview.md still reads 'Final unit count: 46', '44 files map 1:1 to units', and 'Cluster total revised: 46 -> 45 units, pending a user decision on bor-sec-18'. manifest.json declares totalAnalyticalUnits: 55 and disk holds 55. The Hadjioannou 11-chapter expansion — the single largest scope change in the build — appears nowhere in phase0-overview.md (no 'Ch01', no 'per-chapter'). The document also still ends with 'Next step: Strand A (14 units)... Pausing here for go-ahead'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Declare exactly one authoritative count register (manifest.json) and require every other artifact to derive counts from it or state none. Add a cross-artifact consistency gate that greps every .md and .json in the entry for numeric claims about unit/record counts and fails on any that disagrees with the register. Require phase artifacts to be marked SUPERSEDED with a pointer rather than left stale.

defects.defect: 'The parser reads the ## 3A. Canonical Node List section in header format (#### N. Name + - **key**: value bullets) -- replicate FCM's book-level-ontology.md structure exactly.' The plan assumes the header text is taken literally. It is not: parse_header_ontology extracts parentheticals from the header into the aliases list, and build_canonical_terms then flattens every alias into the corpus-wide greedy-match canonicalTerms list. The plan gives no warning and imposes no constraint on node naming.
defects.consequence_observed: Node 32 '#### 32. Motivation model (gaze-based)' compiled as name 'Motivation model' with alias 'gaze-based'. The bare hyphenated adjective 'gaze-based' is now in corpus/index/compiled-index.json canonicalTerms (1,722 entries), a greedy-match list applied corpus-wide. Also entering the global list from this entry's nodes: the bare English words 'anyone' and 'publicness'. This is the identical failure mode that put 'technological' and 'control' into the global list from VR Pedagogy.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State the parser's actual transformation rules inline, with the function name and line, and forbid node names containing parentheticals, slashes or trailing qualifiers. Require every alias to be explicitly declared in a dedicated field rather than derived from the name. Add a gate: no canonicalTerm may be a common English word (stoplist check) or shorter than N characters, and print the full diff of terms this entry adds to the global list for sign-off at G1.

defects.defect: The prescribed ontology header format ('#### N. Name' + key/value bullets) has no id slot, and the plan does not add one. Nodes are therefore addressed by their English display string.
defects.consequence_observed: All 68 nodes in _synthesis/cluster-ontology.json lack an id field entirely; 508 node->unit back-references and every concordance row/column key are matched on display strings such as 'attentional disengagement / meta-awareness'. Renaming any node silently breaks every reference with no error. Already visible: the concordance uses 'EEG eyes-open vs eyes-closed' while the ontology uses 'EEG eyes-open versus eyes-closed baseline'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every node carries a stable id independent of its display name, and every reference uses the id. If the compiler's header format cannot express an id, the plan must either extend the parser (and show the diff) or route the canonical node list through a format that can — and must not commission a format it knows cannot hold the key.

defects.defect: The reliability mitigation is 'harvest successes + self-author any gaps, and verify all three files exist on disk for every unit before starting synthesis'. This authorizes the orchestrator to write a unit analysis it did not perform, and defines the completeness check as FILE EXISTENCE rather than content verification.
defects.consequence_observed: Every unit passes the presence check (55/55 trios verified) while content quality varies by an order of magnitude and is unmeasured: readings 0-30, measures 0-12, prose 1,302-4,216 words. Three units ship zero readings and are indistinguishable from complete under the plan's own completeness definition. There is also no record anywhere in the entry of which units were agent-authored and which were self-authored after a hook no-op, so provenance of the analysis itself is unrecoverable.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace file-existence completeness with content-predicate completeness (schema validation + density floors + locus completeness), record per-unit build provenance (agent id, model, retries, self-authored flag) in the manifest, and require an independent verification pass by a different agent for a sampled fraction of units, with the sample size and pass threshold stated in the plan.

defects.defect: Decision 4 authorizes deferral: 'If the dataset entry isn't built yet, leave dataset bridges as flagged ****** UNVERIFIED: pointers rather than blocking.' It creates no obligation to ever resolve them — no TODO register, no re-verification phase, no gate counting unresolved markers, no trigger tied to the target entry being built.
defects.consequence_observed: The Boredom Experiment (VR Attention Study) entry was built on 2026-07-16, two days after this cluster (2026-07-14/15), with five stable ids. As of today the cluster still carries 37 unresolved grounds-measure edges, 12 unresolved columnToDatasetChannel mappings whose status string still reads '****** UNVERIFIED: dataset entry not built', and 3 UNVERIFIED markers in bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md. The deferral became permanent because nothing was watching.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Deferrals must be first-class records: _audit/deferred.json with {deferral_id, what, blocking_dependency, resolution_procedure, created_at}, a gate that fails any entry whose deferrals reference a dependency that now exists, and a corpus-wide sweep step that resolves deferrals whenever a new entry lands.

defects.defect: 'no >=25-word verbatim -- all copyrighted; anchor-phrases <=12 words + page' is stated as a hard production rule and re-stated as a gate at line 262. It caps the stored evidence span at 12 words and caps the address at a page number. The plan offers no alternative mechanism (hash, offset, private cache, span pointer) for locating the exact clause.
defects.consequence_observed: Across all 189 files the finest locator that exists is a page or page range: 1,700 of 1,897 edges carry a page-shaped locus, 197 carry 'n/a'. Zero sentence indices, zero character offsets, zero bounding boxes — a full-tree scan for offset/char-span/sentence tokens returns nothing but incidental prose uses of 'line'. This is the same suppression policy the audit flagged at In-Game ig-10-deep.json:434-441 and Uncomfortable us-03-radcliffe.json:110,:234, and it is in direct tension with the stated goal of indexing every clause.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Separate the ADDRESS from the TEXT. Require every claim to carry a machine-verifiable address (page + sentence_index + char_start/char_end into a deterministically reproducible extraction, plus the extraction command and a text hash) even when the verbatim itself is withheld. Store the recipe, not the text, so the clause is re-fetchable on demand. That satisfies both the copyright discipline and the clause-level goal.

defects.defect: The only per-unit numeric obligations are raw edge counts keyed to a three-bucket page-length rubric (map>=12, deep>=20, deep-long>=35). Raw edge count measures effort, not coverage: it cannot detect that a unit covered 8 of a source's 60 claims, nor that the edges cluster in one section.
defects.consequence_observed: 0 edge-floor violations across all 55 units — the gate passed perfectly — while the same 55 units yielded 8.4 claim records each against sources averaging 18.9 pages. bor-sec-21-raffaelli (a review of 'knowns and unknowns') carries 34 edges and 0 readings. bor-sec-25-elpidorou-guiding-mind carries 38 edges, 3,439 words of analysis and 1 reading. The floor is satisfiable without extracting a single claim.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace count floors with coverage floors computed against a declared denominator: claims per source page, sections-with-at-least-one-claim / total sections, pages-with-at-least-one-locus / total pages. Publish the denominator (the source's section/page inventory) as a Phase-1 artifact so coverage is computable rather than asserted.

defects.defect: Section 1C requires the manifest to record id, slug, folder, author, year, title, pp, strand and depth per unit, but section 8 contains no gate on manifest field completeness.
defects.consequence_observed: 6 of 55 manifest unit records have year: null (bor-sec-11, -34, -35, -36, -37, -39). bor-sec-11 additionally still carries an '(author verification needed)' marker noted in phase0-overview.md and never cleared. Nothing failed. Also planCorrection #6 records that bor-sec-44's on-disk folder name is still the wrong 'Nacke & Craig - ...' with the rename 'deferred to GATE G1' — a deferral never executed.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every field the plan asks for gets a completeness gate with an explicit null policy: which fields may be null, and when null, which sentinel and which deferral record must accompany it. Add a gate that no unit record may carry an unresolved verification marker at ship time.

defects.defect: The depth rubric buckets sources by page count (map <=10pp / deep / deep-long monograph) and attaches only edge-count consequences to the bucket. Nothing in the rubric governs how many claims a source of a given type should yield, and nothing distinguishes a 3-page commentary from a 53-page methodological review beyond an edge floor.
defects.consequence_observed: Holmqvist (53pp, reclassified deep-long per planCorrection #4) yields 47 edges and 10 readings — 0.19 readings per page. Aho (3pp, map) yields 15 edges and 5 readings — 1.67 readings per page, nearly 9x the density. The rubric produced an inverse relationship between source length and extraction density, the opposite of what a per-page claim index needs.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make the rubric govern record BUDGETS per structural unit of the source (claims per section, per page, per table, per figure), not per document. State the expected claims-per-page band by document type up front so an executing agent can self-check, and make the band a gate.

defects.defect: '~44 units, each with .md + .json + -edges.csv present on disk (no silent gaps)'. The tilde makes the gate unfalsifiable, and 'no silent gaps' is not operationalized.
defects.consequence_observed: The entry shipped 55 units — 25% above the planned 44 — and passed. The gate could not have failed at 40 or at 60. It also cannot detect the one genuine gap that exists: units/bor-sec-00-corpus-overview.md, required by lines 105 and 138, was never created; units/ is an empty directory.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State exact expected counts derived from the manifest, not approximations, and make the manifest the sole source of the expected set: 'for every id in manifest.units, all N required files exist and validate' plus 'no file on disk matching the unit pattern is absent from manifest.units'. Both directions, exact.

defects.defect: The plan requires an overview unit (bor-sec-00-corpus-overview, emitted as units/bor-sec-00-corpus-overview.md, repeated in the folder layout at line 138) and then never gates it, never references it from any other artifact, and never assigns it content requirements.
defects.consequence_observed: units/ is an empty directory. bor-sec-00 appears nowhere in manifest.json. This is the ONLY plan instruction the otherwise-excellent planCorrections discipline missed — all 7 recorded corrections concern sources, authorship and the strand contradiction. It is therefore the cleanest demonstration that a deviation-recording culture catches what agents notice, and a gate catches what they do not.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every artifact the plan commissions appears in a machine-checkable required-artifacts manifest, and the final gate iterates that manifest. Deviation recording is a complement to gates, never a substitute: require both, and make the gate script the thing that decides done.

defects.defect: 'Take a timestamped backup of compile-corpus-index.py and compiled-index.json into .backups/ before editing.' Restated at line 265. Never verified by anything.
defects.consequence_observed: The entry's .backups/ contains 9 files — global-edges.csv, manifest.json, boredom-scholarly-evolution.md and six unit files — all snapshots of the entry's own artifacts during later revision passes. Neither compile-corpus-index.py nor compiled-index.json is backed up there. Whether the section-6 backup was taken elsewhere is unrecoverable.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Name the exact backup paths and require the gate script to assert their existence and their timestamp ordering relative to the edit. If a backup cannot be asserted, the build does not ship.

defects.defect: The orchestration budget is one agent per unit for Phase 2 and (line 254) 'Author the synthesis layer (ontology, debate-map, concordance, evolution) yourself, not via subagents'. At ~7 records per source and ~2,900 sub-items total this is feasible. It does not scale.
defects.consequence_observed: The synthesis layer is 23 files including a 49KB cluster-ontology.json, a 552KB global-edges.csv and a 30KB concordance, all hand-authored in one context. At claim level (50-500 records per source x 55 sources = 2,750-27,500 claims, each with edges) the same instruction requires hand-authoring an aggregate two orders of magnitude larger. Strain is already visible: the concordance's specified per-cell locus/note was dropped and 18 edge tuples went missing in the concat step.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Synthesis must be DERIVED, not authored: specify the aggregation as a script over validated per-unit records, committed alongside its output, so global-edges/concordance/concept-matrix/citation-network are regenerable and reconcilable. Reserve agent authorship for interpretive layers (debate framing, contested readings) and require those to cite derived record ids.

defects.defect: Section 1B asserts as fact that 'Predicting Affect from Gaze Data....pdf' IS 'the single extracted paper' and instructs 'Analyze the single-paper file only'. The plan asserted a file property it had not verified.
defects.consequence_observed: Recorded as planCorrection #2: pdfinfo shows 727 pages and md5 shows it byte-identical to the full ITS-2014 proceedings. The executing agent had to invent and execute a page-boundary search (awk RS='\f') to locate pp.55-64 and re-extract. The correction was recorded properly — the mechanism worked — but the plan cost a full investigative detour on an unverified premise.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Any factual assertion about a source file (page count, identity, uniqueness, authorship, year) must carry the verification command and its output inline in the plan, or be marked UNVERIFIED with the verification step assigned to Phase 0.

defects.defect: The section 1A strand tables are the plan's authoritative source inventory, assembled without per-file verification. Three errors: 'Standish Can Boredom Educate Us? (2015)' names a paper that does not exist (the real paper is Mansikka 2008) and whose on-disk PDF is a mislabeled duplicate of Mertel 2020; 'Lindley & Nacke' reverses the author order (Nacke is first author; the filename's 'Craig' is Lindley's given name); and two on-disk files (Elpidorou, The Bored Mind is a Guiding Mind 2018; Elpidorou, The Good of Boredom 2018) are omitted entirely.
defects.consequence_observed: planCorrections #1, #3, #5 and #6. The two omitted files turned out to be the primary in-cluster grounding for the plan's OWN section 4 debate axis (boredom-as-deficit vs functional/adaptive) and its OWN section 3 construct row (boredom-as-regulatory-signal), which would otherwise have had no dedicated source — a hole in the plan's designed anchor caused by an unverified inventory. The Standish error consumed a full unit slot and a build-abort/restore cycle (46 -> 45 -> 46 units).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Phase 0 must begin by deriving the source inventory FROM DISK (md5, pdfinfo, first-page text extraction of title/author/year/journal), never from a hand-written table, and must diff the derived inventory against any plan-supplied list, reporting extras and phantoms as blocking findings before any unit is assigned.

defects.defect: 'Six strands.' followed immediately by seven strand headings A through G (lines 43-85).
defects.consequence_observed: phase0-overview.md had to note it explicitly: 'header says "six strands" but lists seven letters A-G; 46 units genuinely span 7 groups'. Harmless here only because the executing agent read carefully.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Any count stated in prose must be derivable from the enumeration it introduces; prefer generating such counts rather than typing them. Add a self-consistency read of the plan itself as a pre-execution step.

unspecified_gaps: What a claim record IS. The plan names READING/CLAIM as an object type (line 165) and readings[] as a JSON key (line 204) and never defines the record. 55 agents invented 8 shapes; 296 of 463 readings ended with no id.
The value space for stance. Never mentioned in the plan. Result: 162 distinct values, 195 nulls, 108 hapax values.
The value space for type on a reading. Never mentioned. Result: 'READING/CLAIM' in 264 records, null in 199.

Whether sub-unit records may have ids, and if so what the id grammar is. Result: 9 units invented C1..C22 / F1..F8; 37 values collide across up to 6 units; 46 units invented nothing and left 296 readings unaddressable.
What may appear in the edge CSV's source and target columns. Result: 119 rows carry section markers ('§4', 'n.8', 'Intro') as edge subjects.
The format of locus. Result: page-shaped in 1,700 rows, 'n/a' or a provenance tag in 197.
The target id list for grounds-measure and bridges-to-part-iii. Result: 27 and 122 distinct free-text targets respectively; 0% resolution against the bex-* ids that exist on disk.
The dedup key for global-edges.csv and whether losses must be reported. Result: 18 tuples silently absent from the aggregate.

Which files the compiler actually reads. The plan wires TEXT_DIRS and assumes reach. Result: 97.7% of structured content unreachable, and tension-edges.json — the one edge file the compiler ingests — never even named in the folder layout.
The parser's alias-extraction behaviour on parenthetical node names. Result: 'gaze-based' injected into the 1,722-term corpus-wide greedy-match list, alongside 'anyone' and 'publicness'.
Whether ontology nodes need ids. Result: 68 nodes addressed by English display string; 508 back-references keyed on strings that already disagree across artifacts.
Whether phase artifacts must be reconciled at completion. Result: phase0-overview.md permanently declares 46 units against a manifest of 55 and never mentions the 11-chapter Hadjioannou expansion.
How gates are to be evidenced. Result: no gates artifact; gate outcomes survive only as prose strings inside the concordance and citation-network JSONs.

What happens to a deferred bridge once its blocker clears. Result: 37 grounds-measure edges and 12 channel mappings still say 'not built' 13 days after the target entry was built; a deferred folder rename was never executed.
Whether readings/constructs/measures have floors. Result: 3 units ship 0 readings, 2 more ship 1, and all pass every gate.

Whether negative claims ('source does not treat construct X', 'source does not operationalize measure Y') are records. They exist in every unit .md as explicit 'Not treated' prose — bor-sec-30 lists 8 explicitly-absent measures, bor-sec-13 lists 3 absent constructs — and appear in NO JSON array. A machine-checkable class of claim is written and then discarded.

Whether the analysis prose itself is a source to be indexed. 137,928 words of unit analysis carrying ~6,300 discrete locus-bearing propositions is treated as narrative output, not as indexable content.
Which unit was built by which agent, at what cost, with how many retries, and whether it was self-authored after a hook no-op (line 250 authorizes this). No build provenance is recorded anywhere.

Whether page-number loci must be verified against the source's own printed pagination. bor-sec-30's loci are all prefixed '~p.' and its .md states pagination is 'reconstructed... and is approximate'. No plan step requires resolution.

Whether an entry may be revised after G1, and what re-gates on revision. Six .backups timestamped 2026-07-14 21:19 sit after the 18:xx main build, evidencing an unlogged post-hoc revision pass with no correction record.
design_inputs: Make the CLAIM the unit of production, not the source. Specify the record before any phase: {claim_id, unit_id, text, claim_type, stance, support_tier, provenance_tag, locus{page, page_end, section_id, sentence_index, char_start, char_end}, verbatim_hash, supports[], supported_by[], contested_by[], volatility}. State explicitly that a source is a container of claims and that the deliverable count is claims, not files. Evidence: the Dissertation entry (982 claims, 100% line-anchored, 8-tier taxonomy, 76% in a supports graph, 841 typed edges) and Veri(dis)similitude (157 rows, stable ids, tier, closed-vocabulary disposition, RODA enum anchors) already prove this schema works in this repo; Boredom Secondary at 8.4 readings per source is 17x coarser measured against source text (1 per 1,009 source words vs 1 per 58-59).

Set the density target numerically and gate it per source, not per cluster. Target one claim record per 60-120 source words for close-read sources, expressed as a claims-per-page floor by document type, with a distribution gate (no unit below 50% of the entry median claims/page). Evidence: Boredom Secondary passed every gate at one claim per 2.24 source pages, with three units at ZERO readings (bor-sec-21 at 2,581 words of analysis, bor-sec-29, bor-sec-40) and two at one (bor-sec-25 at 3,439 words, bor-sec-26 at 2,965).

Ship a literal JSON Schema file per record type with the plan, plus one fully-worked exemplar record per type, and gate every produced file through the validator at phase exit. Evidence: naming keys without schemas (line 204) produced 42 mutually incompatible shapes across 2,924 sub-items, including a camelCase/snake_case split inside a single field set (sampleN/keyResult x45 vs sample_n/key_result x38).

Close every typed field with an explicit inline enum, forbid null on stance/support_tier/provenance_tag, and route all free-text nuance into a separate note field. Provide a vocabulary-extension procedure (a per-entry file with justification) so agents have a legal channel other than inventing a value. Evidence: 162 stance values with 195 nulls and 108 hapaxes; even the plan's one closed vocabulary (FE/FAITHFUL/P) leaked loci into the tag field ('FAITHFUL-Elpidorou, p.4').

Specify the full id grammar at every level with worked examples, require global uniqueness across the entire corpus/index tree, and add a build-time cross-entry uniqueness check. Evidence: unprefixed C1..C22 collide across bor-sec-02/45/46/48/49/53 and F1..F8 across bor-sec-50/52; 46 of 55 units produced no ids at all.

Enumerate the literal target id list for EVERY cross-entry relation inline in the plan, exactly as line 24 does for fcm-04..fcm-07, or give the command that generates it. Where the target entry is unbuilt, mandate reserved placeholder ids from a declared namespace (bex-TBD-eeg-fa) rather than free text. Evidence: enumerated targets resolve 68/68 (100%); unenumerated grounds-measure resolves 0/37 across 27 distinct strings while bex-00..bex-04 exist on disk; bridges-to-part-iii resolves 0/128 across 122 strings.

State, for every artifact the plan commissions, which loader function reads it and at which line of which file — and refuse to commission any artifact with no named reader unless the plan also carries the loader change. Evidence: scripts/compile-corpus-index.py reads only the ontology .md (collect_ontology_nodes:1181-1230) and _synthesis/tension-edges.json (collect_tension_edges:1253-1274); 1,897 edges, 91 concordance cells, 11 debate axes, 463 readings and 211 tensions reach runtime as zero, while 68 ontology nodes (2.3%) reach it.

Name tension-edges.json explicitly in the folder layout with its exact compiler-required keys (node_a/node_b), quoting the parser. Gate: compiled-index.json tensionEdges count for this entry > 0. Evidence: the plan's layout (lines 119-132) omits it entirely; the entry has 211 tensions and 11 documented debate axes and contributes 0 of the corpus's 64 tension edges — the same failure that cost Uncomfortable 15, Wendt 12, In-Game 12 and Grammar 37.

Require a reachability report as a shipping artifact: per commissioned artifact, records_on_disk vs records_in_compiled_index vs percent. Hard gate: no artifact ships at 0% reachability without an explicit signed waiver naming the future loader. Evidence: the plan's compiler gate (line 240, 'verify node counts... do not assume') was satisfied and concealed that node count is the only quantity that compiles.

Give claims a machine-verifiable address even when the verbatim is withheld: page + sentence_index + char_start/char_end into a deterministically reproducible extraction, plus the extraction command and a text hash. Store the recipe, not the text, so the clause is re-fetchable on demand. Evidence: the <=12-word anchor rule (line 199) plus page-only loci means the finest address anywhere in 189 files is a page; a full-tree scan finds zero sentence indices, zero char offsets, zero bboxes; 1,700 of 1,897 edges are page-anchored and 197 carry 'n/a'.

Require a per-source structural inventory as a Phase-1 artifact (section list with page ranges, table/figure list, page count, extraction command and hash) so coverage is COMPUTABLE. Then gate coverage, not effort: sections-with-claims / total sections, pages-with-claims / total pages. Evidence: edge floors (12/20/35) passed 55/55 while Holmqvist (53pp) yielded 0.19 readings/page against Aho (3pp) at 1.67 — an inverse density relation no count floor can see.

Make negative claims a first-class record type. Every 'source X does not treat construct Y' / 'does not operationalize measure Z' assertion becomes a typed record with a locus scope. Evidence: bor-sec-30's .md explicitly lists 8 measures NOT treated and bor-sec-13 lists 3 constructs NOT treated; none appear in any JSON array, discarding a machine-checkable claim class the analysts already produced.

Express every gate as a per-source predicate meaningful at N=1, and mark cluster-scale gates 'applies only when N>1; record SKIPPED-N1 otherwise'. Evidence: of the 5 quantitative clauses at line 259, intra-cluster citations are 0 by construction at N=1, debates and contested readings go to 0 or become author-invented (debate-map.json already flags 3 of 11 axes as constructedByCluster at N=55), the 550-edge floor is meaningless against one article's ~35 edges, and 2 of the 5 required Mermaid graphs render empty.

Require _audit/gates.json in every entry: one object per gate with {gate_id, statement, measured_value, threshold, verdict, measured_by (exact reproducible command), measured_at}. Make the final phase 'run the gate script and commit its output', not 'confirm the checkboxes'. Evidence: section 8 lives only in the plan; the entry has no gates report and only volunteered prose gate strings inside two JSONs; corpus-wide only 2 of 27 entries have a gates report.

PRESERVE and formalize manifest.planCorrections. Require every deviation from the plan to be recorded with {issue, files, evidence[] (verification commands and outputs), resolution, residual}, and require the executing agent to record contradictions IN THE PLAN ITSELF without editing the plan. Evidence: 7 recorded corrections including #7, which caught line 208 (Strand A) contradicting line 261 (Strand A/B) and correctly refused to fabricate bridges-to-fcm edges for bor-sec-15/17/19, documenting per-source citation evidence for each refusal. Pair it with gates: it caught 7 real deviations and missed the one nobody looked for (bor-sec-00, units/ empty).

Derive the source inventory from disk in Phase 0 (md5, pdfinfo, first-page title/author/year extraction) and diff it against any plan-supplied list, reporting phantoms and extras as blocking. Evidence: three section-1A inventory errors — a nonexistent 'Standish 2015' whose PDF was a mislabeled Mertel duplicate (cost a build-abort cycle 46->45->46), a reversed 'Lindley & Nacke' byline, and two omitted Elpidorou 2018 files that were the sole in-cluster grounding for the plan's own debate axis and construct row.

Require every factual assertion the plan makes about a file (page count, identity, uniqueness, authorship, year) to carry its verification command and output inline, or be marked UNVERIFIED and assigned to Phase 0. Evidence: line 92 asserts a 727-page proceedings volume is 'the single extracted paper', costing an unplanned page-boundary investigation.

Derive synthesis artifacts by committed script over validated per-unit records rather than hand-authoring them, and emit a reconciliation record for every aggregation: {inputs_n, outputs_n, dropped_n, drop_reason_histogram, dropped_ids[]}, gated so 'unknown' drop reasons fail the build. Evidence: 1,918 unit rows -> 1,897 global rows with 18 tuples unaccounted; the concordance's specified sources:[{id, locus, note}] silently became {units[], n} with 0/91 cells carrying evidence; line 254 tells the orchestrator to hand-author all of it.

Give every ontology/canonical node a stable id independent of its display string, and reference nodes by id everywhere. If the target parser format cannot hold an id, extend the parser in the same plan and show the diff. Evidence: all 68 nodes lack an id field; 508 node->unit back-references and every concordance row/column key match on English strings, which already disagree ('EEG eyes-open vs eyes-closed' in the concordance vs 'EEG eyes-open versus eyes-closed baseline' in the ontology).

State the parser's actual name/alias transformation and constrain node naming accordingly: no parentheticals, slashes or trailing qualifiers in node names; aliases declared explicitly, never derived. Gate the diff of terms this entry adds to the global canonicalTerms list and require sign-off on it. Evidence: '#### 32. Motivation model (gaze-based)' compiled to name 'Motivation model' + alias 'gaze-based', putting a bare hyphenated adjective into the 1,722-term corpus-wide greedy-match list alongside 'anyone' and 'publicness' — the same mechanism that put 'technological' and 'control' there from VR Pedagogy.

Declare one authoritative count register (manifest.json) and gate cross-artifact numeric consistency: scan every .md/.json in the entry for count claims and fail on disagreement; require superseded phase artifacts to be marked SUPERSEDED with a pointer. Evidence: phase0-overview.md permanently declares 'Final unit count: 46' and 'revised: 46 -> 45' against a manifest of 55, never mentions the 11-chapter Hadjioannou expansion, and still closes with 'Pausing here for go-ahead'.

Make deferrals first-class: _audit/deferred.json with {deferral_id, what, blocking_dependency, resolution_procedure, created_at}, a gate that fails when a blocker now exists, and a corpus-wide sweep whenever a new entry lands. Evidence: line 274-275 authorized deferral with no obligation; the Boredom Experiment entry was built 2026-07-16 and 37 grounds-measure edges plus 12 channel mappings still read 'dataset entry not built', and planCorrection #6's folder rename 'deferred to GATE G1' was never executed.

Replace file-existence completeness with content-predicate completeness, and record per-unit build provenance (agent id, model, retries, self-authored yes/no) in the manifest. Require an independent second-reader verification pass on a stated sample fraction with a stated pass threshold. Evidence: line 250 authorizes the orchestrator to 'self-author any gaps' and line 251 defines completeness as 'verify all three files exist'; 55/55 trios exist while readings range 0-30 and no record survives of which units were agent-built.

Budget claim-level extraction explicitly in the orchestration section and choose an architecture that survives it: at 50-500 claims per source x ~55 sources the aggregate is 2,750-27,500 claims with edges, versus the 1,897 edges and 552KB single CSV this plan produced. Specify sharded per-unit storage, a derived index, and a streaming aggregation step — not one hand-authored global CSV. Evidence: global-edges.csv is already 552KB at 1,897 rows and its concat step already lost 18 tuples.

Delete prose word bands and replace them with claim-record budgets, or gate the bands. Prose length must be an output of extraction, not a competing target. Evidence: bands at lines 198-199 appear in no gate; 18 of 55 units violate them and 17 of the 18 overshoot (bor-sec-52 at 4,216w against a 3,500 cap, bor-sec-25 at 3,439w against 2,500) — the measurable signature of analysts putting into prose what the schema could not hold.

Index the analysis prose itself. The 55 unit .md files contain ~6,300 discrete, locus-bearing propositions against 463 structured readings — a 13.6x ratio, measured by full reads of bor-sec-13 (~95 propositions in 2,186w vs 7 readings), bor-sec-30 (~150 in 2,749w vs 8) and bor-sec-16 (~102 in 2,432w vs 9). A new plan should either (a) require the prose to be authored AS claim records so the .md is a rendering of the records, or (b) commission a back-extraction pass over existing unit .md files. Option (a) is strictly better: it removes the prose/schema competition that caused the overshoot in the first place.

Preserve the plan's genuinely load-bearing wins verbatim: mandatory pdftotext-to-scratch with .txt paths handed to agents (lines 184-186), the de-duplication/haystack disposition table with md5 evidence (lines 89-97), canonical axis labels declared literally in the plan so all downstream artifacts agree (lines 147-157, which is why concept-matrix.csv and cluster-ontology share one registry and this entry has none of the double-registry defect that hit Uncomfortable), the provenance tag discipline FE/FAITHFUL/P/anticipatory-application (lines 31-35), the no-fabrication norm that produced planCorrection #7, the explicit 'bridge, never duplicate' anchor rule (lines 19-29), the G1 human sign-off gate (line 242), and the pre-edit backup requirement (line 243) — this time with an assertion that verifies it.
what_to_preserve: manifest.planCorrections. Seven recorded deviations, each with issue / files / evidence array (verification commands and their outputs) / resolution / residual. Correction #7 caught the plan contradicting ITSELF (line 208 Strand-A vs line 261 Strand-A/B), resolved in favour of the more specific rule, refused to fabricate three edges, cited per-source evidence for each refusal, and explicitly declined to edit the plan document so the contradiction would remain visible. Nothing else in the 27-entry corpus comes close. Make this a required artifact with a fixed schema.

The no-fabrication norm and its escalation path. The bor-sec-18 agent refused to build a unit under a false attribution when its assigned PDF turned out to be a mislabeled Mertel duplicate, escalated instead, and the user supplied the genuine Mansikka PDF. Recorded across phase0-overview.md, manifest.excluded and planCorrections #3/#5 with pdfinfo metadata and a full-text diff as evidence. A claim-level plan must keep 'refuse and escalate' as an explicitly sanctioned agent outcome.

Enumerating cross-entry target ids literally in the plan (line 24: fcm-04-first-form, fcm-05-second-form, fcm-06-third-form, fcm-07-particular-profound). 68/68 bridges-to-fcm resolve. Do this for every relation.

Declaring the canonical axis vocabularies verbatim in the plan (lines 147-157: 11 construct rows and 12 measure columns, spelled out). This is why concept-matrix.csv, cluster-ontology, the concordance and the unit JSONs all speak one construct vocabulary and this entry has none of the double-registry defect that hit Uncomfortable Situations. Any new plan must declare its closed vocabularies inline, not by reference.

Mandatory pdftotext pre-extraction to a scratch dir with .txt paths handed to agents (lines 184-186), for cost, for the multi-page-image API failure, and for reproducibility. Also the OCR-LOW near-empty-extraction check, which was run and recorded (manifest.ocrAudit).

The de-duplication and haystack disposition table with md5 evidence (lines 89-97) and its persistence into manifest.excluded (8 dispositions, each with md5 and reason). Genuinely good source hygiene; it produced two real salvages (GazeMotive pp.564-568; Jaques et al. pp.55-64).
