what_the_plan_actually_specifies:
THE CANONICAL SPEC (plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md, 238 lines) is a fill-in-the-parameters, Sonnet-executable prose pipeline. It is not code; there is no programmatic generator for any artifact it names anywhere in scripts/ or src/.

Structure: §P parameters (SOURCE_DIR, CLUSTER_NAME, PREFIX, PURPOSE, ANCHORS, ANCHOR_EDGE_NAMES, CONCORDANCE_HINT) are the only hand-authored part; everything else is declared invariant procedure. §0 sets anchor discipline (bridge, never duplicate), a three-value provenance vocabulary (FE / FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> / P·anticipatory-application), and a blanket copyright rule: "No >=25-word verbatim quotation anywhere" with "anchor-phrases <=12 words with a page number" permitted (:44-45).

Phase -1 (survey, :49-103) has the executing model author its own cluster spec: pdfinfo/md5sum/pdftotext inventory; a de-duplication and "haystack" rubric (:57-67); clustering into 4-8 strands (:68-70); an authoritative unit table with slug/folder/depth conventions and a depth rubric deep / deep-long / map (:72-79); derivation of a two-axis "primary-object concordance" of <=15 row labels x <=15 column labels which becomes frozen vocabulary (:81-88); a controlled vocabulary of <=12 object types plus a named edge-relation set (:90-98); and 6-10 debate-axis seeds targeting "8-12 documented" by Phase 3. Phase -1 ends at GATE G0: present the spec, wait for user sign-off (:102-103).

§2 (:107-133) fixes the folder layout: `_synthesis/` holding manifest.json, phase0-overview.md, cluster-ontology.{md,json}, global-edges.csv, debate-map.{md,json}, concept-matrix.csv, contested-readings.md, citation-network.{md,json}, <topic>-concordance.{md,json}, <topic>-secondary-literature-network.{md,json}, <topic>-terminology-appendix.{md,json}, <topic>-scholarly-evolution.md and five .mmd graphs; `bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md`; one folder per unit holding a .md/.json/-edges.csv trio; and `units/<PREFIX>00-corpus-overview.md`.

§5 (:135-185) is the five-phase executable core. Phase 0: mandatory pdftotext of every source to the scratchpad (agents get the .txt path, never the PDF), apply de-dup, write phase0-overview.md and manifest.json with a named key list (:143-146). Phase 1: per-unit metadata JSON, header fields only. Phase 2: one agent per unit emitting the trio — a paraphrastic .md with a prescribed section skeleton and word bands (humanities 1,500-3,500w, empirical 1,000-2,500w, map 400-1,000w), a .json given as a flat key LIST (:159-161), and an edges CSV with columns `source,relation,target,locus,note` and edge floors map >=12 / deep >=20 / deep-long >=35 (:162-165). Phase 3 (authored by the main loop, not subagents, :167): 3A cluster-ontology whose .md MUST carry a `## 3A. Canonical Node List` in header format `#### N. Name` + `- **key**: value` bullets "because the compiler parses this section" (:168-172); 3B global-edges + 8-12 documented debates; 3C concept-matrix + contested-readings; 3D the concordance grid + a terminology appendix of >=50 lemmas; 3E citation-network + external hubs + 5 Mermaid graphs + a scholarly-evolution arc. Phase 4: bridge pointers only, cross-pipeline graph hard-capped at <=25 edges.

§6 (:187-201) is registration: back up scripts/compile-corpus-index.py and compiled-index.json, hand-add one dict entry to TEXT_DIRS, run the compiler, "verify the new entry's node/term counts in compiled-index.json by reading them", "re-run the repo's verbatim-quote detector", then GATE G1 — show the TEXT_DIRS diff, the compiled counts, and ONE full sample unit trio, and wait for user sign-off before committing.

§7 (:203-214) is orchestration: Agent tool not Workflow; budget 1 + N + N agents plus main-loop synthesis; an explicit reliability note that pre/post-task hooks no-op a subagent ~1/8, mitigated by pre-extracting to .txt and "verify all three files exist on disk for every unit"; deviations recorded in manifest.json -> planCorrections.

§8 (:216-229) is the quality-gate checklist, thresholds declared to "scale with N": N complete trios; >=12*N deduplicated global edges; 8-12 documented debates; 8-12 contested readings; >=50 terminology lemmas; >=max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations; concordance completeness with a `****** UNVERIFIED:` escape; per-strand bridge-edge requirements; no >=25-word verbatim with provenance tags throughout; 5 Mermaid graphs render and the cross-pipeline graph <=25 edges; a parseable `## 3A` section, "compiler runs clean", counts verified by reading, "verbatim detector clean"; backups taken and G0/G1 sign-offs obtained with no commit before G1.

THE DERIVED AND SIBLING PLANS follow the same shape with per-entry numbers: boredom-secondary (>=550 edges @ ~44 units, :259), vr-pedagogy (23 trios and >=276 edges hardcoded at plan time, :215-216), in-game (>=260 edges, 10-14 tensions, >=50 games, >=180 bibliography, >=120 lemmas, :305-321), grammar-of-motives (>=350 edges, 14-18 tensions, >=250 lemmas, :373-390), uncomfortable (>=160 edges, >=8 tension entries, a 10-locus offset spot-check, a >=30-consecutive-word verbatim scan, :256-262), wendt (>=120 edges, >=60 lemmas, double locus `(p.NN / pdf NN)` on every citation, "registered in compiled-index.json", :131-133). Two older cluster plans (rdr2-secondary :73, phantasia :178) name cluster-ontology.{md,json} but never mention the compiler, TEXT_DIRS, the header node-list format, or any registration step at all.

THE ONE OUTLIER is tmp/Dissertation/DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md, which alone specifies a literal per-record JSONC schema with location {line_start,line_end}, an 8-tier support taxonomy with a remediation action per tier (:333-341), a granularity rule ("a claim is a discrete proposition that could plausibly be true or false"), per-section claim volume bands with a hard cap of 350, a typed argument-edge CSV whose targets include loci as first-class nodes, and global gates of >=800 claims / >=300 edges / >=150 citation needs / >=70% Tier-A resolvable (:1221-1234). It produced 982 line-anchored claim records — and contains no registration step whatsoever.

defects.defect: The mandated folder layout omits `tension-edges.json` entirely. It mandates `debate-map.{md,json}` (:116) instead. But `scripts/compile-corpus-index.py:1267` reads ONLY `<analysis_subdir>/tension-edges.json` when collecting tension edges; it never opens debate-map.json under any name. The plan therefore instructs authors to put the cluster's conflict layer in a file the compiler does not know exists.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary's 11 fully-documented debate axes (corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/debate-map.json, every axis multi-unit, min 3 units) and VR Pedagogy's 10 (corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/debate-map.json) contribute ZERO runtime tension edges. compiled-index.json holds 64 tensionEdges, all from the older book entries; not one comes from any TEMPLATE-lineage cluster. Neither cluster has a tension-edges.json at all.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Name the exact filenames and key names the runtime reads, and require a post-build assertion that the entry's contribution to the runtime artifact is non-zero for every layer the entry authored. No layer may be declared done until `compiled_count[layer][entry] > 0` is read back from the compiled artifact.

defects.defect: The layout mandates thirteen `_synthesis` artifacts and pairs six of them as `.{md,json}` twins. `compile-corpus-index.py:1216-1228` opens exactly one file per entry — `book-level-ontology.md` else `cluster-ontology.md` — plus `tension-edges.json`. Every `.json` ontology twin, global-edges.csv, concept-matrix.csv, contested-readings.md, citation-network.*, the concordance, the secondary-literature network, the terminology appendix, the evolution arc and all five .mmd graphs are opened by no code in the repository. The plan never says which artifacts are for the machine and which are for a human reader.
defects.consequence_observed: Of 494 JSON files under corpus/index, exactly 11 (the tension-edges.json files) are read by any program. 219 edge CSVs totalling 19,770 rows reach nothing — god-reason/reasoning.jsonl, the only edge file loaded at runtime (jsonl-loaders.ts:80,:156), is an unrelated n-gram artifact with a single fixed key shape. The 58 'unreachable-content' defects in the audit are the direct signature of this instruction.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Split the artifact list into MACHINE (has a named reader, a schema, and a compiled-count assertion) and HUMAN (explicitly labelled non-authoritative, derived, and regenerable). Forbid authoring any MACHINE artifact for which the reader does not already exist.

defects.defect: `debate-map.{md,json}` and the tension layer are specified only as '8-12 documented cross-source disagreements, each with the sources on each pole + a resolution note'. No key names, no types, no id format. `compile-corpus-index.py:1128` hard-requires `node_a`/`nodeA` AND `node_b`/`nodeB` and silently drops the record otherwise.
defects.consequence_observed: Verified by parsing all 11 tension-edges.json: 4 of 11 yield ZERO compilable edges. Uncomfortable Situations uses pole_A/pole_B (15 lost), Wendt uses wendt_position/against (12 lost), In-Game uses label/description only (12 lost), A Grammar of Motives uses label/description only (16 lost). 55 of 119 tension records — 46% — are discarded with no warning and no exit code.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship a JSON Schema file per record type in the repo, reference it by path from the plan, and make schema validation a build step that exits non-zero. No repo-wide *.schema.json exists today.

defects.defect: Both the Phase-5 procedure and the §8 checklist require 're-run the repo's verbatim-quote detector' and 'verbatim detector clean'. No such tool exists. `ls scripts/` (107 entries) contains no verbatim, quote, or copyright checker; the only 'verbatim' code in src/ is the drafting-time citation-enforcer, which never touches corpus/index. Replicated verbatim in boredom:240-241, vr-pedagogy:204, and every sibling plan's gate list.
defects.consequence_observed: The mandatory copyright gate is satisfied by agent self-attestation. corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md records it as 'per-unit agents verified (longest ~19 w)'. corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/.../ig-10-deep.json:434-441 records the executor truncating quotations to hit the ceiling: 'verbatim 24-word definition retained as definition_anchor; under the 25-word ceiling per task constraint'. 15 unverified-quotation defects in the audit.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every gate must name an executable and its exit condition (`python3 scripts/check-X.py <entry> && echo PASS`). A gate that names a tool must fail if the tool is absent, not pass by narration.

defects.defect: The plan mandates node headers in the form `#### N. Name` and calls the format 'header format', 'replicate the Boredom/FCM structure exactly'. It never states that the header parser treats a trailing parenthetical as a Greek/German lemma. `compile-corpus-index.py:735` does exactly that (`if not greek and parenthetical: greek = parenthetical`), `:1286` pushes that value into the global canonicalTerms greedy-match list, and `corpus-index-provider.ts:121` renders `node.greek` as the node's PRIMARY BOLD LABEL in the writing prompt, with `:190-191` adding it to retrieval keyword expansion. Worse, the plan's OWN frozen concordance vocabulary is parenthetical by construction — boredom:147-157 (`profound/deep boredom (FCM 3rd form)`), vr-pedagogy:118-127 (`presence (spatial/physical)`, `immersion (technological)`, `cognitive load (extraneous vs germane)`).
defects.consequence_observed: 204 of 701 compiled ontology nodes carry a Latin-only English parenthetical in the `greek` field. Traced exactly: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md:194 `#### 3. Immersion (technological)` -> node.greek='technological' -> canonicalTerms. Bare English words `technological`, `control`, `HMD`, `spatial/physical`, `umbrella analytic`, `Pitfall 1`, `1976` are now corpus-wide greedy-match terms. Worst offenders: Grammar of Motives 30, Being and Time 28, FCM 23, Boredom Secondary 21, VR Pedagogy 19, In-Game 18. Those 204 nodes also render into every writing prompt under the wrong label.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Never let surface form carry semantics. Require explicit typed fields (`name`, `lemma_greek`, `lemma_german`, `gloss`) and forbid parentheticals in any header used as a key. Add a check that asserts every `lemma_*` value contains non-Latin script or is empty.

defects.defect: 'Page offset (inferred, single-page scan): book_page = pdf_page - 2 ... Verify with 2 more anchors in Phase 0; if confirmed, never recompute per page.' The 'never recompute' instruction converts a two-point sample into a corpus-wide constant. No plan anywhere in plans/ requires page-offset verification beyond this (grep for offset-verification instructions returns nothing else); only 3 of 27 entries declare a `pdf_page_offset` at all (BCAP 15, Heidegger and Rhetoric 6, Rickert 20).
defects.consequence_observed: Rickert's declared offset of 20 is both wrong and non-constant (drifts 18->15). Aristotle: 33 of 34 unit records carry pdf_pages from a superseded linear offset with errors up to 47 pages, and the bekker-index has 101 of 188 loci off by >2 pages. Every locus in those entries is unresolvable to a real page. 44 dangling-reference defects.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require a machine-verifiable offset MAP, not a constant: an anchors table of >=10 (page_printed, page_pdf) pairs spread across the document, a check that asserts the map is monotone and that every locus in every record resolves inside the document's page range, and re-verification whenever the source file's sha256 changes.

defects.defect: The layout has NO slot for a claim or clause layer, and the unit JSON is given as a flat key list (`{id, slug, citation, discipline, strand, depth, thesis, sections, constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges:{}, extraction:{}}`) with no types, no cardinalities, no required/optional split, no id format, and no uniqueness rule. Book plans give even less: plans/wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md never mentions a claims array anywhere.
defects.consequence_observed: Every entry that produced claim-level material invented its own container, and each invented it differently: Wendt units hold 139 `{text, locus}` objects of which 91 have NO id and the 48 that do collide 20 ways (local C1..C10 counters reused per file — measured directly); Veri(dis)similitude uses a markdown pipe table (vds-claims-moves.md, 157 rows); Being and Time uses `id|claim|premises|targets|status` table rows (108); Boredom Secondary carries 2,924 sub-items across 9 incompatible sub-schemas with a `stance` field holding 162 uncontrolled values and 195 nulls; Uexküll uses `Claim|Evidence type|Strength|Page ref` (107); Dissertation uses phase2-claims.json (982). 49 schema-violation + 10 id-collision + 10 id-prefix-violation defects.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: The claim record IS the deliverable. Ship one JSON Schema for it, one for the clause record, one for the edge record, and one for the locus record, and validate all four in CI.

defects.defect: '>= max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations'. At N=1 this evaluates to 10 and becomes UNSATISFIABLE, not merely zero — a single unit cannot cite itself ten times. An unsatisfiable gate is worse than a vacuous one because executors must talk past it, which normalises talking past gates in general.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md: 'Intra-cluster citations >=15 -> actual 4. This is a finding, not a shortfall of the build' — the gate was reclassified as a research result. corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/citation-network.json embeds `gate:{required:10, deliveredTextual:40, deliveredTotal:65, satisfied:true}`, clearing the bar by counting a broader 'deliveredTotal' link set. VR Pedagogy's citation-network.json has no links array at all — only `intraClusterHubs[5]` — so the gate is not computable there.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Relational gates belong at GROUP scope over a set of entries with a declared minimum membership, and must be written as `if |group| >= k then ... else N/A-by-construction`. Never write a gate whose N=1 value is a permanent fail.

defects.defect: 'Debate-axis seeds: 6-10 ... (target 8-12 *documented* by Phase 3)' plus the §8 gate '8-12 documented debates'. A count target on a discovery-dependent phenomenon, authored by the same agent that then attests the count, is an instruction to manufacture the shortfall.
defects.consequence_observed: VR Pedagogy's debate-map.json: axes DA-07 and DA-08 each reference exactly ONE unit — they are not cross-source disagreements at all, they exist to reach 10. Boredom Secondary's debate-map.json is honest about it: `constructedByCluster: ['DA-05','DA-08','DA-10']` with the note 'Axes tagged P/anticipatory-application are assembled by this cluster from units that do not cite one another on the point. They are the cluster's own analytical contribution, not a dispute the sources stage themselves.' 3 of 11 (27%) of the gold cluster's 'documented debates' are cluster-constructed.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace count targets on relational discoveries with COVERAGE and EVIDENCE gates: every recorded disagreement must cite >=2 distinct source records with resolvable loci on opposing sides, and the record must carry a boolean `staged_by_sources` — with a separate reported count for constructed axes. Do not gate on the total.

defects.defect: 'citation-network.{md,json} # intra-cluster: who cites whom' — one comment, no keys, no shape. Two clusters built from this same line, in the same month, by the same discipline, produced mutually unreadable files.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/citation-network.json has 15 top-level keys including `links[65]`, `gate{}`, `strandMatrix`, `elpidorouCentrality`, `mostCited`, `mostCiting`. corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/citation-network.json has 4 keys and no links array — only `intraClusterHubs[5]`. No single script could compute the intra-cluster gate across both.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Any artifact named in the layout must be accompanied by its schema in the same line of the plan, or removed from the layout.

defects.defect: '3C `concept-matrix.csv` + `contested-readings.md`' plus the gate '8-12 contested readings'. contested-readings.md is given no format at all — not a table, not an id scheme, not a field list.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/contested-readings.md is free prose with bold `**CR-01.**` run-in markers; the header text declares 18 instances while a naive regex finds 21 hits. Nothing about it is countable without bespoke per-entry parsing. Boredom's equivalent differs again. The gate is decided by whatever number the authoring agent typed in the file's own preamble.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Contested readings become typed records with `{id, contesting_record_id, contested_target (record_id | external_interlocutor), grounds, locus_a, locus_b, provenance}` in a validated JSON file; the .md is generated from it.

defects.defect: Both plans specify `cluster-ontology.{md,json}` and a full synthesis suite but contain NO mention of scripts/compile-corpus-index.py, TEXT_DIRS, the `## 3A. Canonical Node List` header format, or any registration step. Registration is an optional afterthought that the plan never requires.
defects.consequence_observed: Verified: corpus/index/Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary (1985-2017)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md and the RDR2 Secondary and Aristotelian Emotion equivalents contain ZERO `####` sections — the header parser would return nothing even if they were registered, and they are not in TEXT_DIRS. Across the whole index, 8 of 27 entries are unregistered (Aristotelian Emotion 33 files, Aristotelian Motion and Time 5, Phantasia 46, Dissertation 358, Game-Behavior Analysis Method 33, RDR2 Playthrough 141, RDR2 Secondary 60, Veri(dis)similitude 9) = 685 of 1,758 files, 39% of the entire index, reaching nothing.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Registration is Phase 0, not Phase 5: create the entry's registry row and prove a non-zero compiled contribution BEFORE authoring content, so an unregistered entry cannot be authored at all.

defects.defect: The entire §8 gate set is a markdown checkbox list with no output artifact. The plan never requires the executor to emit a machine-readable record of gate results, and never names a file the reviewer can diff.
defects.consequence_observed: Only 2 of 27 entries have a quality-gates-report.md; only 1 (RDR2 Secondary) has anything approaching machine-readable metrics, and that file's own header reads 'dfd... — Quality Gates' (a copy-paste artifact from the Wendt entry). Where gate records do exist they are self-attested JSON objects inside the artifact they judge: boredom-terminology-appendix.json carries `gate:{required:50, delivered:72, satisfied:true}` and the concordance carries `unitCoverageGate: 'SATISFIED 55/55'` — written by the agent that wrote the artifact.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Mandate `gates.json` per entry, emitted by a checker script and never by the authoring agent, with `{gate_id, threshold, measured, pass, checker, checker_version, measured_at, input_sha256}` per gate, plus an aggregate exit code.

defects.defect: The TEMPLATE says thresholds 'scale with N' (:216), but the derived plan freezes N at plan-authoring time: '23 unit trios on disk' and '>= 276 deduplicated global edges (12*N)'. There is no instruction to re-derive the gate when the manifest — declared authoritative at TEMPLATE:78-79 — disagrees.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/manifest.json records `totalAnalyticalUnits: 34` (11 units added mid-run by user instruction). The gate bar of 276 was 12x23; the correct bar was 12x34=408. The same drift is acknowledged and then repeated for Boredom (plan says ~44, manifest says 55, gate says >=550 rather than 12x55=660). 66 count-mismatch defects in the audit are this pattern.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Gates must be expressed as formulas over values READ FROM the authoritative artifact at check time, never as literals. The checker computes N from the manifest and the manifest from disk, and fails if they disagree.

defects.defect: Phase 0 mandates extraction to '<scratchpad>/<prefix>-txt/' and hands agents that path, but never requires the extraction to be reproducible, never requires the extraction command and source sha256 to be recorded, and never forbids anchoring records to positions inside a scratch file. Nothing tells an agent that a /tmp line number is not an address.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/ carries 781 `lines NNN-NNN` anchors (e.g. ig-03-deep.md:129 'verified against the chapter text at /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt lines 1195-1877'; ig-10-deep.json:434-441 anchors six content-filter decisions to lines 5901-6285). /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt does not exist. ~1,000 clause-adjacent pointers — the finest-grained addresses in the entire index — are dead, and would be resurrected by one deterministic re-extraction that the plan never specified.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define a canonical, reproducible text projection per source: fixed tool + fixed flags + recorded tool version + source sha256 + output sha256, written to a tracked path under the entry, with a checker that re-runs the projection and asserts the sha256 still matches. Only then may character offsets be used as addresses.

defects.defect: 'No >=25-word verbatim quotation anywhere. Paraphrase; anchor-phrases <=12 words with a page number are permitted.' Applied uniformly, with no copyright-status test, no distinction between the analysed source and the primary texts it quotes, and no exemption for public-domain material. The threshold is also internally inconsistent across the family: plans/uncomfortable-situations-2017-analysis.md:178 says '<=25-word fair-use snippets', :259 says scan for '>=30-consecutive-word strings', :280 says 'no >=25-word verbatim'.
defects.consequence_observed: The ban was enforced against Equiano (1789), Radcliffe (1794), Austen (1811) and Darwin (1872) — all public domain. Two entries suppress the quoted text entirely (In-Game ig-10-deep.json:434-441; corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/.../us-03-radcliffe.json:419 'No Radcliffe passage was excerpted at length'). The executor truncated a definition to 24 words specifically to clear the ceiling. For an index whose stated goal is 'every claim and every clause', the clause is the payload, and this instruction deletes it.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace the blanket ban with a per-source `rights` field {public-domain | licensed | in-copyright} set in Phase 0 from year/publisher, and a per-record `quote_scope` policy: public-domain sources store the full clause verbatim; in-copyright sources store `{char_start, char_end, sha256(clause), first_8_words}` so the clause is addressable and re-derivable from the user's own copy without redistribution. Store the ADDRESS always; store the TEXT where rights permit.

defects.defect: '5 Mermaid graphs render; cross-pipeline graph <=25 edges.' The gate names no evidence artifact and no command. It was widely believed unrunnable, and executors recorded it as deferred rather than run.
defects.consequence_observed: mmdc 11.14.0 IS installed. Only 2 of 15 .mmd-bearing entries carry a render-validation record (Uncomfortable Situations and Phantasia — and the Phantasia one is an empty file). corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md records 'Mermaid graphs render via mmdc -> deferred ... mmdc is not installed in this environment', which was false. 67 .mmd files encoding 1,544 arrow-edges have no adapter and no validation.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every gate names its command and its evidence file. If a tool is genuinely absent the checker exits non-zero; 'deferred' is not a state a checker can emit.

defects.defect: The unit-id convention (`PREFIX` + `01..N`) is specified for UNITS only. No plan in plans/ states an ID scheme, an id namespace, or a uniqueness requirement for any sub-unit record — grep across all plans for uniqueness language returns nothing. Nor does any plan require that two registries in the same entry share an id space.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/ holds TWO concept registries with ZERO id overlap in one directory: concept-matrix.csv keys on `C-US-01..C-US-40` while book-level-ontology.json keys on `US-C-001..US-C-036`. Nothing can join them. Boredom Secondary's sub-item ids collide across 6 units. Wendt's claim ids collide 20 ways.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Mandate one global id grammar `<entry>:<type>:<nnnn>` (e.g. `ped-sec-14:claim:0087`), require ids to be stable across rebuilds, and add a checker that asserts global uniqueness across the whole index and that every cross-reference resolves.

defects.defect: `cluster-ontology.{md,json}` — the twin instruction — implies the two files carry the same content. Authors treated the .json as the richer canonical store. The compiler reads only the .md.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/_synthesis/book-level-ontology.json holds 38 concepts, 6 dimensions AND 18 canonical POSITIONS; the .md carries 44 `####` sections (concepts+dimensions only) — the 18 positions reach nothing. corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/book-level-ontology.json holds 36 concepts and 18 positions; the .md carries 36 sections — 18 positions unreachable. A Grammar of Motives loses 12 positions the same way. 48 canonical positions authored into a file the pipeline never opens.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: One authoritative machine store per layer; all human-readable renderings are GENERATED from it by a script, never hand-authored in parallel.

defects.defect: 'verify the new entry's node/term counts in compiled-index.json by reading them (do not assume)'. The instruction assumes the compiled artifact preserves per-entry attribution. `compile-corpus-index.py:1319-1321` merges nodes across texts by `node['name'].lower()` with no text component and `:1331-1332` concatenates the provenance strings, so a node shared with another entry no longer counts as this entry's.
defects.consequence_observed: 771 raw nodes merge to 701 with no per-merge log. Boredom Secondary declares nodeCount 68 in its own cluster-ontology.json; grouping compiled-index.json by `text` yields only 61 sole-attributions plus 7 spread across merged multi-text strings. The gate's own measurement instrument is lossy, so 'counts verified by reading' verifies a different number than the one authored.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require the compiled artifact to carry per-record provenance as a LIST of entry ids, not a concatenated string, and have the checker assert `count(records where entry_id in provenance) == entry's declared count`.

defects.defect: 'compiler runs clean' — 'clean' is undefined and, as written, cannot fail. `compile-corpus-index.py` main() at :1361 always returns 0; it has no `sys.exit`, no error counter, no `--strict`; a monkey-patched run counted zero `warn()` calls while 55 tension records were being discarded.
defects.consequence_observed: Every entry passed 'compiler runs clean' while silently losing 55 tension edges, 48 positions, and injecting 204 mis-parsed lemmas. The audit's 17 in-branch content-discarding sites in the compiler are all silent.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define 'clean' as `exit 0 AND discarded_record_count == 0`, require the compiler to emit a per-entry discard report, and make the plan's gate read that report rather than the console.

defects.defect: 'Concordance complete: every row -> >=1 anchor-1 node, every column -> >=1 anchor-2 channel (or `****** UNVERIFIED:`)'. The escape hatch is unbounded, so the gate is satisfiable by 100% placeholders.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/boredom-construct-measure-concordance.json records verbatim: `columnToChannelGate: 'SATISFIED 12/12 in the form the plan specifies for an unbuilt dataset entry: every column carries an explicit ****** UNVERIFIED: pointer rather than a fabricated correspondence.'` Twelve placeholders were recorded as twelve passes. Nothing in any plan later reconciles the placeholders when the anchor entry is built.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Placeholders are a tracked debt, not a pass. Emit `unresolved.json` per entry with `{ref, reason, blocking_entry, created_at}`; the gate reports `resolved / (resolved+unresolved)` and a build cannot be marked complete with unresolved refs to an entry that now exists on disk.

defects.defect: The only enforced completeness check in the whole plan is 'after each batch, verify all three files exist on disk for every unit and self-author any gaps'. File existence is treated as a proxy for content validity.
defects.consequence_observed: Measured: Boredom Secondary 55/55, VR Pedagogy 34/34 and RDR2 Secondary 12/12 have complete .md/.json/-edges.csv trios — a 100% pass on the one gate that is mechanically checkable. Those same entries carry the id collisions, the 40 mis-parsed nodes, the single-unit debates and the schema divergence. The plan enforced the weakest possible property.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace existence checks with content checks: schema validation, id uniqueness, locus resolvability, cross-reference resolution, and non-zero compiled contribution. Existence becomes a precondition of those, not a gate.

defects.defect: 'Phase 3 — cluster synthesis (author the synthesis layer YOURSELF in the main loop, not via subagents)' combined with 'Use the Agent tool, not Workflow'. The synthesis layer is where every cross-unit gate is measured, and the plan assigns its authorship to the same agent that then ticks the §8 checklist. No independent checker exists at any point in the loop.
defects.consequence_observed: Gate results are embedded as self-attested objects inside the artifacts they judge (`gate:{required:50, delivered:72, satisfied:true}` in boredom-terminology-appendix.json; `rowToFcmGate`, `columnToChannelGate`, `unitCoverageGate` in the concordance). 89 of 93 spot-verified audit findings survived refutation precisely because nothing in the pipeline ever tried to refute them.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Separate producer and judge structurally: the authoring agents never write gate results; a checker script run by the orchestrator writes gates.json, and the human gate reviews gates.json plus a random sample the checker selects, not a sample the author chooses.

defects.defect: 'GATE G1 — show the TEXT_DIRS diff + compiled node/term counts + one full sample unit trio, and WAIT for user sign-off before committing.' The only mandatory pre-commit inspection of the actual content is ONE unit trio, chosen by the author.
defects.consequence_observed: For Boredom Secondary that is a 1.8% inspection rate (1 of 55 units); for VR Pedagogy 2.9% (1 of 34). Neither G0 nor G1 inspects the 355 unit records, the 19,770 edge rows, the 2,924 sub-items, or a single locus. The two entries that passed G1 most recently are the two that injected 40 mis-parsed nodes into the global term list.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: G1 presents gates.json (all machine gates green), the compiled-contribution delta per layer, a checker-selected random sample of k records with their loci opened and resolved, and the unresolved-debt list. Author-chosen samples are not admissible.

defects.defect: The manifest key list is given but no invariants are stated: nothing requires `totalAnalyticalUnits` to equal the trio count on disk, nothing requires declared phase/status fields to be true, nothing requires declared statistics to agree with the companion CSVs.
defects.consequence_observed: VR Pedagogy manifest declares totalSourceFilesOnDisk 35 / totalAnalyticalUnits 34 against a plan that said 24/23; Boredom declares 50/55 against a plan that said 49/~44. Several manifests declare phases pending that are complete on disk. BCAP's section 3B contradicts its own companion CSV in every line.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every declared count becomes a checked assertion against a filesystem or artifact derivation; a manifest that disagrees with disk fails the build.

defects.defect: The per-unit deliverable is gated on PROSE VOLUME ('humanities/theory units 1,500-3,500w; empirical/STEM units 1,000-2,500w; map units 400-1,000w') with no per-record target of any kind. There is no gate anywhere in the family on records per source, records per 1,000 source words, or coverage of the source's sections.
defects.consequence_observed: Executors satisfied the gate by writing prose. corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/ contains 233 structured readings but 1,277 provenance-tagged assertions inside the prose — 5.5x more claim-level content written than structured. corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/.../us-03-radcliffe.json:102 is a single `outline` string of ~8,000 words carrying dozens of inline page anchors (PDF 87, book p.77, p.150, p.134, p.12, p.36, p.186, p.210) — clause-adjacent citations trapped in one unaddressable field. The prose gate actively rewarded the wrong artifact.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make record density the primary volume gate (claims per 1,000 source words, with a declared band), cap free-prose fields at a character limit that makes a blob impossible, and forbid page anchors inside prose fields — they must be structured locus records.

defects.defect: The edge CSV is given as `source,relation,target,locus,note` with a suggested relation list, but the relation vocabulary is open ('+ primary-object relations matching the concordance axes ... e.g. treats-<row-type>') and no plan mandates the header for entries outside the template lineage.
defects.consequence_observed: Measured across corpus/index: 219 edge CSVs, 19,770 rows, 41 DISTINCT HEADERS and 645 distinct relation values (16 of them singletons). Only 110 of 219 files use the template header. scripts/normalize-edges.py exists but knows only 6 hardcoded pipelines and is never run in any pipeline. Not one of the 19,770 rows is read by any runtime code.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Closed relation vocabulary in a versioned file, with an explicit `other` escape requiring a free-text `relation_raw` and a review flag; one header, validated; and a named runtime consumer that must show a non-zero row count for the entry.

defects.defect: Registration is specified as a hand-edit to a Python dict literal inside scripts/compile-corpus-index.py, once per entry, performed by an LLM at the very end of a long build.
defects.consequence_observed: 19 entries registered against 27 on disk; the working tree carries 3 uncommitted TEXT_DIRS entries versus HEAD, so the registry and the entries are versioned independently and can silently diverge. Under the ratified direction of ~265 single-source entries this becomes 265 hand-edits to one dict — an O(N) manual step with an O(N) forget rate, and the audit already shows the forget rate is 30%.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Registration must be data, not code: a `registry.json` (or per-entry `entry.json` discovered by glob) that the compiler reads. Adding an entry then cannot require editing a program.

defects.defect: '<topic>-scholarly-evolution.md — thematic arc across the cluster's date range' is a mandatory deliverable with no N-dependence stated. At N=1 the date range is a point and the artifact is undefined.
defects.consequence_observed: No single-source entry in the index carries one; the instruction simply cannot be executed at N=1, and the plan gives no N/A path, so an executor at N=1 must either fabricate an arc or silently drop a mandated deliverable — the RDR2 Playthrough entry (141 files, no plan at all) drops every mandated deliverable.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Mark every deliverable with its scope (RECORD / ENTRY / GROUP) and its minimum N. Group deliverables are absent-by-construction at entry scope, and the checker reports them as N/A rather than missing.

defects.defect: '>= 50 terminology lemmas'. This is a VOLUME gate, not a cross-unit gate, and the plan applies it at cluster scope with no per-source derivation.
defects.consequence_observed: Phantasia produced 213 canonical lemmas from 8 units (~27/unit after canonicalization from 279 raw); Boredom 72 from 55 units (~1.3/unit); VR Pedagogy 79 from 34; RDR2 65 from 12. The gate is therefore trivially met in some clusters and would be unreachable without padding at N=1. The four clusters differ by 20x in lemmas-per-unit while all passing.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Express lemma gates per source and per 1,000 source words, and separate 'lemmas extracted' from 'lemmas canonicalized' so the canonicalization ratio is itself reported.

defects.defect: 'If a named anchor entry does not exist yet on disk, leave its bridges as `****** UNVERIFIED:` pointers and flag it in phase0-overview.md — do not block.' The instruction creates debt with no ledger and no reconciliation trigger.
defects.consequence_observed: VR Pedagogy's entire anchor-2 axis (Boredom Experiment dataset) is placeholders. The Boredom Experiment entry has since been built (7 compiled nodes) and nothing reconciled. 44 dangling-reference defects in the audit.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: A machine-readable `unresolved.json` per entry keyed by target entry id, plus a global checker that fails when an unresolved ref names an entry that now exists.

defects.defect: The layout mandates no orthography or encoding normalisation rule for non-English lemmas, and no rule about which of several transliterations is canonical.
defects.consequence_observed: Uexküll carries four mutually incompatible German orthographies in one entry, and the CORRUPTED variant is the one that reaches runtime. 13 encoding-corruption defects in the audit.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Declare UTF-8 NFC, one canonical orthography per lemma with `variants[]`, and a checker that flags any lemma differing from another only by normalisation or mojibake.

defects.defect: '3B global-edges.csv (concat + dedup)' creates a second serialization of the per-unit edge files with no statement of which is authoritative.
defects.consequence_observed: 19,770 rows on disk are ~9,762 distinct triples — nearly every edge is stored twice. Four entries DISAGREE between the two layers (FCM 428 vs 452, Aristotle 246 vs 156, Grammar 878 vs 876, Phantasia 708 vs 706) and nothing records which is stale. The audit's open question 3 is exactly this.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: One authoritative edge store per entry; any aggregate is generated and gitignored or regenerated in CI, never hand-maintained.

unspecified_gaps: What a CLAIM is, and what a CLAUSE is. The TEMPLATE has no claim record and no clause record anywhere in its layout or schemas. Every entry that produced claim-level material invented its own container and its own granularity rule; only tmp/Dissertation/DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md ever wrote one down ('a discrete proposition that could plausibly be true or false, contested or supported', with the worked example that one complex sentence contains three claims).

Which artifacts the machine reads. The plan lists 13 _synthesis artifacts as peers. Two are read (cluster-ontology.md, tension-edges.json). Executors therefore invested equally in eleven dead ones and, in RDR2 Secondary's case, rationalised non-registration as a design choice ('consumed directly by agents (read as files)') that no code implements.
The tension/debate JSON key names. Four incompatible schemas resulted; 55 of 119 records discarded.
The citation-network JSON key names. Two clusters, same template, same month, incompatible files.
The contested-readings format. Prose in one entry, something else in another; not countable.
The unit JSON field TYPES, cardinalities, and required/optional split. Only a key list is given.
Any id grammar or uniqueness rule below unit level. Result: 91 unidentified and 20 colliding claim objects in Wendt alone; two disjoint concept registries inside Uncomfortable Situations.
That a trailing parenthetical in a node header is parsed as a Greek/German lemma. 204 of 701 nodes poisoned; bare English words in the global greedy-match list.
That page offsets drift and must be verified as a map rather than assumed as a constant. No plan requires offset verification; the one plan that mentions it says 'never recompute'.
That scratch extraction paths are not addresses. 781 line-range anchors in In-Game point into a deleted /tmp file.
Any reproducibility requirement on text extraction: no tool version, no flags, no source sha256, no output sha256 recorded anywhere.
Any rights model. The 25-word ban is applied uniformly to public-domain and in-copyright sources alike, and to primary texts quoted inside the analysed source.
Any record-density target. Prose word-count bands are the only volume gate, so 1,277 provenance-tagged assertions were written as prose in VR Pedagogy against 233 structured readings.
Any requirement that a gate produce a machine-readable result artifact. 2 of 27 entries have a gate report; 1 has metrics.
Any separation between the agent that authors a layer and the agent/script that judges it. Gate objects are embedded inside the artifacts they judge.
Any definition of 'compiler runs clean'. The compiler cannot fail: main() always returns 0 and emits zero warnings while discarding records.
Any reconciliation path for `****** UNVERIFIED:` placeholders once the blocking entry exists.
Which of the two edge serializations is authoritative. Four entries already disagree between them.
Any statement that registration must happen before authoring, or any check that an entry contributes non-zero records to the compiled artifact.
Any orthography/encoding normalisation rule. Uexküll ships four German orthographies and the corrupted one wins.
Any per-source coverage requirement (that every section/chapter/page range of the source is represented). Nothing prevents an entry from covering only the abstract and introduction.
Any instruction for what the entry looks like at N=1 — no scope tagging of deliverables, so at N=1 an executor must either fabricate group artifacts or silently drop mandated ones.

Any versioning/rebuild story. Nothing says what happens to record ids when a source is re-extracted or an entry is rebuilt; the Dissertation plan is the only document that even mentions id stability across runs.
design_inputs: ADDRESSING FIRST, AUTHORING SECOND. Phase 0 of the new plan must produce a canonical, reproducible text projection per source before any analysis: fixed tool + fixed flags + recorded tool version, written to a TRACKED path inside the entry (e.g. `<entry>/_source/<slug>.txt`), with `{source_path, source_sha256, tool, tool_version, flags, projection_sha256, char_count, page_map[]}` recorded in `source.json`. A checker re-runs the projection and asserts projection_sha256 is unchanged. This single artifact is what converts the existing 982 Dissertation claims, 995 In-Game line anchors, 973 Aristotle Bekker bullets and 1,326 RDR2 observations from prose into addresses.

DEFINE THE CLAUSE ADDRESS EXPLICITLY as `{projection_sha256, char_start, char_end}` plus derived human loci `{page_printed, page_pdf, sentence_index}`. Nothing in 1,758 files carries a sentence offset, character span or bbox today; the finest locator anywhere is a page, a Bekker line pair, or a video timestamp. The character span into the canonical projection is the only locator that is both machine-checkable and rights-safe (it addresses the clause without redistributing it).

SHIP FOUR JSON SCHEMAS IN THE REPO and reference them by path from the plan: `claim.schema.json`, `clause.schema.json`, `edge.schema.json`, `locus.schema.json`. No *.schema.json exists anywhere in the repo today and 49 schema-violation defects follow from that. Validation must be a build step with a non-zero exit.

BASE THE CLAIM SCHEMA ON THE ONE THAT WORKED — corpus/index/Dissertation/_run-history/2026-05-20T0058/_per-section/*/phase2-claims.json (982 records, 100% line-anchored, 76% in an explicit supports/supported_by graph, 841 typed edges). Required fields: `id` (global grammar), `entry_id`, `section_id`, `locus` (clause address object), `text` (the claim proposition, ours), `clause_ref` (the source clause address), `claim_type`, `logical_role`, `supports[]`, `supported_by[]`, `citations[] {locus, tier, rationale}`, `support_tier` (closed enum), `provenance` (closed enum FE | FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> | P/anticipatory-application), `interpretive_flag_present` (bool), `remediation {action, candidates[], effort}`.

CARRY OVER THE 8-TIER SUPPORT TAXONOMY VERBATIM from tmp/Dissertation/DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md:333-341 (T1-textually-confirmed ... T7-overreach, T8-secondary-needed), each with its remediation action. what_to_preserve: The double-locus rule from plans/wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md:129 — `(p.NN / pdf NN)` on every citation. Measured 307/307 = 100% compliance. Precisely specified format + regex-checkable + applied per-record is the exact recipe that works; extend to a triple locus including the character span.

The three-value provenance vocabulary (TEMPLATE:38-42): FE = the source's own claim, FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> = close paraphrase of a specific passage with a page anchor, P / anticipatory-application = our interpretive link. It is closed, it is short, it is applied consistently, and it is the discipline that keeps the user's own readings separable from the sources' — indispensable at claim level.

The 8-tier support taxonomy with a remediation action per tier (tmp/Dissertation/DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md:333-341). Exercised at scale on 982 records; makes 'every weakness' an indexed property rather than a narrative aside; T7-overreach flagged 22 real cases.

The claim record schema and its explicit JSONC example (DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md:490-535) — the only place any plan in this repo writes a literal record schema, and the only place a working claim layer resulted.

The granularity rule with a worked decomposition, plus the anti-inflation cap (DISSERTATION-ANALYSIS-PIPELINE-PLAN.md 'Granularity rule' + the risk register's per-section cap of 350 and 'one proposition = one claim, not one sentence = one claim').

The typed argument-edge CSV whose targets include LOCI as first-class nodes (`DISS-01-C12,cites-as-support,citation,ARISTOTLE-LOCUS:DA III.10 433b12-25,...`). Making a locus an edge target is exactly what a clause-level index needs.

Anchor discipline: bridge, never duplicate (TEMPLATE:30-36). Pointers to an anchor entry's unit ids rather than re-digesting its argument is correct and is what keeps ~265 single-source entries from becoming ~265 re-explanations of the same book.

The manifest-is-authoritative rule (TEMPLATE:78-79) with `planCorrections` recorded rather than silently applied. VR Pedagogy's planCorrections entries are genuinely useful forensics. The fix is to make gates READ the manifest, not to abandon it.

The de-duplication and 'haystack' rubric (TEMPLATE:57-67) — md5 identity, preprint/published merge with `dup-variant`, and page-range extraction from proceedings volumes. Concrete, executable, and the 23 duplicate groups / 20 cross-domain duplicates across 288 corpus PDFs make it necessary.

Mandatory pre-extraction to text with the agent given the .txt path and never the PDF (TEMPLATE:138-140). The reasoning (image-payload cost, multi-page-image API-400) is sound; it needs only to be made reproducible and tracked rather than scratch.

The explicit reliability note that subagents no-op ~1/8 with a mandatory post-batch completeness sweep (TEMPLATE:208-210). It is the one enforced check in the plan and it achieved 100% trio completeness on all three template-lineage clusters (55/55, 34/34, 12/12). Keep the discipline; upgrade what it checks from existence to content.

GATE G0 — a cheap, early, human sign-off on scope and vocabulary before any expensive authoring (TEMPLATE:100-103). Correcting the axes at spec time is far cheaper than after 55 units. Keep it; add the record schema and the density band to what G0 approves.
The `****** UNVERIFIED:` / do-not-block convention (TEMPLATE:36) as a way to keep a build moving. Keep the marker; add the ledger and the reconciliation trigger it never had.

The concordance idea itself, correctly understood. Phantasia's is keyed `loci_by_work` — source x locus, not unit x unit. That is already a claim-addressing structure and it survives N=1 intact; it should become the entry-scope backbone rather than a cluster-scope grid.

Honest self-reporting when a gate misses. corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md declares its intra-cluster-citation shortfall and its deferred Mermaid validation openly, and Boredom's debate-map.json flags 3 of 11 axes as `constructedByCluster`. gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Per-section bands (150-200 for DISS-01-A0, cap 350) are the N=1 form and they bound correctly.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: THIS IS THE ONLY CLAIM-LEVEL GATE SET THAT EXISTS, and it worked: 982 claims, 841 typed edges, 100% line-anchored, 76% in the support graph.
gates_assessment.verdict: THE TEMPLATE TO GENERALISE — with two fixes. (1) It has no registration step at all, so its 982 claims and 358 files reach nothing (the Dissertation entry is unregistered). (2) Its density is stated as absolute counts per section rather than as records per 1,000 source words, so it does not transfer to a source of unknown length. Convert to a density band and add the compiled-contribution assertion.

summary:
THE PLAN FAMILY'S CENTRAL DEFECT IS THAT IT SPECIFIES WHAT TO WRITE AND NOT WHERE IT LANDS. scripts/compile-corpus-index.py reads exactly two files per entry — `book-level-ontology.md` or `cluster-ontology.md` (:1216-1228) and `tension-edges.json` (:1267). The canonical TEMPLATE (:109-133) mandates thirteen `_synthesis` artifacts, six of them as `.{md,json}` twins, and does not mention `tension-edges.json` at all. Every instruction in the plan about debates, concordances, citation networks, concept matrices, terminology, evolution arcs, edges and graphs therefore produces content that no program in this repository opens. Measured: 494 JSON files under corpus/index, 11 read; 219 edge CSVs / 19,770 rows, 0 read; 8 of 27 entries unregistered = 685 of 1,758 files (39%) reaching nothing; 4 of 11 tension files discarding 100% of their records at compile-corpus-index.py:1128 (55 of 119 total) with zero warnings and an exit code that is always 0.

THE GATES DID NOT CATCH ANY OF IT BECAUSE ONLY ONE OF THEM IS ENFORCED BY ANYTHING, and it is the weakest: 'all three files exist on disk'. That gate passes 55/55, 34/34 and 12/12 on the three template-lineage clusters, which simultaneously carry 20 colliding claim ids, 40 mis-parsed ontology nodes, and four 'documented debates' that reference a single unit. The mandatory copyright gate names a verbatim-quote detector that does not exist and is satisfied by agent self-attestation. 'Compiler runs clean' cannot fail. 'Counts verified by reading' reads a lossy instrument (compile-corpus-index.py:1319-1321 merges across texts by lowercased name). Where gate results were recorded at all they were written by the same agent that wrote the artifact, embedded inside it (`gate:{required:50, delivered:72, satisfied:true}`). Only 2 of 27 entries have a gate report; 1 has metrics.

THE CLEANEST TRACED CAUSAL CHAIN, and the one with corpus-wide blast radius, runs from a formatting instruction to the writing prompt. TEMPLATE:169 mandates node headers as `#### N. Name`, and the plan's own frozen concordance vocabulary is parenthetical by construction (`Immersion (technological)`, `Presence (spatial/physical)`, `Cognitive load (extraneous vs germane)`). compile-corpus-index.py:735 falls back to treating the parenthetical as a Greek/German lemma; :1286 pushes it into canonicalTerms; corpus-index-provider.ts:121 renders `node.greek` as the node's PRIMARY BOLD LABEL in every writing prompt and :190-191 makes it a retrieval keyword. Result: 204 of 701 compiled nodes carry an English parenthetical as their lemma, and bare words 'technological', 'control', 'HMD', 'umbrella analytic', 'Pitfall 1' are now global greedy-match terms. The plan never said the parenthetical was semantic; it never had to, because it never said node names were keys.

ADJUDICATION OF THE CROSS-UNIT ARGUMENT: the prior report's two headline numbers are EXACTLY right and I reproduced them from the gold cluster files — corpus/index/Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary (1985-2017)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.json gives 32 of 41 concepts multi-unit and 21 of 22 readings multi-unit, and debate-map.json gives 12 of 12 debates multi-unit; Boredom Secondary independently gives 54 of 68 nodes multi-unit and 11 of 11 debate axes multi-unit at a minimum of 3 units each. BUT THE INFERENCE DRAWN FROM THEM IS TOO BROAD. Of the seven gates the report names, only THREE genuinely evaluate to nothing at N=1: documented debates, the intra-cluster citation network, and the scholarly-evolution arc. The concordance does NOT collapse — Phantasia's is keyed `loci_by_work`, i.e. source x locus, so at N=1 it becomes the single row of locus cells one article fills, which is precisely the addressable payload the ultimate goal wants. Contested readings do NOT collapse if re-based on named external interlocutors (VR Pedagogy's CR-01/CR-03 contest Short et al. 1976 and the SSQ, neither a cluster unit). The `>=12*N` edge gate does NOT collapse because TEMPLATE:162 already carries per-unit floors that bind at N=1 by construction. Concepts do NOT collapse — 9 of 41 gold-cluster concepts are already single-unit. And `>=50 lemmas` fails at N=1 for an unrelated reason (volume: ~27 canonical lemmas per unit in the gold cluster), not cross-unit-ness. One gate is worse than vacuous: `>=max(10, N/4)` intra-cluster citations evaluates to 10 at N=1 and is UNSATISFIABLE, which is exactly why executors learned to talk past it ('a finding, not a shortfall of the build'). SO: the user's overrule stands, and the new plan needs a GROUP-level home for precisely three gates, not a retreat from standalone article entries.

THE DEEPEST FINDING IS THAT THIS IS NOT AN AUTHORING PROBLEM. Claim-level material already exists in bulk — 982 line-anchored Dissertation claims with an 8-tier support taxonomy and 841 typed edges, 157 tiered Veri(dis)similitude rows at one structured claim per 59 words, 2,924 Boredom sub-items of which 2,012 already carry a page locus, 973 Aristotle Bekker-anchored bullets against 2,323 Bekker loci that ARE a clause-level address system, 139 Wendt `{text, locus}` objects, 995 In-Game line anchors. It is unaddressable because no plan ever specified a record schema, an id grammar, a uniqueness rule, a reproducible text projection, or a locator finer than a page. Nothing in 1,758 files carries a sentence offset, a character span, or a bbox. Two entries actively SUPPRESS the clause under a uniform 25-word ban applied even to Austen, Radcliffe, Equiano and Darwin — all public domain — with one executor recorded truncating a definition to exactly 24 words 'per task constraint'.

WHAT THE NEW PLAN MUST DO DIFFERENTLY, in one line each: put addressing before authoring (a tracked, sha256-pinned canonical text projection per source, from which char-span clause addresses are derived); ship four JSON Schemas and validate in CI; register at Phase 0 and assert a non-zero compiled contribution per layer before any content is written; make registration data rather than a hand-edit to a Python dict; gate on record density (~1 record per 58-59 source words, the rate both proven exemplars hit) instead of prose word count; scope-tag every gate RECORD / ENTRY / GROUP with a minimum N and an explicit N/A-by-construction branch; replace count targets on relational discoveries with evidence gates; express every threshold as a formula read at check time; emit gates.json from a checker script that no authoring agent may write; and replace the blanket verbatim ban with a rights model that stores the full clause where rights permit and a `{char_span, sha256, first-8-words}` address where they do not. The one gate in the entire family with 100% compliance — Wendt's `(p.NN / pdf NN)` double locus, 307/307 — is the model: precisely specified format, regex-checkable, applied per record.
