The template never once uses the word "schema" (0 occurrences, likewise in the Boredom plan), never mentions tension-edges.json (the compiler's ONLY edge channel — hence every template-built cluster contributes zero of the 64 compiled tension edges), and never mentions offset, span, clause, bbox, uniqueness, namespace or collision. Where it leaves a shape unspecified, executing agents invented one, differently every time: four sibling clusters shipped four incompatible global-edges.csv headers, and two executions of the identical "concat + dedup" instruction chose different dedup keys (Boredom keyed on source,relation,target and destroyed 18 locus-distinct rows; VR Pedagogy keyed on source,relation,target,locus and destroyed 0). Its two most load-bearing gates are unfalsifiable: the compiler literally cannot fail (main() has no exit code; an unparsable ontology returns [] with no warning), and the "verbatim-quote detector" it tells you to re-run does not exist in the repo. And its copyright rule — no >=25-word verbatim anywhere, anchor phrases <=12 words — is in direct, irreconcilable opposition to a clause-level index, because a clause-level record IS the verbatim span; In-Game's own content_filter_audit shows definitions being truncated to 24, 23 and 20 words to stay "under ceiling". Meanwhile the claim-level material already exists on disk in bulk and is simply unaddressable: Boredom's readings[] arrays are claim records with stance, locus and provenance tag; 296 of 463 lack ids and stance carries 162 uncontrolled values with 195 nulls, purely because template line 159-161 lists array names and never specifies a single element field. A new plan does not need better authoring. It needs a record-level schema with stable ids, a resolvable locator contract, a rights-tiered quotation policy that permits the clause, an ingest path that actually reads what is authored, and gates that can fail.
what_the_plan_actually_specifies:
PARAMETERS (§P, lines 14-26). Seven hand-filled values — SOURCE_DIR, CLUSTER_NAME, PREFIX, PURPOSE, ANCHORS (0-2 existing entries), ANCHOR_EDGE_NAMES, optional CONCORDANCE_HINT. N is declared to be the final analytical-unit count derived in Phase -1; every downstream threshold scales off it.

ANCHOR + PROVENANCE + COPYRIGHT DISCIPLINE (§0, lines 30-45). Anchors are bridged, never re-digested: cite the anchor's unit ids via the matching ANCHOR_EDGE_NAME; find each anchor's unit ids and ontology node list before Phase 2; if an anchor entry does not exist, leave `****** UNVERIFIED:` pointers and do not block. Three provenance tags carried through every unit and edge: FE (source's own claim, paraphrased), FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> (close paraphrase of a specific passage with page anchor), P / anticipatory-application (our interpretive link). Copyright: no >=25-word verbatim quotation anywhere; anchor phrases <=12 words with a page number.

PHASE -1 — SURVEY AND SELF-AUTHORED CLUSTER SPEC (lines 49-103). -1.1 inventory via pdfinfo + md5sum + pdftotext -l 3. -1.2 de-dup/haystack rubric: identical md5 DROP; same study different file MERGE with dup-variant note; >300pp proceedings HAYSTACK (grep the .txt, find the page range, re-extract with -f/-l, else map-depth stub flagged HAYSTACK-UNRESOLVED); substantively relevant monograph kept as one deep-long chapter-selective unit. -1.3 strands: 4-8 thematic strands, grouped first by discipline register then shared object, strands with <3 members merged. -1.4 authoritative unit table: PREFIX+01..N grouped by strand, -00- reserved for corpus-overview, recording id/slug/folder/author/year/title/pp/strand/depth/sourceFile; slug = surname + short-title fragment; folder = "<Author> - <Short Title> (<Year>)"; depth rubric deep / deep-long / map; the table is provisional and _synthesis/manifest.json is authoritative thereafter (explicitly citing the Boredom 44->55 drift). -1.5 primary-object concordance axes: rows = canonical concepts normalized to <=15 labels, columns = anchor loci/channels or methods/measures <=15 labels, derived by asking what two things a citation lookup must connect; frozen vocabulary for Phase 2. -1.6 controlled vocabulary: <=12 object types seeded from CONSTRUCT / MEASURE-LOCUS / READING-CLAIM / THEORY-MODEL / THEME / DEBATE-AXIS / INTERLOCUTOR / AUTHOR / TERM plus one bridge type per anchor; edge relations = 7 standard + 4 cluster + concordance-axis relations + one bridge relation per anchor; 6-10 theme seeds; 6-10 debate-axis seeds targeting 8-12 documented. -1.7 emit the filled spec to plans/ and STOP at GATE G0 for user sign-off.

FOLDER LAYOUT (§2, lines 107-133). corpus/index/<CLUSTER_NAME>/ containing _synthesis/ with manifest.json, phase0-overview.md, cluster-ontology.{md,json}, global-edges.csv, debate-map.{md,json}, concept-matrix.csv, contested-readings.md, citation-network.{md,json}, <topic>-concordance.{md,json}, <topic>-secondary-literature-network.{md,json}, <topic>-terminology-appendix.{md,json}, <topic>-scholarly-evolution.md and five graph-*.mmd files; bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md; one folder per unit holding <PREFIX>NN-<slug>.md, .json and -edges.csv; and units/<PREFIX>00-corpus-overview.md.

FIVE-PHASE PIPELINE (§5, lines 135-185). Phase 0: mandatory pdftotext of every source to the scratchpad (agents get the .txt path, never the PDF — avoids image-payload cost and the multi-page-image API-400); near-empty .txt flagged OCR-LOW; apply de-dup/haystack dispositions; write phase0-overview.md and manifest.json with 16 named keys. Phase 1: per-source metadata JSON header fields only (bib header, discipline, strand, <=60-word abstract paraphrase, section structure, expected concordance rows/columns, expected interlocutors, per-anchor bridge candidates, OCR confidence). Phase 2: one agent per unit, two-pass on deep-long; each unit emits (a) a paraphrastic .md of 1,500-3,500w humanities / 1,000-2,500w empirical / 400-1,000w map, with a fixed section order ending in a concordance feed, an Analytical role section and a "Not treated:" line; (b) a .json with keys id, slug, citation, discipline, strand, depth, thesis, sections, constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges{}, extraction{}; (c) an -edges.csv with columns source,relation,target,locus,note under edge floors map>=12, deep>=20, deep-long>=35, plus per-unit axis and bridge edge requirements. Phase 3, authored in the main loop in waves: 3A cluster-ontology.{md,json} whose .md must carry a "## 3A. Canonical Node List" in header format (#### N. Name + - **key**: value bullets, minimum definition/type/units/centrality) replicating Boredom/FCM exactly because the compiler parses it; 3B global-edges.csv (concat + dedup) plus an 8-12 entry debate-map; 3C concept-matrix.csv plus contested-readings.md; 3D the concordance {md,json} plus a >=50-lemma terminology appendix, with every row mapped to an anchor-1 node and every column to an anchor-2 channel or else `****** UNVERIFIED:`; 3E citation-network, external-hubs network, five Mermaid graphs and a thematic scholarly-evolution narrative. Phase 4 (only if ANCHORS non-empty): bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md as pointers only, plus graph-cross-pipeline-bridge.mmd hard-capped at <=25 edges, all tagged anticipatory-application.

PHASE 5 COMPILER WIRING (§6, lines 187-201). Timestamped backups of the compiler and compiled-index.json into .backups/; add one dict entry to TEXT_DIRS with ontology_format "header" and analysis_subdir "_synthesis"; run python3 scripts/compile-corpus-index.py; verify the new entry's node/term counts by reading compiled-index.json; re-run the repo's verbatim-quote detector; GATE G1 shows the TEXT_DIRS diff, the compiled counts and one sample unit trio and waits for sign-off; never commit before G1.

ORCHESTRATION (§7, lines 205-214). Agent tool not Workflow. Budget 1 (Phase -1/0 main loop) + N metadata agents batched ~8 at a time + N deep agents (deep-long get dedicated two-pass agents) + Phase 3 authored in the main loop. Documented reliability lesson: pre/post-task hooks intermittently no-op a subagent about 1 in 8, mitigated by pre-extracting to .txt and, after each batch, verifying all three files exist for every unit and self-authoring any gaps. Each Phase-2 agent receives the .txt path, its id/slug/strand/depth, the controlled vocabulary, the concordance axes, the edge floors, the anchor unit-id list, the provenance tags, the <=25-word verbatim ban and one exemplar trio as the quality bar. Mid-run deviations are recorded in manifest.json -> planCorrections, never silently.

QUALITY GATES (§8, lines 216-229). Eight checkboxes: N complete unit trios with dispositions recorded; >=12*N deduplicated global edges, 8-12 debates, 8-12 contested readings, >=50 lemmas, >= max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations; concordance completeness including every unit in >=1 cell; per-strand bridge and column-axis edge requirements; no >=25-word verbatim with provenance tags throughout; five Mermaid graphs render and the cross-pipeline graph is <=25 edges; a parseable ## 3A section, compiler runs clean, compiled counts verified by reading, verbatim detector clean; backups taken and G0/G1 sign-offs obtained with no commit before G1.

WHAT THE BOREDOM PRECEDENT HAD THAT THE TEMPLATE ABSTRACTED AWAY. The Boredom plan hand-authored its concordance axes as concrete label lists (§3, lines 147-158), hand-named its two anchors with their exact unit ids fcm-04..07 and their ontology file path (§0, lines 21-29), hand-listed seven debate-axis seeds as real propositions (§4, lines 175-179), enumerated its de-dup dispositions file-by-file with reasons in a table (§1B, lines 89-97), and closed with a §9 "Decisions to confirm" section of six reasoned recommendations inviting pushback. The template replaced all of that with derivation rubrics. It also lost artifacts the earlier precedents produced without being told to: Phantasia emitted _synthesis/render-validation.txt naming the mmdc version and per-graph node/edge counts against caps, and RDR2 emitted _synthesis/quality-gates-report.md with a gate/target/actual/pass table plus an honest "Gates NOT fully met" section. Neither is required by the template, and neither template-built cluster produced one.

defects.defect: The mandated folder layout specifies ~14 _synthesis artifacts plus three files per source, and the Phase-5 wiring specifies exactly one TEXT_DIRS dict entry with ontology_format 'header' and analysis_subdir '_synthesis'. The compiler reads, from that configuration, ONE file: _synthesis/book-level-ontology.md or _synthesis/cluster-ontology.md, parsed for header nodes (compile-corpus-index.py:1217-1229), plus _synthesis/tension-edges.json (compile-corpus-index.py:1267-1271) which the template never mentions. It reads no unit .md, no unit .json, no -edges.csv, no global-edges.csv, no concept-matrix.csv, no debate-map, no concordance, no terminology appendix, no citation-network, no .mmd. The plan therefore instructs agents to spend the overwhelming majority of their effort producing files the pipeline never opens.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/ — 55 unit JSONs containing 2,588 locus-bearing sub-items, 3,815 per-unit edge rows, a 1,897-row _synthesis/global-edges.csv, a 72-lemma appendix, a 12-axis debate map and the construct x measure concordance all reduce at runtime to 61 name-only nodes in compiled-index.json. Corpus-wide: 1,759 files / 35.3 MB under corpus/index produce a 664 KB compiled-index.json whose node records carry no id, no page, no quote and no locus (fields are only name, greek, transliteration, translation, definition, type, units, text, aliases, centralityTier).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Invert the order: define the runtime record schema and the loader FIRST, then require that every artifact the plan mandates be an input to that loader. Forbid mandating any artifact that no code path reads. Add a mechanical gate that enumerates the entry's files, marks each as READ-BY-LOADER or HUMAN-ONLY, and fails if the read-by-loader byte fraction falls below a declared threshold.

defects.defect: The unit JSON is specified as a bare list of key names — constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges{} — with zero element-level schema. No required per-element id, no id-uniqueness or namespacing rule, no required locus, no controlled vocabulary for stance/type, no null policy. Executing agents invented an element shape per array per unit.
defects.consequence_observed: Measured across the 55 unit JSONs of corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/: 2,588 sub-items total; readings[] has 463 elements across 8 distinct key-signatures of which only 167 carry any id (296 do not) and 29 lack a locus; readings[].stance holds 162 distinct values with 195 nulls (values range from 'FE' and 'contests' to 'asserts (core model claim)' and 'restates-FCM (fcm-06)'); constructs[] has 425 elements across 5 key-signatures with 155 missing a locus; sections[] has 330 elements of which 330 lack a locus; measures[] has 7 distinct key-signatures. The same gap produced Wendt's 139 claim objects of which 91 lack ids and 20 collide, and Boredom Secondary's 9 incompatible sub-schemas.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship a machine-checkable JSON Schema (or equivalent) as an artifact of the plan, not prose. Every record element must carry: a globally unique id built as <ENTRY_PREFIX>-<SOURCE_ID>-<KIND>-<NNNN>; a locator object; a support/stance value drawn from a closed enum declared in the plan; a provenance tag from a closed enum; and an explicit null-policy. Require a validator run over every emitted JSON as a hard gate, and require the validator to be committed with the entry.

defects.defect: tension-edges.json is the compiler's only edge channel (compile-corpus-index.py:1254-1273, requiring node_a/nodeA and node_b/nodeB per entry at :1125-1129). The word 'tension-edges' appears 0 times in the template and 0 times in the Boredom plan. The template instead mandates debate-map.{md,json}, contested-readings.md and per-unit tensions[] — none of which any code reads.
defects.consequence_observed: No template-built cluster has a tension-edges.json (verified absent for Boredom Secondary, VR Pedagogy Secondary, RDR2 Secondary, Phantasia Secondary). compiled-index.json contains 64 tensionEdges, sourced entirely from pre-template book entries (Aristotle 12, Heidegger and Rhetoric 12, Uexkull 10, Being and Time 9, BCAP 7, FCM 7, Rickert 7). Boredom Secondary's 165 unit-level tensions and its 12 documented debate axes contribute zero.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Enumerate, in the plan, every file the loader opens and its exact schema, and make each one a mandatory Phase-3 deliverable. If tensions/debates are to survive the new design, specify the exact contract; if the new design replaces tension edges with typed claim-to-claim edges, say so and delete the dead artifact from the layout.

defects.defect: 'global-edges.csv — all per-unit edges concatenated + deduped' and '3B global-edges.csv (concat + dedup)' specify a deduplication with no key. locus and note are the evidence-bearing columns; whether they participate in the key decides whether evidence survives.
defects.consequence_observed: Two executions of this identical instruction chose different keys. corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/global-edges.csv has 1,897 rows, exactly |distinct (source,relation,target)| over its 3,815 per-unit rows; |distinct (source,relation,target,locus)| is 1,915, so 18 rows differing ONLY in their page anchor were silently collapsed. corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/global-edges.csv has 1,129 rows, exactly |distinct (source,relation,target,locus)| over its 2,260 per-unit rows, losing 0. The repo's shared implementation hardcodes the destructive key: scripts/normalize-edges.py:268 keys on (source, relation, target, pipeline).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State the dedup key literally and make it evidence-preserving: merge on (source_record_id, relation, target_record_id) but UNION the locator set rather than discarding rows, so the merged edge carries every distinct locus and note it was derived from. Require the merge step to report rows_in, rows_out and loci_preserved, and fail if loci_preserved < loci_in.

defects.defect: '-edges.csv — columns source,relation,target,locus,note' is the only column declaration in the plan, it is stated once for the per-unit file, it is never restated for the aggregated global-edges.csv, and it contains no edge id, no source/target type discriminator and no provenance column despite §0 requiring provenance on every edge.
defects.consequence_observed: Four sibling clusters from the same lineage shipped four incompatible global-edges.csv headers: Boredom Secondary 'source,relation,target,locus,note,unit'; VR Pedagogy Secondary 'source,relation,target,locus,note'; RDR2 Secondary 'unit,source,relation,target,locus,note'; Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary 'edge_id,source_id,relation,target_id,domain,evidence_pdf_page,evidence_bekker_or_page,source_unit,contributor,notes'. Only Phantasia — the OLDEST, pre-template design — carries an edge id and separate evidence columns; the template abstracted that away. No cross-entry union of edges is possible.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Declare one canonical edge record with an id, typed endpoints (record ids, not display strings), relation from a closed global registry, a locator object, a provenance tag, a confidence/support tier, and the deriving unit. Use one physical format for per-source and aggregated edges so concatenation is trivially valid. Provide the header line verbatim in the plan and gate on exact header equality.

defects.defect: The compiler cannot fail. compile-corpus-index.py main() has no exit-code path and no error accumulation; every malformed input is either warn()-ed to stderr and skipped or silently dropped. Critically, parse_header_ontology (:513-551) returns [] for an unparsable file with NO warning at all — collect_ontology_nodes (:1217-1229) warns only when the FILE IS MISSING, so a present-but-unparsable ontology yields zero nodes and zero diagnostics. The gate is unfalsifiable.
defects.consequence_observed: Three clusters (Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary, RDR2 Secondary, Aristotelian Emotion Secondary) hold ontologies in a prose dialect the parser cannot read; corpus/index/Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary (1985-2017)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md has 41 identified concept nodes (PHX-C-001..041) and 22 reading nodes but 0 lines matching the parser's '#### N. Name' split. Registering it today would add zero nodes and print nothing. Four tension-edges.json files similarly yield zero with no warning because _normalize_tension_edge returns None on missing node_a/node_b without warning.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace 'compiler runs clean' with a validate-then-load step that exits non-zero, and specify the assertions: per-source expected record count declared in the manifest must equal loaded count; zero-yield for a registered source is a hard failure; every rejected record is written to a rejects file with a reason. Gate on the rejects file being empty, not on the process returning.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:227 ('cluster-ontology.md has a parseable ## 3A. Canonical Node List')
defects.defect: The gate measures the presence of a heading; the parser does not read the heading. For ontology_format 'header', compile-corpus-index.py:533-536 splits the WHOLE FILE on '^#### \d+\. ' or '^\*\*\d+\. ' — the '## 3A' heading is irrelevant (only _parse_header_tables at :554-566 restricts to 3A, and only for pipe tables). So the gate passes when a file has the heading and zero parseable nodes, and passes when a file has parseable nodes and no heading. It is uncorrelated with the thing it claims to verify.
defects.consequence_observed: Phantasia and RDR2 Secondary cluster-ontology.md files: 0 '#### N.' headers each. Meanwhile Social Presence, Presence Theory and Rhetoric of Interactivity pass with 10/10/7 nodes for entries whose _synthesis directory contains only README.md, citations.md, cluster-ontology.md, concept-matrix.csv and drafting-loci.md — the heading is present and the gate says nothing about the missing apparatus.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Never gate on a marker; gate on the loader's output. The check must be: run the loader, read back the count and a sampled record for this entry, and assert count == manifest-declared count and that a named spot-check record round-trips field-for-field.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:168-172 ('#### N. Name' + 'Replicate the Boredom/FCM structure exactly')
defects.defect: The instruction tells authors to copy an exemplar's surface form without telling them the exemplar's parenthetical slot is TYPED. _parse_header_section (:689-694) parses '#### N. Name (X)' and assigns X to the node's `greek` field, which build_canonical_terms (:1276-1305) then adds verbatim to the global canonicalTerms list — a corpus-wide, length-descending, greedy-match term list. Nothing in the plan reserves that slot or forbids bare English words as node names or parentheticals.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md: 20 of 60 '#### N.' headers carry a parenthetical, e.g. ':194 #### 3. Immersion (technological)' and ':290 #### 19. Conventional instruction (control)'. compiled-index.json now records node 'Immersion' with greek='technological' and node 'Conventional instruction' with greek='control', and the bare English words 'technological' and 'control' are live entries in the 1,722-term global canonicalTerms greedy-match list used corpus-wide.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Never instruct 'replicate the exemplar exactly' for a machine-parsed file. Give the field grammar explicitly, with each field's name, type and destination, and state which fields feed global matching. Add a gate that rejects any global-match term that is a common English word (stopword/frequency list) or shorter than a declared threshold, and require every node to carry an explicit id independent of its display name.

defects.defect: A claim/clause-level index must store the clause. The clause IS the verbatim. A blanket 25-word ceiling applied to every source in every entry makes the atomic unit of the target index unstorable, and it is applied undifferentiated across rights tiers — the same rule binds copyrighted secondary literature, the user's own MA thesis and dissertation, and public-domain Aristotle.
defects.consequence_observed: Nothing in 1,758 files carries a sentence offset, character span or bbox; the finest locator anywhere is a page, page range, Bekker line pair or video timestamp. Entries actively destroy evidence to comply: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/Calleja - From Immersion to Incorporation/ig-10-deep.json:434-441 records a content_filter_audit noting block quotes 'paraphrased', vignettes with 'no >=25-word verbatim reproduced', and canonical definitions retained only because they are '24-word ... under the 25-word ceiling per task constraint', '20-word ... under ceiling', '23-word ... under ceiling'. Uncomfortable Situations applies the same suppression.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace the blanket ban with a rights-tiered quotation policy plus a storage/display split. Tier the corpus (own-work / public-domain / licensed-copyright / third-party-copyright). Store the exact span with character offsets for EVERY tier as internal evidence; apply the word ceiling only to RENDERED output and only for the copyright tiers, with the record carrying a redaction flag. Make the span the primary key of the claim record, so the index is clause-addressable even where display is restricted.

defects.defect: The atom of the whole design is the SOURCE: one folder, one .md, one .json, one -edges.csv per source, all keyed by <PREFIX>NN. There is no per-claim or per-clause file, no record table, no record id namespace. Claims exist only as unnamed array elements inside a per-source JSON, addressable only by array position.
defects.consequence_observed: Across 27 entries: 355 unit-record files / ~320 distinct units and 372 unit analyses — roughly 7 records per source. The target is 50-500. Meanwhile the claim material is already written but unaddressable: VR Pedagogy has 233 structured readings against 1,277 provenance-tagged assertions in its own prose; Aristotle records 973 Bekker-anchored claim bullets and 2,323 distinct Bekker loci; Boredom Secondary's readings[] arrays hold 463 claim records that no schema names.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make the CLAIM the atom. Specify a per-source claims file (JSONL, one record per line, append-only) plus a per-source clause/span file, with the unit .md demoted to an optional human-readable rendering derived from the records. Require record counts per source in the 50-500 band and gate on records-per-1,000-source-words, not on prose length.

defects.defect: The per-unit deliverable is budgeted as PROSE (1,500-3,500w humanities, 1,000-2,500w empirical, 400-1,000w map) and the only quantitative floor per source is 12-35 edges. A 3,500-word paraphrastic synthesis cannot enumerate 50-500 addressable claims; the budget silently caps extraction density. The floors are also depth-tiered by document length, not by claim density.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary averages 8.4 structured readings per unit (463 across 55). The two entries closest to the target were built OUTSIDE this budget model: corpus/index/Dissertation/ carries 982 line-anchored claim records at roughly one record per 58 words, and corpus/index/Veri(dis)similitude (Salvo MA)/vds-claims-moves.md carries 157 claim rows at roughly one structured claim per 59 words.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace word budgets with record-density targets expressed as records per 1,000 source words (the Dissertation and Veri(dis)similitude entries both sit near 1 per 58-59 words — use that as the calibrated target), and set the per-source floor from the source's own word count rather than from a depth label. Make prose length an output of the record set, not an input constraint.

defects.defect: Two independent faults. (1) The floor is far below actual output, so it never binds and never detects a shortfall. (2) It counts rows AFTER deduplication, so a more destructive dedup key makes the gate EASIER to pass while destroying more evidence — the metric is anti-correlated with the property it should protect.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary: N=55 so the floor is 660; actual 1,897 (2.9x over). VR Pedagogy: N=34 so the floor is 408; actual 1,129 (2.8x over). Neither run could have failed this gate. Boredom's locus-blind dedup destroyed 18 evidence-distinct rows and the gate registered nothing because 1,897 still cleared 660.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Drop the multiple-of-N edge floor. Gate instead on (a) edges per 1,000 source words, (b) the fraction of edges whose both endpoints resolve to existing record ids, (c) the fraction of edges carrying at least one resolvable locator, and (d) loci_preserved == loci_in through the merge. Report all four numerically in a machine-readable metrics file.

defects.defect: Every threshold on this line degenerates or becomes unsatisfiable at N=1. '>=12*N deduplicated global edges' becomes 12 — trivially met and meaningless for a single article that should yield hundreds of claim edges. '8-12 documented debates' and '8-12 contested readings' require cross-source disagreement, which does not exist at N=1; the gate can only be satisfied by fabricating debates or by ignoring it. '>= max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations' becomes 10 — a single article cannot cite itself ten times, so the gate is unsatisfiable by construction. Only '>=50 terminology lemmas' survives.
defects.consequence_observed: The failure mode is already visible above N=1: corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md reports 'Intra-cluster citations >=15 -> actual 4' and rationalizes the miss as 'a finding, not a shortfall of the build'. When a gate cannot be met, executors reinterpret it rather than fail.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make every gate a per-source intensive quantity (records per 1,000 words, locator-resolution rate, schema-validity rate, cross-reference-integrity rate) so all of them are meaningful at N=1. Move genuinely cross-source measures (debates, contested readings, intra-cluster citation graph) into a separate OPTIONAL cluster-synthesis layer that is skipped entirely when N < a stated threshold, and state that skipping is a pass, not a waiver.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:68-70 (4-8 strands, merge strands with <3 members) and :81-88 (concordance axes)
defects.defect: The entire Phase -1 spine presupposes a multi-source cluster. Strand assignment (4-8 strands, <3-member strands merged) is undefined at N=1 and degenerate at N<12. The concordance axes are derived by asking what two things a lookup must connect ACROSS sources, and the concordance gate at :221-222 requires every unit to appear in >=1 cell — at N=1 the grid is a single column of one.
defects.consequence_observed: No single-source entry was ever built from this template; the three thinnest registered entries (Social Presence 10 nodes, Presence Theory 10, Rhetoric of Interactivity 7) instead abandoned the template's artifact set entirely, shipping only README.md, citations.md, cluster-ontology.md, concept-matrix.csv and drafting-loci.md — i.e. when the cluster machinery did not fit, executors silently dropped it rather than adapt it.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Design the new plan single-source-first: N=1 must be the DEFAULT path, complete and gate-passing on its own, with cluster-level synthesis as a strictly additive later phase over already-complete single-source entries. Replace 'strands' with intra-source structure (section/chapter/argument-arc) which exists at N=1.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:198-199 and :228 ('re-run the repo's verbatim-quote detector'; 'verbatim detector clean')
defects.defect: The named tool does not exist. A search of scripts/ finds no verbatim-quote detector (the only quote-adjacent script is scripts/substitute-quote-ids.py, which does something else); 'verbatim' appears in scripts/ only inside prompt text, a README, analyze-lanham.ts, icp-run.ts and render_style.py. The plan's only automated defence of its own central copyright rule is a reference to vapour.
defects.consequence_observed: The >=25-word ban is therefore enforced nowhere by machine, in any entry. Compliance is asserted per-unit by the authoring agent: corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md records 'per-unit agents verified (longest ~19 w)' — self-report, not measurement. 15 unverified-quotation defects were filed in the audit.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Do not name a tool the plan does not ship. Deliver the checker as part of the plan's artifact set (a script committed alongside), specify its exact invocation and its pass criterion, and make its output a required machine-readable file. If the new policy stores spans (see the rights-tiering item), the checker's job changes to validating span-to-source fidelity by exact string match against the retained extraction, which is both stronger and trivially automatable.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:54 (-1.1 inventory) and :162-165 (loci must carry page anchors)
defects.defect: The word 'offset' appears 0 times in the template and 0 times in the Boredom plan. The plan requires page anchors on both sides of edges but never requires establishing, recording or verifying the mapping between the PDF page index that pdftotext reports and the printed page number the citation must carry — and never notices that the mapping can be non-constant (front matter, inserts, multi-part volumes).
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Rickert - Ambient Rhetoric/rickert-structured/manifest.json:7 declares 'pdf_page_offset: 20', which is both wrong and non-constant (it drifts to 15). Aristotle: 33 of 34 unit records carry pdf_pages derived from a superseded linear offset with errors up to 47 pages, and the bekker-index has 101 of 188 loci off by more than 2 pages. The correct pattern exists but only in a non-template entry: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/us-literary-loci-concordance.json declares page_offset_rule 'book p.n = PDF p.n + 10'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Add a mandatory pre-extraction locator-calibration step per source: sample >=5 pages spread across the document, record (pdf_index, printed_page) pairs, assert the mapping is affine and constant, and if it is not, record a piecewise map. Store the map in the source's manifest record. Gate: every recorded locus must resolve through the declared map, and >=3 randomly sampled loci per source must be verified by string-matching the cited text on the mapped page.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:137-140 (pdftotext every source to the scratchpad; agents get the .txt path)
defects.defect: The extraction is mandated to a scratch directory and is treated as disposable tooling rather than as the addressing substrate. Nothing requires the .txt to be retained inside the entry, hashed, or version-pinned, even though every locus and every line anchor is defined relative to it.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/ records 588 line-range references (e.g. ig-10-incorporation.json:20 'Verified directly from /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt lines 5855-6285', :66 'source_lines_in_fulltext: 5949-5952'). /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt no longer exists. Roughly a thousand clause-adjacent pointers — the finest-grained addressing in the entire corpus — are unresolvable, and the entry's own falsification notes ('verified ABSENT from Ch.10 fulltext (no Varela...hits in lines 5855-6285)') can no longer be checked.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require the normalized full text to be a committed, immutable, hashed artifact of the entry (e.g. <entry>/_source/<source_id>.txt plus its sha256 and the extractor name+version), and require every span/line/char locator to name that artifact id. Gate: every locator's referenced text artifact exists and its hash matches. This single change would resurrect ~1,000 clause pointers in In-Game with one deterministic re-extraction.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:168-172 (§3A node bullets: definition, type, units, centrality)
defects.defect: The mandated node record has no id, no uniqueness requirement and no namespace. The compiler then merges nodes GLOBALLY by name.lower() across all entries (deduplicate_ontology_nodes, compile-corpus-index.py:1310-1349), concatenating their `text` provenance. Distinct concepts from distinct entries that happen to share a display string are fused into one record, and the fused record's definition is chosen by string length.
defects.consequence_observed: compiled-index.json contains fused nodes whose text field lists multiple entries, e.g. 'Boredom Secondary (Part III); Heidegger - Being and Time; Heidegger - The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics', 'Boredom Secondary (Part III); Rickert - Ambient Rhetoric', 'Aristotle - Complete Works; Heidegger - The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics; Heidegger and Rhetoric' — 20 such fused rows. No compiled node carries an id field at all; the only address for any node in the entire runtime index is its display name.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Mandate an explicit, entry-namespaced, immutable id on every node and every record (<ENTRY>-<KIND>-<NNN>), make ids the only join key, and treat name collisions as an EXPLICIT sameAs/alias edge authored deliberately, never as an automatic merge. Gate on id uniqueness within the entry and on id-collision across entries.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:167 ('author the synthesis layer YOURSELF in the main loop, not via subagents') and :205-207 (budget 1 + N + N)
defects.defect: Phase 3 — ontology dedup, global edge merge, debate map, concept matrix, concordance, terminology appendix, citation networks, five graphs and the evolution narrative — is required to be authored in a single main-loop context. The agent budget is source-linear (2N) with no sharding below the source and no merge protocol. This is workable at ~7 records per source and impossible at 50-500.
defects.consequence_observed: At the current density Boredom Secondary's Phase 3 already had to reconcile 2,588 sub-items and 3,815 edge rows in one loop, and the result was the locus-blind dedup (18 rows lost) and a 162-value uncontrolled stance vocabulary that no single pass caught. At the target density a 55-source cluster is 5,000-25,000 records — beyond any single context.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Specify a sharded, deterministic, idempotent synthesis: per-source records are authored independently and are complete on their own; aggregation is performed by a committed SCRIPT (not a model) that is re-runnable and reports rows_in/rows_out/rejects; any model-authored synthesis operates over the script's output and is itself sharded by axis with an explicit merge order. Require the aggregation to be re-run from scratch at the end and byte-compared to the committed artifact.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:7-10 ('a cheaper model (Sonnet) executes ... with minimal judgment calls'; 'do not stall'; 'write ****** UNVERIFIED: and continue') and :208-210 ('self-author any gaps')
defects.defect: The plan institutionalizes divergence. It routes under-determined decisions to a cheap model, forbids stalling, offers a placeholder as the universal escape, and instructs the main loop to SELF-AUTHOR any unit whose subagent no-opped (a documented ~1-in-8 event) — with no requirement to mark self-authored units as lower-fidelity, and no reconciliation pass that ever converts a placeholder into a verified value.
defects.consequence_observed: §8's first gate is 'no silent gaps', which is satisfied by file existence and is therefore satisfied equally by a self-authored stand-in. corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/boredom-construct-measure-concordance.json records datasetEntryStatus 'NOT BUILT ... Every column->channel mapping is a flagged ****** UNVERIFIED: pointer, never a verified correspondence' — an entire axis of the entry's designated payoff artifact is placeholders, permanently, with nothing scheduling repair. 44 dangling-reference defects were filed corpus-wide.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Keep no-stall, but make every deferral a first-class typed record: an unresolved marker must be a row in a machine-readable open-items file with an id, the blocking dependency, and the exact assertion that will close it. Require every record to carry a `derivation` field (agent-read / self-authored / inferred) and gate on the self-authored fraction. Add a mandatory reconciliation phase that re-runs when a named dependency lands, and gate the entry's status field on the open-items file being empty.

defects.defect: §8 is a markdown checkbox list addressed to the executing model. Nothing instructs the executor to EMIT the gate results as an artifact, in any format. There is therefore no evidence trail, no machine-readable metrics, and no way for a later reader or a later run to know which gates were checked, with what numbers, or whether any was waived.
defects.consequence_observed: Only 2 of 27 entries carry a quality-gates-report.md (Wendt - Design for Dasein, RDR2 Secondary) and NEITHER was built from this template; only 1 has machine-readable metrics. The template also abstracted away artifacts its own precedents produced unbidden: corpus/index/Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary (1985-2017)/_synthesis/render-validation.txt (mmdc version, per-graph node/edge counts against caps, PASS status) and the RDR2 gate table with an explicit 'Gates NOT fully met (reported honestly)' section. Neither Boredom Secondary nor VR Pedagogy Secondary produced either.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make gate evaluation an artifact, not a checklist: require _synthesis/gates.json (machine-readable: gate id, target, actual, pass, evidence path) plus a rendered gates report, both regenerated by a committed script. Make the entry's registration conditional on gates.json existing with zero failures, and preserve the RDR2 'gates not met, reported honestly' convention as a required section rather than a happy accident.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:226 ('5 Mermaid graphs render; cross-pipeline graph <=25 edges')
defects.defect: The gate names no command, no tool, no acceptance output and no evidence artifact — so 'render' is whatever the executor decides it means. (mmdc IS available in this environment at /home/dalton/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/mmdc, so the gate is checkable; the plan simply does not say how.)
defects.consequence_observed: The older Phantasia run emitted _synthesis/render-validation.txt naming '@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli v11.14.0 (mmdc)', the exact invocation and a per-graph PASS table. The template-built Boredom Secondary and VR Pedagogy Secondary shipped 5 .mmd files each and no render evidence at all. RDR2's report simply deferred: 'mmdc is not installed in this environment, so render-validation is deferred to the user's toolchain'.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Either name the exact command and require its output as a committed artifact, or drop the graphs from the mandatory set. Given that .mmd files reach no loader, treat them as optional human-facing renderings generated FROM the record set by a script, not hand-authored deliverables.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:78-79 ('This table is provisional; _synthesis/manifest.json written in Phase 0 is authoritative thereafter') and :218
defects.defect: The manifest is declared authoritative at Phase 0 and is never required to be re-derived from disk at the end. The plan also mandates a folder-per-unit layout at :127 but permits nested chapter units without saying so, so the manifest's unit list and the on-disk layout can diverge in shape as well as count. Gate :218 checks 'each with .md + .json + -edges.csv on disk' without specifying the enumeration.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/manifest.json declares totalAnalyticalUnits 55, but 45 units sit in top-level folders and 11 sit nested inside 'Hadjioannou (ed) - Heidegger on Affect (2019)/Ch01..Ch12'. The obvious enumeration (*/​*-edges.csv) finds 45 of 56 edge files; only */*/*-edges.csv finds the rest. Manifest counts were the single largest defect class in the audit (66 count-mismatch findings), and several manifests declare phases pending that are complete on disk while BCAP's section 3B statistics contradict its own companion CSV in every line.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require the manifest to be REGENERATED from disk by a committed script as the final step of every phase, with the hand-authored plan table kept only as `declared` alongside a `discovered` block, and gate on declared == discovered. Forbid nested unit folders or make nesting explicit in the record (a chapter is a source with a parent_source_id). Every count stated anywhere in the entry must be emitted by that script, never typed.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:90-98 (object types 'adapt names to the domain, keep <=12'; edge relations 'e.g. treats-<row-type>, operationalizes-<col-type>')
defects.defect: Every cluster invents its own type names and its own concordance-axis relation names, with no global registry, no reserved core set that must not be renamed, and no mapping requirement back to a canonical vocabulary. The result is that edges from two entries are not comparable and cannot be unioned, which defeats the 'every point of connection' half of the goal.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom coined treats-construct / operationalizes-measure / construct-measured-by / bridges-to-fcm / grounds-measure; VR Pedagogy coined its own construct-condition equivalents; Phantasia's edge file carries a `domain` column no sibling has; RDR2 concords to game elements. corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/ additionally carries TWO incompatible concept registries in one directory with zero ID overlap — concept-matrix.csv using C-US-01..40 and book-level-ontology.json using US-C-001..036.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship a global, versioned relation and type registry as an artifact of the plan. Entries may EXTEND it only by adding a registered subtype that declares its parent relation, and every extension must be written back to the registry file in the same commit. Gate: every relation string in every edge file resolves in the registry. Forbid more than one concept registry per entry and gate on id-space disjointness across registries.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:137-140 (pdftotext extraction; OCR-LOW flag) and :150 (OCR confidence field)
defects.defect: Extraction quality is captured as a single self-assessed 'ocr_confidence' string and an OCR-LOW flag for near-empty output. Nothing checks character-level fidelity — ligature loss, umlaut stripping, hyphenation, or encoding. The plan never uses the words encoding, ligature or diacritic.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/Calleja - From Immersion to Incorporation/ig-10-deep.json:425-430 itself documents the damage it had to repair by hand — 'difﬁ culty / difﬁ culties', 'sufﬁ cient', 'ﬁ gurative', 'intensiﬁ es', 'identiﬁ ed' — the known pypdfium2 fi/ff/fl drop. corpus/index/Von Uexkull .../uex-analysis/book-level-ontology.md:27 records 'Wohnhulle' for 'Wohnhülle', and that file is the one the compiler reads, so the corrupted orthography is what reaches runtime. compile-corpus-index.py:157-163 compounds this by silently falling back to latin-1 on UTF-8 failure, converting a decode error into mojibake with only a stderr warning. 13 encoding-corruption defects were filed.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Add a mandatory extraction-fidelity check to the calibration step: run a ligature/diacritic probe (search for 'fi'/'ff'/'fl'-adjacent malformations and for expected diacritics in the source's language), record extractor name+version and the probe result in the source manifest record, and fail the source if the probe trips. Forbid encoding fallbacks in the loader — a decode failure must be a hard error, not a silent latin-1 reinterpretation.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:81-88 ('normalized to <=15 labels' rows and columns) and :92 ('keep <=12 types')
defects.defect: The concordance is capped at <=15 x <=15 = 225 cells and the type vocabulary at <=12. These ceilings are calibrated for a human-browsable matrix, not for an index of every claim in a document. The instruction also normalizes each source's own term TO these labels, discarding the source's vocabulary into a free-text note — the exact granularity the goal requires is deliberately compressed away.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/boredom-construct-measure-concordance.json is an 11-construct x 12-measure grid standing in for 55 sources and 2,588 recorded sub-items — a ~200-cell summary of what should be tens of thousands of addressable connections. The source's own term survives only inside a prose note field with no schema.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Keep the small normalized axis set as a NAVIGATION layer, but require the source's own term to be a first-class field on the record (surface_form) alongside the normalized label, both indexed. Remove the cap on the number of canonical nodes; cap only what is rendered in a matrix view.

defects.defect: The plan mandates a .json twin for the ontology and the concordance. The compiler reads only the .md (compile-corpus-index.py:1221-1227 tries book-level-ontology.md then cluster-ontology.md, and nothing else). The .json twin is a decoy that looks canonical, invites authors to put richer structure in it, and reaches nothing. Nothing in the plan requires the twins to agree.
defects.consequence_observed: In-Game and Uncomfortable Situations each authored 18 canonical POSITIONS into book-level-ontology.json; all 36 reach nothing because only the .md twin is read. Uncomfortable's two registries disagree by construction (C-US-01..40 in the CSV, US-C-001..036 in the JSON).
defects.fix_for_new_plan: One source of truth per fact. Author the machine-readable form (JSON/JSONL) as canonical and GENERATE every .md rendering from it with a committed script; gate on the rendering being reproducible byte-for-byte from the canonical file. Never mandate two hand-authored twins.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:32-36 (bridge by unit id; '****** UNVERIFIED:' if the anchor does not exist) and :221-224
defects.defect: Bridges are authored as literal id strings into a foreign entry, with no requirement to validate that the target id exists, and with a placeholder escape when the target entry is absent. Gates :221-224 check that bridge edges are PRESENT, never that they RESOLVE.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary's entire dataset-channel axis is placeholders (datasetEntryStatus 'NOT BUILT', 'every column->channel mapping is a flagged ****** UNVERIFIED: pointer'). Corpus-wide, 44 dangling-reference defects were filed and 10 id-prefix-violation plus 10 id-collision defects, all downstream of ids being free-text strings that nothing resolves.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require a cross-reference integrity pass as a hard gate: every id referenced anywhere in the entry must resolve either to a record in this entry or to a record in a registered sibling entry; unresolvable references must be zero, or must be typed rows in the open-items file with a named blocking dependency. Ship the resolver as a committed script.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:190-197 (add one dict entry to TEXT_DIRS in scripts/compile-corpus-index.py)
defects.defect: Registration is a manual edit to a hardcoded Python dict, gated behind a human sign-off at the very END of the pipeline (:200-201, 'do LAST, then GATE'). Any entry whose shape does not fit the two supported ontology_format values ('header', 'table') is simply never registered, and the plan provides no path for such an entry other than reshaping it.
defects.consequence_observed: 8 of 27 entries are absent from TEXT_DIRS entirely: Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary, RDR2 Secondary, Aristotelian Emotion Secondary, Aristotelian Motion and Time Secondary, Dissertation, Game-Behavior Analysis Method, RDR2 (Salvo Playthrough), Veri(dis)similitude (Salvo MA) — including the two richest claim-level assets in the repo (Dissertation's 982 line-anchored claim records with an 8-tier support taxonomy, and Veri(dis)similitude's 157 stable-id claim rows). corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 Secondary (2019-2023)/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md states the reason outright: registering would require hand-authoring a node-format §3A, 'a semantic stretch', so the cluster is 'consumed directly by agents (read as files)' — i.e. its 506 edges, 10 debates and 65 lemmas reach no runtime.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make registration data-driven and automatic: an entry declares itself via a committed entry-manifest at a conventional path, and the loader discovers all entries by globbing for that manifest. No source-code edit, no hardcoded dict. Registration must happen at entry CREATION (a stub entry registers on day one and grows), not as a terminal step, so an unfinished entry is visible-and-empty rather than invisible.

defects.defect: The plan hardcodes a single rights assumption into an otherwise domain-general template. The corpus in fact spans the user's own unpublished work (Dissertation, Veri(dis)similitude, King & Salvo VLE), public-domain primary texts (Aristotle), and third-party copyrighted monographs — with wildly different quotation latitude.
defects.consequence_observed: The uniform ban suppressed verbatim in entries where it was unnecessary and shaped the entire index away from span-level storage. Two entries (In-Game, Uncomfortable Situations) carry explicit suppression audits; the Aristotle entry, where quotation is unrestricted, nonetheless records only Bekker loci and paraphrase bullets — 2,323 Bekker loci with line numbers and no stored clause text, despite Bekker line pairs already being a clause-level address system.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Add a required RIGHTS_TIER parameter per source (own-work / public-domain / licensed / third-party-copyright) recorded in the source manifest record, and bind the quotation and rendering policy to that tier rather than to the entry. Store spans universally; restrict display per tier.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:182-185 ('hard cap <=25 edges' on the cross-pipeline bridge graph)
defects.defect: The <=25 cap is stated once and is used for two different things — the RENDERED .mmd graph and, in effect, the entry's whole cross-entry bridge budget, since the graph is the only cross-pipeline artifact the plan requires. A rendering-legibility constraint has been promoted into a data-model constraint.
defects.consequence_observed: Bridge edges exist at the source level only (Boredom's bridges{} objects and bridges-to-fcm rows), and the cross-pipeline artifact for a 55-source cluster is a <=25-edge diagram. At claim level, cross-entry support/contest links between individual claims are the primary product, and 25 is off by orders of magnitude.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Separate the data cap from the render cap. Impose no cap on cross-entry edges in the record store; cap only what a given rendered view displays, and generate views by filtering (top-N by centrality/tier) rather than by limiting authorship.

defects.defect: The -00- overview unit is the only unit that lives outside the per-unit folder convention (in units/ rather than '<Author> - <Title> (<Year>)/'), and the plan never says whether it counts toward N. Every N-scaled gate is therefore ambiguous by one.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary's manifest declares totalAnalyticalUnits 55 while units/bor-sec-00-corpus-overview.md exists separately, and the entry has 45 top-level unit folders + 11 nested + the overview; the counts stated in the entry, the manifest and the gates cannot all be checked against one enumeration.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: State explicitly whether meta-records count toward N (recommend: no), give the overview the same physical shape as every other record so one enumeration works, and require the manifest's discovered counts to be script-generated with meta-records tagged and excluded from N.

unspecified_gaps: No schema, anywhere. The word 'schema' appears 0 times in the template and 0 times in the Boredom plan. Every JSON the plan mandates is specified as a list of key names at most; no element types, no required fields, no enums, no validator. Measured consequence: readings[] alone carries 8 distinct key-signatures across one cluster's 55 files.

No record identity. No plan line requires an id on any sub-record (constructs, measures, readings, concepts, interlocutors, tensions, edges, nodes, concordance cells). Executors invented ids for readings in 167 of 463 cases in Boredom and for none of the other six arrays; Wendt ended with 91 of 139 claim objects id-less and 20 colliding. compiled-index.json node records have no id field at all.

No controlled values. Fields that are obviously categorical — stance, type, tag, centrality, depth, disposition — are never bound to an enum. Boredom's readings[].stance holds 162 distinct values with 195 nulls.
No dedup key. 'concat + dedup' (:115, :173) never says on what. Two runs picked different keys; the shared helper scripts/normalize-edges.py:268 picks the destructive one.
No CSV contract for the aggregated file. The column list at :162 is stated for the per-unit file only; four sibling clusters shipped four different global-edges.csv headers.
No mention of tension-edges.json — the compiler's only edge input — in either plan.
No page-offset model. 'offset' appears 0 times. Nothing establishes or verifies the pdf-index to printed-page mapping, and nothing anticipates a non-constant mapping.
No locator resolvability requirement. Loci must be 'carried' (:164) but never resolved; no round-trip string match, no sampling check.

No durable extraction artifact. The .txt is written to the scratchpad (:138) and never required to be retained or hashed, though every line/char anchor depends on it. In-Game's 588 line anchors are already dead.
No encoding or ligature policy. 'encoding', 'ligature', 'diacritic' appear nowhere; the loader's silent latin-1 fallback is unaddressed.

No verbatim/quote storage model. The plan bans long quotation but never specifies how a permitted <=12-word anchor phrase is STORED (field name, exactness guarantee, link to the span it came from). Anchor phrases live in free-text notes.
No sentence, clause, character-offset or bbox locator type is defined or even named ('clause', 'span', 'bbox' all 0 occurrences).
No global relation/type registry. Each cluster coins its own axis relations and type names; nothing maps them back.
No uniqueness, namespacing or collision policy ('unique', 'namespace', 'collision' all 0 occurrences), which is why global name-based merging in the compiler silently fuses entries.
No definition of what makes an entry 'registered' beyond a hand edit to a Python dict, and no stub/partial registration state.

No provenance field on the record. §0 mandates three provenance tags in prose but no plan line makes provenance a required, enumerated FIELD on any record; it appears as an ad-hoc 'tag' on some readings and as parenthetical text inside note strings elsewhere.
No derivation/fidelity marker distinguishing an agent-read record from a main-loop self-authored stand-in, despite :208-210 explicitly instructing self-authoring of gaps.
No gate-evidence artifact. §8 never says to write the results anywhere; 2 of 27 entries have a gates report and neither is template-built.
No render command or evidence for the Mermaid gate.
No reconciliation pass for '****** UNVERIFIED:' placeholders; nothing converts them, tracks them, or fails on them.
No manifest re-derivation from disk; the Phase-0 manifest is declared authoritative and never reconciled.
No policy for nested/chapter units, though the exemplar cluster has 11 of them.
No rights tiering; a single copyright assumption is hardcoded for a template meant to process 'ANY folder'.
No single-source (N=1) path; every structural device (strands, debates, contested readings, intra-cluster citations, concordance grid) presupposes a multi-source cluster.
No idempotency or re-run contract. Nothing says what happens on a second execution over an existing entry, so incremental growth of an index is undefined.
design_inputs: Define the runtime record contract BEFORE any authoring instruction, and ship it as a committed machine-checkable schema file (JSON Schema or equivalent) that the plan references by path. Nothing may be mandated as a deliverable unless a named loader reads it.

Make the CLAIM the atomic record, not the source. Per source emit an append-only JSONL claims file with one record per line. Required fields per claim: id (namespaced <ENTRY>-<SOURCE>-CL-<NNNN>, immutable), source_id, claim_text (the assertion, ours), locator (object, see below), span_ref (id of the exact clause span it rests on), support_tier (closed enum), provenance (closed enum FE / FAITHFUL / P-anticipatory-application), stance (closed enum), surface_form (the source's own term/wording), derivation (agent-read / self-authored / inferred), confidence.

Adopt the Dissertation entry's proven support taxonomy as the enum baseline: 8 tiers with T1 textually-confirmed / T3 interpretive-flagged / T7 overreach as the anchors, since it is the only working claim schema in the repo (982 records, 100% line-anchored, 76% in an explicit supports/supported_by graph, 841 typed edges, 235 cached verbatims with insertion_anchor).

Calibrate density from the two entries that already hit the target: Dissertation at ~1 record per 58 words and Veri(dis)similitude at ~1 structured claim per 59 words. Set the per-source floor as records per 1,000 source words derived from those, and delete the prose word budgets (template :154-155) that currently cap extraction at ~8.4 claims per source.

Define a LOCATOR OBJECT with a declared type and require the finest type the source supports: {text_artifact_id, sha256, page_printed, page_pdf, char_start, char_end, line_start, line_end, bekker_start, bekker_end, timestamp_ms}. Require char_start/char_end (clause level) for every claim in a source with extractable text; permit degradation to page only with an explicit reason code.

Require a per-source LOCATOR CALIBRATION step before extraction: sample >=5 spread pages, record (pdf_index, printed_page) pairs, assert affine and constant, store the mapping in the source record, and record a piecewise map when it drifts. Model the good pattern already on disk: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/us-literary-loci-concordance.json's page_offset_rule 'book p.n = PDF p.n + 10'. This directly prevents the Rickert offset-20-and-drifting and Aristotle 47-page-error classes.

Commit the normalized full text as an immutable, hashed artifact inside the entry (<entry>/_source/<source_id>.txt + sha256 + extractor name and version), and require every locator to name that artifact id. Gate: every referenced text artifact exists and its hash matches. This alone would resurrect ~1,000 clause pointers in In-Game (Calleja 2011) by one deterministic re-extraction.

Add an extraction-fidelity probe to calibration: test for the pypdfium2 fi/ff/fl ligature drop (In-Game's own ig-10-deep.json documents 'difﬁ culty', 'sufﬁ cient', 'ﬁ gurative') and for expected diacritics (Uexkull's runtime-reaching 'Wohnhulle' for 'Wohnhülle'). Fail the source rather than repair the text. Forbid any encoding fallback in the loader; a decode failure is a hard error.

Replace the blanket '>=25-word verbatim' ban with a rights-tiered policy. Add RIGHTS_TIER per source (own-work / public-domain / licensed / third-party-copyright) to the source record. Store the exact clause span for EVERY tier as internal evidence, with a redaction flag; apply word ceilings only to RENDERED output and only for the restricted tiers. Retire the current rule that forced In-Game to truncate canonical definitions to 24/23/20 words and to paraphrase block quotes out of existence.

Mandate a SPANS file per source (JSONL: span_id, text_artifact_id, char_start, char_end, exact_text, page_printed, redaction_flag) as the physical carrier of clause-level evidence, and make every claim and every edge point at span ids. This is the single missing artifact type: nothing in 1,758 files currently carries a character span.

Give every record and node a namespaced immutable id and make ids the ONLY join key. Ban name-based merging: same-name concepts across entries must be linked by an explicit authored sameAs edge. Gate on id uniqueness within an entry and report id collisions across entries (the current loader fuses by name.lower() and has produced 20 cross-entry fused nodes with concatenated provenance and no ids at all).

Ship a global, versioned RELATION AND TYPE REGISTRY as a plan artifact. Entries may only extend it by adding a subtype that declares its parent, written back to the registry in the same commit. Gate: every relation string resolves in the registry. This makes edges from Boredom (treats-construct), VR Pedagogy, Phantasia (domain-tagged) and RDR2 unionable, which they currently are not.

Specify ONE canonical edge record and one physical format used identically at per-source and aggregated level: edge_id, source_record_id, relation, target_record_id, locator(s) (a SET, never a scalar), provenance, support_tier, deriving_unit. Provide the header line verbatim in the plan and gate on exact header equality. Four sibling clusters currently ship four different headers.

Specify the merge as evidence-preserving and implement it in a committed script: merge on (source_record_id, relation, target_record_id) and UNION locator sets rather than dropping rows. Emit rows_in, rows_out, loci_in, loci_preserved and fail when loci_preserved < loci_in. This is the exact defect that cost Boredom 18 locus-distinct rows while VR Pedagogy, from the same instruction, lost none.

Make registration data-driven: every entry declares itself in a committed entry-manifest at a conventional path and the loader discovers entries by glob. Delete the hand-edited TEXT_DIRS step. Register at entry CREATION so an unfinished entry is visible-and-empty, never invisible. Eight of 27 entries — including the two richest claim assets, Dissertation (982 claims) and Veri(dis)similitude (157 claims) — are currently invisible for want of a dict line.

Make the machine-readable file canonical and GENERATE every .md rendering from it with a committed script; gate on byte-reproducibility of the rendering. Never mandate two hand-authored twins (the current cluster-ontology.{md,json} and concordance {md,json} pairs, where the .json twin reaches nothing and In-Game's and Uncomfortable's 18+18 JSON-only positions are lost).

Replace 'compiler runs clean' with validate-then-load that EXITS NON-ZERO. Required assertions: manifest-declared record count per source == loaded count; zero-yield for a registered source is a hard failure; every rejected record is written to a rejects file with a reason; gate on the rejects file being empty. The current compiler cannot fail and returns [] silently for an unparsable ontology.

Replace every N-scaled cluster threshold with per-source intensive metrics that are meaningful at N=1: records per 1,000 source words; percent of claims with a char-span locator; percent of edges whose endpoints both resolve; percent of records passing schema validation; percent of sampled loci that round-trip by exact string match; percent of records with derivation=self-authored. Move debates, contested readings and intra-cluster citation graphs into an optional additive cluster layer skipped below a stated N, where skipping is a pass.

Make N=1 the DEFAULT and complete path. A single article must produce a fully valid, fully gated, registered entry with no strands, no concordance grid, no debate map and no cross-source citation network. Cluster synthesis becomes a later, purely additive pass over already-complete single-source entries.

Emit gate results as artifacts: _synthesis/gates.json (gate id, target, actual, pass, evidence path) plus a rendered report, both produced by a committed script, with registration conditional on zero failures. Preserve RDR2's 'Gates NOT fully met (reported honestly)' section as a REQUIRED section. Only 2 of 27 entries currently have any gates report.

Ship every checker the plan names. Do not reference a 'repo verbatim-quote detector' that does not exist. Deliver: the schema validator, the locator resolver, the cross-reference integrity checker, the merge script, the manifest regenerator, the gates reporter — all committed alongside the plan with exact invocations.

Require the manifest to be REGENERATED from disk at the end of every phase, with the hand-authored plan table retained as `declared` beside a script-produced `discovered` block, and gate on declared == discovered. Every count stated anywhere in the entry must be script-emitted, never typed. Count-mismatch was the largest defect class (66 findings) and Boredom's 55-vs-45-vs-11-nested layout is the canonical instance.

Make deferral typed and closable: every '****** UNVERIFIED:' becomes a row in a machine-readable open-items file carrying an id, the blocking dependency, and the exact assertion that closes it. Add a reconciliation phase triggered when a dependency lands, and gate entry status on the file being empty. Boredom's entire dataset-channel concordance axis is currently permanent placeholders with nothing scheduling repair.

Require a `derivation` field on every record and gate on the self-authored fraction, so the documented ~1-in-8 subagent no-op cannot silently become fabricated analysis that passes the 'no silent gaps' file-existence check.

Specify sharded, deterministic, idempotent aggregation. Per-source records must be complete and valid independently; all aggregation is performed by a re-runnable script, not a model; any model-authored synthesis operates over the script's output and is sharded by axis with a declared merge order; the aggregation is re-run from scratch at the end and byte-compared. Main-loop authoring of the synthesis layer (template :167) does not survive a 5,000-25,000-record cluster.

Define the re-run/growth contract explicitly: what happens on a second execution over an existing entry, how new records are appended without renumbering, how ids are reserved, and how a revised source (new extraction, corrected offset) invalidates and re-anchors dependent records. The index must be growable, not a one-shot build.

Separate DATA caps from RENDER caps everywhere. No cap on cross-entry edges, canonical nodes, concordance cells or claim records in the store; caps apply only to a given generated view, produced by filtering on tier/centrality. Retire the <=25 cross-pipeline edge cap, the <=15 x <=15 concordance axes and the <=12 object types as data constraints.

Preserve the source's own wording as a first-class indexed field (surface_form) alongside the normalized canonical label, so normalization to a small axis vocabulary stops discarding the granularity the goal requires.

Reserve and document every machine-parsed slot in any human-authored format the plan retains. If a node heading has a parenthetical, state its type and destination. Add a gate rejecting any global-match term that is a common English word or below a length threshold — the rule that would have caught 'technological' and 'control' entering the 1,722-term corpus-wide greedy-match list from 20 parentheticals in VR Pedagogy's ontology.

Enumerate in the plan every file the loader opens with its exact schema, and make each one a mandatory deliverable. Add a coverage gate that classifies every file in the entry as READ-BY-LOADER or HUMAN-ONLY and fails below a declared read-by-loader threshold. Today 35.3 MB across 1,759 files compiles to a 664 KB name-only index.
what_to_preserve: GATE G0 (:100-103): Phase -1 emits a filled, cluster-specific spec to plans/ and STOPS for user sign-off before any building. This is the cheapest correction point in the whole pipeline and it worked — the Boredom run's scope, axes and anchors were fixed before 55 agents ran.
GATE G1 (:200-201) and the no-commit-before-sign-off rule (:229), together with mandatory timestamped .backups/ before touching any tracked file (:189).

manifest.json -> planCorrections (:214). Genuinely excellent and demonstrably used: Boredom's manifest records two substantive mid-run corrections with files, resolution and 'User-approved 2026-07-14' — including catching that a file the plan assumed was a single extracted paper was in fact a 727-page proceedings volume byte-identical to another entry. Keep this verbatim, and extend it to record schema deviations.

The three-tag provenance discipline (:38-42): FE for the source's own claim, FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> for a close paraphrase of a specific passage with a page anchor, and P / anticipatory-application for our own interpretive links, with every bridge claim tagged anticipatory-application and never presented as the source's own. Promote it from prose convention to a required enumerated FIELD.

Anchor discipline (:30-36): bridge, never re-digest; cite the anchor's own unit ids; find the anchor's canonical id list before authoring. This is the correct instinct for a connected index and should be strengthened into a resolved-reference requirement.

The de-duplication and haystack rubric (:57-67): identical md5 DROP, same-study MERGE with a dup-variant note, >300pp proceedings HAYSTACK with grep-locate and -f/-l re-extraction, HAYSTACK-UNRESOLVED flag. Concrete, mechanical, and it worked.

Mandatory pdftotext pre-extraction with agents given the .txt path and never the PDF (:138-140), explicitly to avoid image-payload cost and the multi-page-image API-400 failure. Keep the mechanism; upgrade the .txt from scratch file to committed hashed artifact.

The documented reliability lesson (:208-210): pre/post-task hooks intermittently no-op a subagent about 1 in 8, so verify all three files exist on disk for every unit after each batch before proceeding. Keep the verification; replace 'self-author any gaps' with a typed derivation marker and a re-dispatch.

The no-stall doctrine with an explicit escape (:8-10) — record the judgment call and continue, write '****** UNVERIFIED:' rather than block. Keep the doctrine; make the escape a typed, closable open-item rather than a free-text string.

Giving each Phase-2 agent an explicit context bundle (:211-213): the .txt path, its id/slug/strand/depth, the controlled vocabulary, the axes, the floors, the anchor id list, the provenance tags, plus one exemplar trio named as the quality bar. The bundle idea is right; the exemplar must be a schema-valid record set rather than a prose file to imitate.

The 'Not treated:' line ending every unit .md (:158) — explicitly recording which canonical nodes a source does NOT touch. This is negative evidence and it is rare and valuable; make it a structured absence record, since 'every weakness' in the stated goal requires it.

Depth tiering with two-pass treatment for long works (:76-77, :152) and chapter-selective reading of monographs and edited volumes — Boredom's Hadjioannou volume correctly became 11 addressable chapter units rather than one opaque record.
Verifying compiled counts by READING compiled-index.json rather than assuming (:198-199). The instinct is exactly right; it just needs a machine assertion behind it instead of a human glance.

The artifacts the template ABSTRACTED AWAY and must be restored: _synthesis/render-validation.txt (Phantasia — names the mmdc version, the exact invocation, and per-graph node/edge counts against caps) and _synthesis/quality-gates-report.md (RDR2 — a gate/target/actual/pass table PLUS an explicit 'Gates NOT fully met (reported honestly)' section). Both were produced without being required, and both stopped appearing once the template replaced the hand-written plans.

From the Boredom precedent specifically: hand-authored, concrete axis label lists and debate-axis seeds stated as real propositions (§3 :147-158, §4 :175-179), the file-by-file de-dup disposition table with reasons (§1B :89-97), and the §9 'Decisions to confirm — reasoned recommendations, push back freely' section. Rubric-driven derivation is cheaper but demonstrably lossier; the new plan should keep a hand-authored, user-signed-off vocabulary layer.

gates_assessment.gate: N units, each with .md + .json + -edges.csv on disk (no silent gaps); de-dup/haystack dispositions recorded in `excluded` (TEMPLATE:218)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Trivially true — one folder with three files passes. Says nothing about content.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Meaningless. File existence is orthogonal to whether 50-500 addressable claim records exist inside; the three-file-per-source layout is itself the granularity ceiling.
gates_assessment.verdict: WRONG TARGET. Checks presence, not content, provenance or validity, and is satisfied equally by a main-loop self-authored stand-in (which :208-210 explicitly instructs). Also under-specified as to enumeration: Boredom's 11 nested chapter units are invisible to the obvious glob (45 of 56 edge files found). Replace with: schema-validity rate, record count vs manifest-declared, and self-authored fraction.

gates_assessment.gate: >= 12*N deduplicated global edges (TEMPLATE:219)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Floor = 12 edges. Trivially met and absurdly low for a source that should yield hundreds of claim-level connections.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Off by 1-2 orders of magnitude. 12 edges per source against 50-500 claim records per source is roughly 1-2% of target connectivity.
gates_assessment.verdict: NON-BINDING AND PERVERSE. Boredom N=55 floor 660 vs actual 1,897 (2.9x); VR Pedagogy N=34 floor 408 vs actual 1,129 (2.8x) — neither run could have failed. Worse, it counts POST-dedup rows, so a more destructive dedup key makes the gate easier to pass: Boredom's locus-blind key destroyed 18 evidence-distinct rows and the gate registered nothing. Replace with edges per 1,000 source words, endpoint-resolution rate, locator-carriage rate, and loci_preserved == loci_in.

gates_assessment.gate: 8-12 documented debates (TEMPLATE:219, artifact at :116/:173)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: UNSATISFIABLE OR FABRICATION-INDUCING. A documented cross-source disagreement requires >=2 sources; at N=1 the only ways to pass are to invent debates or to ignore the gate.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: A fixed 8-12 band is independent of N and of claim count — it is as easy at N=55 as at N=8, and it caps rather than scales the recorded disagreement, which is precisely the 'every weakness' half of the goal.
gates_assessment.verdict: VACUOUS AT N=1, NON-SCALING ABOVE IT, AND THE ARTIFACT REACHES NOTHING. debate-map.{md,json} is read by no code; Boredom's 12 axes contribute 0 of the 64 compiled tensionEdges. Move to an additive cluster layer, express as claim-to-claim contests edges in the record store, and make the runtime channel real.

gates_assessment.gate: 8-12 contested readings (TEMPLATE:219, artifact at :118/:175)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Unsatisfiable for the same reason as debates — contestation is inter-source.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Fixed band, unrelated to the number of claims; contested-readings.md is prose and carries no ids.
gates_assessment.verdict: VACUOUS AT N=1; UNREACHABLE AT RUNTIME. Replace with a typed contests/qualifies/concedes edge between claim records, counted as a rate.

gates_assessment.gate: >= 50 terminology lemmas (TEMPLATE:220, artifact at :122/:176-178)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: The only §8 quantity that survives N=1 in principle, though 50 lemmas from one article is arbitrary and unrelated to that article's actual lexical range.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Lemma count is a vocabulary metric, not an indexing metric; it does not track claims, clauses or connections at all.
gates_assessment.verdict: SURVIVES BUT IRRELEVANT, AND UNREACHABLE. Boredom shipped 72 lemmas and VR Pedagogy 79; both terminology appendices are read by no code. Fold lemmas into the node/term layer that the loader actually consumes, with per-lemma ids and loci.

gates_assessment.gate: >= max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations (TEMPLATE:220)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: UNSATISFIABLE BY CONSTRUCTION — floor is 10 and a single source cannot cite itself ten times.
