gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Measures a real property (cluster connectivity) but at source granularity only; it says nothing about claim-to-claim linkage.
gates_assessment.verdict: UNSATISFIABLE AT N=1 AND ALREADY REINTERPRETED IN PRACTICE. RDR2's quality-gates-report records 'Intra-cluster citations >=15 -> actual 4' and reframes the miss as 'a finding, not a shortfall of the build' — the observable failure mode of an unmeetable gate. Move to the optional cluster layer with an explicit skip-is-pass rule below a stated N.

gates_assessment.gate: Concordance complete: every row -> >=1 anchor-1 node, every column -> >=1 anchor-2 channel (or `****** UNVERIFIED:`); every unit appears in >=1 concordance cell (TEMPLATE:221-222)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Degenerate — a one-source grid; and the row/column axes themselves are derived from cross-source normalization that does not exist at N=1.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: The <=15 x <=15 cap (:85) makes the concordance a <=225-cell summary; at claim level it is a navigation aid, not an index.
gates_assessment.verdict: SELF-DEFEATING ESCAPE CLAUSE. The parenthetical '(or ****** UNVERIFIED:)' means the gate passes when the mapping is entirely absent. Boredom's concordance JSON states datasetEntryStatus 'NOT BUILT ... Every column->channel mapping is a flagged ****** UNVERIFIED: pointer, never a verified correspondence' — the gate passed with a whole axis unmapped, permanently, and the artifact reaches no runtime. Replace with a cross-reference integrity gate requiring zero unresolved ids or typed closable open-items.

gates_assessment.gate: Every anchor-reading-strand unit carries >=1 bridge edge to a specific anchor unit id; every column-relevant unit carries >=1 column-axis edge (TEMPLATE:223-224)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Applies per unit, so it survives N=1 — the best-formed gate in §8.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Right shape, wrong granularity: one bridge per SOURCE, where the target requires bridges per claim.
gates_assessment.verdict: CORRECT INSTINCT, NOT VALIDATED. Checks presence, never resolution — nothing verifies the cited anchor unit id exists. 44 dangling-reference defects corpus-wide. Keep the per-unit form, scale it to per-claim, and add id resolution.

gates_assessment.gate: No >=25-word verbatim; provenance tags present throughout; every bridge/cross-pipeline claim tagged anticipatory-application (TEMPLATE:225)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Unchanged — but so is its unenforceability.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: ACTIVELY HOSTILE. A clause-level record IS a verbatim span; this rule forbids storing the target unit of the index.
gates_assessment.verdict: UNMEASURABLE AND POINTED THE WRONG WAY. The named checker does not exist (no verbatim detector anywhere in scripts/), so compliance is self-reported ('per-unit agents verified (longest ~19 w)' — RDR2). Its observable effect is evidence destruction: In-Game's content_filter_audit records block quotes paraphrased away and canonical definitions kept only because they are 24, 23 and 20 words 'under ceiling'. 'Provenance tags present throughout' is likewise unmeasurable because provenance is nowhere a required field. Replace with rights-tiered storage-vs-display and an exact-string span-fidelity checker that is shipped with the plan.

gates_assessment.gate: 5 Mermaid graphs render; cross-pipeline graph <= 25 edges (TEMPLATE:226)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Five graphs over one source are degenerate or empty.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: A <=25-edge cap on the cross-pipeline graph, conflated with the bridge budget, is orders of magnitude below claim-level cross-entry linkage.
gates_assessment.verdict: CHECKABLE IN PRINCIPLE, UNSPECIFIED IN PRACTICE, AND MEASURES A RENDERING. mmdc IS available (/home/dalton/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0/bin/mmdc) but the gate names no command and requires no evidence: Phantasia (pre-template) emitted render-validation.txt with tool version and per-graph counts; Boredom and VR Pedagogy emitted nothing; RDR2 deferred it outright. Graphs reach no loader — demote to generated views and separate the render cap from any data cap.

gates_assessment.gate: cluster-ontology.md has a parseable `## 3A. Canonical Node List` (TEMPLATE:227)
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_N1: Unchanged and equally uninformative.
gates_assessment.behaviour_at_claim_level: Node lists are concept-level; they carry no claims, no loci and no quotes, so a passing §3A says nothing about claim coverage.

what_the_plan_actually_specifies:
The governing entry-creation plan is plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md, a parameterised, Sonnet-executable procedure that turns a folder of PDFs into one `corpus/index/<CLUSTER_NAME>/` directory. §P (:14-24) takes SOURCE_DIR, CLUSTER_NAME, PREFIX, PURPOSE, ANCHORS, ANCHOR_EDGE_NAMES. §0 (:30-45) fixes anchor discipline ("bridge, never duplicate"), the three provenance tags (FE / FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> / P·anticipatory-application), and a copyright ceiling (no ≥25-word verbatim; ≤12-word anchor phrases with a page).

Phase −1 (:49-103) is a survey that self-authors the cluster spec: inventory by pdfinfo/md5/pdftotext, a de-dup + haystack rubric, 4-8 thematic strands, an authoritative unit table (id, slug, folder, author, year, title, pp, strand, depth ∈ deep|deep-long|map), a two-axis "primary-object concordance" (≤15 row labels × ≤15 column labels), and a controlled vocabulary of ≤12 object types plus ~15 edge relations. It ends at GATE G0: present the spec, wait for sign-off.

Phase 0-5 (:135-201) is the executable core. Phase 0 pdftotexts every source into the scratchpad and writes phase0-overview.md + manifest.json. Phase 1 emits per-source metadata JSON. Phase 2 emits, per unit, a trio: a 400-3,500-word paraphrastic .md, a unit .json whose keys are `{id, slug, citation, discipline, strand, depth, thesis, sections, constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges:{}, extraction:{}}`, and an edges.csv with columns `source,relation,target,locus,note` under edge floors (map ≥12 / deep ≥20 / deep-long ≥35). Phase 3 is authored in the main loop in five waves: 3A cluster-ontology.{md,json} whose .md must carry a `## 3A. Canonical Node List` in `#### N. Name` + `- **key**: value` header format ("the compiler parses this section"); 3B global-edges.csv + debate-map; 3C concept-matrix.csv + contested-readings; 3D the concordance + a ≥50-lemma terminology appendix; 3E citation networks, five .mmd graphs, a scholarly-evolution arc. Phase 4 writes bridge-sources/anchor-pointers.md (pointers only) and a ≤25-edge cross-pipeline graph. Phase 5 (:187-201) adds one dict entry to TEXT_DIRS in scripts/compile-corpus-index.py, runs the compiler, verifies node/term counts by reading compiled-index.json, and stops at GATE G1 for sign-off before commit.

§7 (:205-214) is orchestration: Agent tool not Workflow; budget 1 + N + N agents; a stated ~1/8 subagent no-op rate mitigated by pre-extracting to .txt and verifying "all three files exist on disk"; deviations recorded in manifest.planCorrections. §8 (:216-229) is the gate list: N unit trios on disk; ≥12·N deduplicated edges; 8-12 debates; 8-12 contested readings; ≥50 lemmas; ≥max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations; concordance completeness; ≥1 bridge edge per anchor-reading unit; no ≥25-word verbatim and "provenance tags present throughout"; 5 graphs render; a parseable §3A node list; compiler clean; counts verified; backups; G0 and G1 sign-offs.

The per-book siblings (uncomfortable-situations-2017-analysis.md, in-game-calleja-2011-analysis.md, wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md) follow the same shape with per-entry object types and their own edge-CSV column sets and volume targets. plans/index-system-implementation-plan-2026-07-28.md is the downstream repair programme: it diagnoses that the authored unit/edge/apparatus layer reaches runtime at zero, and proposes (N3.1, :324) "a canonical unit record — id, entry, title, locus range, concepts, arguments, claims, edges, provenance" and (W5.1, :408) emitting unit records into the compiled output.

defects.defect: The deepest record the plan ever asks an author to create is the UNIT — one per source, chapter or extracted paper. Every claim-bearing structure is a bare array name nested inside that unit JSON (:159-161 `readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[]`). The plan has no claim record, no claim id, no claim gate, and no claim yield target. Claim-level material therefore exists only as a by-product of prose authoring.
defects.consequence_observed: ~320 distinct units for ~265 sources across 27 entries, but claim-level content is stranded: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III) holds 233 structured `readings` against 1,136 provenance-tagged assertions written in the .md prose of the same entry (4.9x more claim-level content unstructured than structured). corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III) holds 463 readings across 55 units (8.4 per source). corpus/index/Wendt - Design for Dasein/units/*.json holds 139 claim objects of shape {text, locus} and nothing finer.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Make the CLAIM the unit of authorship and the unit of gating. The unit record becomes a container that declares its claim id range and its yield. Set a measurable yield floor derived from what already works: corpus/index/Dissertation achieves 1 claim record per ~58 words and Veri(dis)similitude 1 structured row per ~59 words. Require ≥1 claim record per 150 words of source body for `deep` units and ≥1 per 400 for `map`, computed by script from the extracted text layer's word count, and fail the entry if the ratio is not met.

defects.defect: The unit JSON is specified as a list of top-level key NAMES with no element schema, no required fields, no types, and no id requirement: `{... constructs[], measures[], readings[], concepts[], interlocutors[], tensions[], bridges:{<anchor-key>:[...]}, extraction:{tool, date, ocr_confidence}}`. Every executing agent invented the element shape, and each invented a different one.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III): 2,924 sub-items across 55 unit JSONs in 42 distinct element shapes — readings 8 shapes (257×{claim,locus,stance,tag,type}, 167×{id,locus,text}, 12×{loci,summary,target_fcm_unit}, 8×{claim,page,provenance}, …), constructs 5, measures 7, concepts 6 (87 of them bare strings), interlocutors 5 (146 bare strings), sections 6, tensions 5. The locus key alone is spelled four ways across the same entry: `locus` 2,016, `page` 333, `loci` 187, `pages` 26. corpus/index/Heidegger - The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics splits the same field two ways: 142×{id,locus,text} vs 33×{claim,id,locus}.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship a JSON Schema file with the plan and make `validator exits 0` a hard gate. Every nested array element gets a named record type with required fields and types. One canonical field name per concept — `claim_text` never `text`/`claim`/`tx`/`statement`; `locus` object never `locus`/`page`/`loci`/`pages` strings. Bare-string elements are a schema violation, not a shorthand.

defects.defect: The only specification of the position/claim record in the whole per-book plan family is one line: "`positions`: list of {claimant, claim, support, contested_by}". No id, no locus, no stance, no tier, no provenance tag.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations ships 55 positions in SIX mutually incompatible shapes across six unit files: us-00-intro.json {claim,claimant,contested_by,support_evidence}; us-03-radcliffe.json {claim,claimant,contested_by,position_id,support}; us-04-austen.json {claim,id,support_loci,tier}; us-01-darwin.json {gloss,id,label,pdf_pages}; us-02-equiano.json {advocate,id,opposition,pdf_locus,stance}; us-05-epilogue.json {anchor,claim,contributor,id,tier,type}. Only one of the six carries a position_id; only one carries support_loci. A seventh shape, {id,claimant,canonical_statement,support_units,centrality_tier}, holds the 18 canonical positions in _synthesis/book-level-ontology.json.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: A single canonical CLAIM record used by every unit, every entry and every phase; per-entry object-type lists may extend the `claim_kind` enum but may not redefine the record.

defects.defect: The plan instructs authors to emit `cluster-ontology.{md,json}` / `book-level-ontology.{md,json}` — a JSON twin the compiler never opens. scripts/compile-corpus-index.py:1216-1227 reads only `book-level-ontology.md`, falling back to `cluster-ontology.md`; the string `ontology.json` appears nowhere in its 1,412 lines. The plan states the .md is "the compiler input" but never states that the .json is consumed by nothing.
defects.consequence_observed: Canonical POSITIONS authored into JSON reach zero runtime nodes: In-Game 18 and Uncomfortable Situations 18 (verified — compiled-index.json holds 36 Uncomfortable nodes, exactly its 36 .md concept sections, and 0 positions). Three unregistered clusters ship structured ontology JSON no parser can read: Phantasia Secondary 41 concepts, Emotion Secondary 40, RDR2 Secondary 21. Uncomfortable additionally carries two disjoint concept registries in one directory — _synthesis/concept-matrix.csv C-US-01..C-US-40 (40 rows) versus book-level-ontology.{md,json} US-C-001..US-C-036 (36) — with zero ID overlap.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every artifact the plan tells an author to write must name its consumer as `file:function`, or be explicitly labelled human-only. If the new plan wants JSON to be authoritative, the compiler branch must be built first and the gate must assert the record count arriving in the runtime artifact.

defects.plan_line: plans/in-game-calleja-2011-analysis.md:211 and plans/uncomfortable-situations-2017-analysis.md:199 (TEMPLATE never mentions tension-edges.json at all, :107-133)

defects.consequence_observed: Measured across all 11 tension-edges.json files: 119 records authored, 64 reachable, 55 silently discarded (46%). A Grammar of Motives 16/16 lost (tension_id/label/description); Uncomfortable Situations 15/15 lost (pole_A/pole_B); In-Game 12/12 lost (tension_id/label/description); Wendt - Design for Dasein 12/12 lost (wendt_position/against). compiled-index.json tensionEdges contains 64 rows and not one entry from those four.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Publish the runtime edge/tension contract as a schema in the plan, and gate on a round-trip: author N tension records, recompile, assert exactly N appear in the runtime artifact keyed by their ids. Never gate a machine-consumed artifact on a count alone.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:168-172 ("Replicate the Boredom/FCM structure exactly — the compiler parses this section") and plans/boredom-secondary-cluster-index-plan-2026-07-14.md:238-239
defects.defect: The plan mandates the header node format `#### N. Name` + `- **key**: value` and tells authors to copy a Heidegger/Greek exemplar verbatim, without ever stating what the parenthetical in the heading MEANS. scripts/compile-corpus-index.py:688-736 parses `^(.+?)(?:\s*\((.+?)\))?$` and at :734-736 does `if not greek and parenthetical: greek = parenthetical`; build_canonical_terms then pushes `greek` into the corpus-wide greedy-match term list.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/VR Pedagogy Secondary (Part III)/_synthesis/cluster-ontology.md:194 `#### 3. Immersion (technological)` produced compiled-index.json node {name:"Immersion", greek:"technological"} and the bare English word "technological" entered canonicalTerms globally; `Conventional instruction (control)` produced canonicalTerm "control". 19 of 60 VR Pedagogy nodes carry an English gloss in the greek field; 242 nodes corpus-wide carry non-Greek text there (VLE: "W25", "global immersion", "capstone prerequisite"; Boredom Experiment: "first-person in-VR headset feed"). canonicalTerms now contains technological, control, action, image, world, time, Presence, Emotion as greedy-match tokens.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Never instruct "replicate exemplar X exactly" for a machine-parsed artifact. Publish the field grammar with the semantics of every position, forbid parentheticals in node headings, and require lemma fields to be named explicitly (`greek_lemma`, `german_lemma`). Add a gate: no canonicalTerm may be a lowercase common English word absent from a declared lemma allow-list.

defects.defect: "provenance tags present throughout" — no denominator, no field, no per-record requirement, no controlled vocabulary for the FAITHFUL author key. It cannot be failed. The plan also never says the tag belongs in a machine-readable FIELD rather than in prose.
defects.consequence_observed: Provenance survives mostly as prose text, not data: VR Pedagogy carries 1,136 tag tokens in .md files and only 233 `tag` fields in structured records. The FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> key is an open vocabulary keyed on surname and has drifted to 85 distinct forms including truncations FAITHFUL-B, FAITHFUL-C, FAITHFUL-DB, FAITHFUL-O (O'Gorman), FAITHFUL-De, FAITHFUL-Tu, plus doubled forms (FAITHFUL-Slaby 175 and FAITHFUL-Slaby & Thonhauser 8). Two spellings of one tag coexist corpus-wide: INTERP-med 29 vs INTERP-medium 21. Worst, in Boredom Secondary the tag has leaked into the wrong facet: `stance: "FE"` occurs 22 times.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: `provenance` becomes a required, closed-enum field on every claim and clause record; the FAITHFUL author key must resolve against a per-entry interlocutor registry file. Gate: 100% of claim records carry a provenance value that is in the enum and (if FAITHFUL) resolves to a registry key — verified by script.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:219-220 ("≥ 12·N deduplicated global edges"); boredom:259 ("≥550"); vr-pedagogy:216 ("≥276"); in-game:211 ("≥260"); uncomfortable:199 ("≥160")
defects.defect: Every volume gate in the plan family counts EDGES, an artifact that reaches runtime at zero. There is no gate on claims, on locus resolvability, on premise completeness, or on tier distribution. The plan optimises exactly the thing that cannot be queried.
defects.consequence_observed: 19,715 edge rows exist on disk across 219 CSVs (~9,762 distinct triples). compiled-index.json contains 701 ontology nodes, 72 hooks, 64 tension edges and 1,722 terms — and no edges from any unit CSV. Meanwhile the claim layer, which is what the goal names, is ~1,900 records across 27 entries in nine mutually incompatible shapes with no gate at all.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Gate on claim-record yield, locus resolution rate, tier distribution, premise completeness and provenance coverage. Every volume gate must be paired with a round-trip gate: N authored → N queryable.

defects.defect: The `locus` column is specified only as a column name plus "Loci must carry page anchors on both sides where applicable". No grammar, no numbering-system declaration (book page vs PDF page vs section vs line), no requirement of a single locus per cell, and "where applicable" makes it optional by author judgment.
defects.consequence_observed: 17,287 locus cells classified across all edge CSVs: 6,961 bare numbers with no page-system declared (e.g. "227-228"), 3,576 `p.N` / `pp.N-M`, 1,987 multi-locus prose strings ("p.94-95, 99-101"), 1,665 "pdf p.N", 1,394 comma-lists, 961 with NO DIGIT AT ALL ("implicit-throughout", "programmatic-throughout"), 598 Bekker, 92 file-section pointers, 43 empty. Nothing is machine-resolvable to a source position. The same disease at claim level: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/_synthesis/us-literary-loci-concordance.json LIT-001 packs twelve page-anchored phrases into one `specific_anchor` string.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: `locus` becomes a typed object, never a string, with an explicit address kind and a `resolution_status` enum. One address per object; multiple addresses become multiple locus objects. Empty and no-digit loci must be typed `unresolvable`, not silently mixed in.

defects.defect: Three sibling plans specify three different edge-CSV column sets — `source,relation,target,locus,note` versus `{source_id, relation, target_id, domain, evidence_page, contributor}` versus a per-chapter variant — and none registers the relation vocabulary anywhere machine-readable.
defects.consequence_observed: 41 distinct edge-CSV header dialects over 219 files (the modal `source,relation,target,locus,note` covers only 110); 633 distinct relation values over 19,715 rows; scripts/normalize-edges.py:37-41 hardcodes five entry paths and covers none of the five secondary clusters. Two entries even ship differently-named edge files (`edges.csv`, `global-edges-pre-canonical.csv`) that the standard `*-edges.csv` glob misses — 2,034 rows.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: One edge record schema, one file name convention, one closed relation vocabulary shipped as a file with an explicit `x-` extension namespace for genuine novelty, plus a validator that rejects unregistered relations.

defects.defect: Of the eight quality gates, six are cross-source relational: ≥12·N edges, 8-12 documented debates, 8-12 contested readings, ≥max(10, N/4) intra-cluster citations, concordance row/column completeness, ≥1 bridge edge per anchor-reading unit. At N=1 the intra-cluster citation network, the debate map, the contested-readings list and the scholarly-evolution arc all evaluate to zero or become fabrication prompts. The plan never says what to skip or how to record the skip.
defects.consequence_observed: Five entries built at N=2..5 produced 0 structured unit records and 0 edges and sit as "ontology-only" contributors of concept names alone: Virtual Learning Environments (18 nodes, 0 units, 0 edges), Presence Theory (10/0/0), Social Presence in Virtual Worlds (10/0/0), Rhetoric of Interactivity and VR (7/0/0), Boredom Experiment (7/0/0). plans/index-system-implementation-plan-2026-07-28.md:375 records the diagnosis and :465-472 proposes an article profile that does not exist. VR Pedagogy's node list shows the fabrication pressure the other way: nine nodes are named "Debate axis N: X ↔ Y" with definition "See `debate-map.md` DA-0N."
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Split gates into intra-source (must bind at N=1: claim yield, locus resolution rate, premise completeness, tier distribution, provenance coverage, quotation-hash coverage) and group-level (declared skippable at N<3 with a recorded reason written into the manifest). A single-source entry must be a complete, gate-passing artifact on its own.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:54-56 and :137-140 (extraction) — no plan anywhere requires page-offset verification
defects.defect: Phase −1.1 runs pdfinfo/pdftotext and Phase 0 extracts to the scratchpad, but nothing requires the author to establish and verify the mapping between PDF page number and printed book page, nor to record it, nor to test whether it is constant.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Aristotle - Complete Works: 33 of 34 unit records carry pdf_pages derived from a superseded linear offset with errors up to 47 pages, and aristotle-bekker-index.json has 101 of 188 loci off by more than 2 pages — degrading the corpus's single best clause-level address system. Rickert - Ambient Rhetoric declares pdf_page_offset 20, which is both wrong and non-constant (drifts 18→15). The counter-example proves it is cheap: plans/wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md:133 required "double locus on every citation" and the entry duly produced _synthesis/page-offset-verification.md with the offset stated as `book = pdf − 2` and four anchors.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require a per-source `page-offset-verification.md` naming ≥3 sampled anchors spread across the document, asserting the offset, and explicitly testing constancy; a non-constant offset must be recorded as a piecewise table, and every stored pdf_page carries the offset id it was computed under.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:73 (ids assigned at unit level only; no registry, no uniqueness check, no gate)
defects.defect: The plan assigns `PREFIX01…N` to units and stops. Nothing requires sub-records to carry ids, nothing requires those ids to be unique beyond one file, and no gate checks collisions or prefix conformance.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Wendt - Design for Dasein: 139 claim objects, 91 with no id at all, 28 with ids of which 20 collide (C1..C20 restart in each unit file). corpus/index/Boredom Secondary (Part III): readings ids collide 37 of 79, tensions 5 of 8. corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations runs two disjoint concept id spaces in one directory. Corpus-wide the audit counts 10 id-prefix-violation and 10 id-collision defects; plans/index-system-implementation-plan-2026-07-28.md:320 records 31 unenforced ID prefixes and no validator.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every record at every level gets a globally unique id of the form `<ENTRY>-<UNIT>-<TYPE><nnnn>`, registered in a per-entry `id-registry.json`, with a validator that fails on collision, on prefix mismatch, and on any dangling id reference.

defects.defect: §−1.6 controls only OBJECT TYPES (≤12) and EDGE RELATIONS. It never controls a claim-level stance, support tier, evidence type, or confidence. Those facets are then invented per record, and several entries fuse an enum head to a free-text rationale in one cell, destroying the facet.
defects.consequence_observed: Boredom Secondary `stance`: 170 distinct values over 264 populated cells, with 199 readings carrying none. Von Uexkull's claim tables: `Strength` should be a 3-value enum but has ~100 distinct values because the rationale is glued on with an em-dash ("Strong — multiple independent examples", "Moderate — polemical assertion more than demonstration"); `Evidence type` has 105 distinct values over 107 rows. BCAP `Status` mixes a 4-value vocabulary with 17 "Explicitly stated; …" variants AND embeds the page locus in the same cell ("Textually explicit (pp. 33, 40, 43)"). Being and Time `status` is the best case — 7 controlled values covering 101 of 108 rows — with 5 free-text escapes. Even the Dissertation, the strongest layer, left `claim_type` free: 378 distinct values over 982 records, and `logical_role` 825 distinct — both useless as facets.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Ship every facet as a closed enum file with the plan; rationale always goes in a SEPARATE free-text field; a value not in the enum is a validator failure, not an author's improvisation.

defects.defect: The copyright ceiling is enforced by a detector that does not exist. plans/index-system-implementation-plan-2026-07-28.md:391 states Q4.5 as "Build the verbatim-quote detector — the mandatory G1 copyright gate, currently satisfied by agent self-attestation." Worse, the policy as written tells authors to DELETE the clause text rather than to record it under a safe representation.
defects.consequence_observed: 15 unverified-quotation defects across the audit. Two entries actively suppress the exact material a clause-level index exists to hold: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011)/.../ig-10-deep.json `content_filter_audit` records six passages as "paraphrased"/"no ≥25-word verbatim reproduced" with only line ranges into a now-deleted file; corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations/.../us-03-radcliffe.json:110 marks Antonia's 'undone' exclamation "NOT to be quoted at length per content-filter discipline". The clause is gone; only prose about it remains.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace deletion with a safe representation: store `quote_sha256`, `quote_word_count`, the full typed address, the first and last ≤8 words, and a `suppressed:true` + `suppression_reason` flag — never nothing. Build the detector before the gate cites it, and make the gate `detector exits 0`, not attestation.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:137-140 ("pdftotext every source in SOURCE_DIR to the scratchpad ... downstream agents get the .txt path") and boredom:184-186
defects.defect: The extracted text layer — the only object against which a line offset or a character offset can mean anything — is written to an ephemeral scratch directory, and the plan records neither the extraction command, the tool version, nor a checksum. defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/In-Game (Calleja 2011) contains 858 line-range references (e.g. ig-10-deep.json content_filter_audit "Lakoff+Johnson block-quote p.168 lines 5901-5907") pointing into /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt, plus five sibling scratch files — all deleted; `ls /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt` returns No such file. defects.fix_for_new_plan: The extracted text layer becomes a first-class, retained artifact stored under the entry, with `{tool, tool_version, exact_command, source_sha256, text_sha256, extracted_at}` recorded in the unit record. Offsets are always qualified by `text_layer_id`. Add an explicit recovery step: deterministically re-extract Calleja's PDF and rebind the 995 line ranges.

defects.defect: The registration gate verifies only that node and term counts appeared in compiled-index.json. Nothing verifies that the unit records, edges, claims, concordance or apparatus reached runtime — because they cannot. The plan therefore certifies as complete an entry whose analytical substance is unreachable, and it gives the author no way to notice.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Wendt - Design for Dasein/_synthesis/quality-gates-report.md ticks all 13 gates and then declares registration optional on a false premise: "being in it is an enrichment, not a prerequisite for an entry to function ... Not done by hand." The entry was later registered, but its 12 tension edges still yield zero. Only 2 of 27 entries have a quality-gates-report.md at all (Wendt and RDR2 Secondary); only 1 carries machine-readable metrics. Corpus-wide, 58 unreachable-content defects were filed.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: The registration gate must be a round-trip diff on the runtime artifact: assert the exact delta in nodes, claims, clauses, edges and tensions attributable to this entry, by id, and fail on any authored record that does not appear. Make quality-gates-report.md machine-readable and mandatory, generated by the validator rather than typed by the author.

defects.defect: The plan acknowledges a ~1/8 subagent no-op rate and mitigates by checking that "all three files exist on disk for every unit". Existence is not conformance. An agent that emitted a differently-shaped file, or a file with the right name and the wrong internal format, passes this check.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Heidegger - Basic Concepts of Aristotelian Philosophy: the plan's claim schema (`- **claim** / **premises** / **aristotelian_texts** / **status**` with an explicit → conclusion step) appears in exactly 1 of 13 unit files (phase2-u-fp2a.md, 18 of 146 `-P<n>` records). The other twelve invented `- **Source**` / `- **Status**` (60 and 36 occurrences) or plain prose; phase2-u-sp2a.md has zero `-P<n>` headings at all. Field-name casing forked in the same entry: `- **Premises**` 14 vs `- **premises**` 18.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Replace the existence check with a per-file schema validation run after every batch, and re-dispatch or self-author on validation failure, not on absence. Give each agent the schema file and an exemplar record, and require the agent to self-validate before returning.

defects.defect: The manifest is declared authoritative ("the manifest, not the plan, is ground truth") and is told to carry counts, but nothing requires those counts to be recomputed from disk at the end of the run, and nothing requires an expected node count at all.
defects.consequence_observed: Of 27 entries only 6 manifests declare any count field and ZERO declare an expected node count; five entries have no manifest at all (A Rhetoric of Motives, Phantasia Secondary, Presence Theory, Social Presence, Rhetoric of Interactivity, Game-Behavior Analysis Method). plans/index-system-implementation-plan-2026-07-28.md:212 records that the one `nodeCount` on disk was generated by the compiler's own parser, so checking it is a tautology. 66 count-mismatch defects were filed corpus-wide; BCAP's section 3B statistics are wrong in every line; manifests declare phases pending that are complete on disk.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Every declared statistic is emitted by the validator from the filesystem, never typed by an author; the gate compares the validator's recomputation against the previous run and requires an explicit `planCorrections` entry for any change.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:74 (slug rule) — no orthography or Unicode rule anywhere in the plan family
defects.defect: The plan fixes a slug convention for filenames but never fixes an orthography for author names, non-ASCII lemmas or transliterations, and never requires Unicode normalisation.
defects.consequence_observed: corpus/index/Von Uexkull - A Foray... carries three orthographies of the author's own name in one entry — Uexkull 101, Uexküll 90, Uexkuell 36 — and the ASCII-mangled form is the one that dominates the runtime artifact (compiled-index.json: Uexkull 60, Uexkuell 5, Uexküll 4). 13 encoding-corruption defects corpus-wide. Compounding risk on the ingestion side: the pdfium ligature bug silently drops lowercase fi/ff/fl, which would corrupt any quote hash taken from an affected extraction.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Require NFC normalisation on write; a per-entry `name-forms.json` mapping every observed variant to one canonical key; a `normalized_quote` field for matching alongside the raw `quote`; and a pre-flight check that the extraction tool version is not on the known-bad list.

defects.defect: The plan asks for many cross-references — unit ids in node records, anchor unit ids in bridge edges, concordance row→anchor-node mappings, file pointers — and requires none of them to resolve. `****** UNVERIFIED:` (:10, :36) is offered as an escape hatch with no reconciliation step.
defects.consequence_observed: 44 dangling-reference defects. corpus/index/Veri(dis)similitude (Salvo MA)/vds-claims-moves.md closes by directing the reader to `repurpose-crosswalk.md` and `gaps-to-add.md`, neither of which exists in the directory. Nine VR Pedagogy runtime nodes have as their entire definition "See `debate-map.md` DA-0N." — a pointer into a file no runtime consumer opens, so the node arrives definitionless. corpus/index/Virtual Learning Environments/units/vle-05-…md:3 declares a source directory that does not exist.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: A link-resolution gate: every id reference, file pointer and anchor-unit id must resolve, or be recorded in an `unresolved.json` with a reason and an owner. A definition field may not consist solely of a pointer.

defects.defect: The agent budget is one Phase-2 agent per unit, given the .txt path and asked to produce the whole trio in one pass. At unit granularity (~7 structured records per source) that is feasible. At claim granularity (50-500 records per source) a single agent cannot hold the source and emit hundreds of typed, id'd, locus-anchored, cross-referenced records in one pass, and the plan specifies no chunked passes, no per-pass yield floor, no merge/dedup step and no cross-pass id allocation.
defects.consequence_observed: Where an entry did attempt density, the shape fragmented mid-run: BCAP's schema holds in 1 of 13 units; corpus/index/Red Dead Redemption 2 (Salvo Playthrough) frame-traces carry 1,326 bullet observations, 3,788 VTT cues and 121 frame ids across 24+ table header dialects with zero ids; Boredom Secondary's 2,924 sub-items landed in 42 shapes.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Specify a windowed pass protocol: fixed text windows (e.g. 1,500-3,000 words of the retained text layer) with a per-window yield floor, a pre-allocated id block per window, a deterministic merge step, and an explicit dedup pass keyed on `quote_sha256` + normalized claim text.

defects.defect: The per-unit quality target is a WORD COUNT of paraphrastic prose (1,500-3,500w humanities, 1,000-2,500w STEM, 400-1,000w map). Prose length is the only per-unit quality measure the plan has, and prose is the layer nothing can query.
defects.consequence_observed: 372 unit analyses totalling millions of words of paraphrase, none of which reaches runtime, against ~1,900 structured claim records in nine shapes. VR Pedagogy is the clearest case: 1,136 provenance-tagged assertions live in prose while only 233 are structured — the plan's word-count gate rewarded exactly the wrong artifact.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Demote prose length to an optional human-readability note. The measured deliverable is the record set; the .md is generated FROM the records, not authored alongside them.

defects.defect: The plan names Boredom Secondary, RDR2 Secondary and Phantasia Secondary as the structural precedents to imitate. It never names corpus/index/Dissertation/, which holds the only proven claim schema in the repository — 982 line-anchored records with a closed 8-tier support taxonomy, an explicit supports/supported_by graph, typed citation slots, and 235 cached verbatims with insertion anchors. defects.consequence_observed: Nine incompatible claim shapes: Dissertation compact {id,ss,ln,tx,ty,lr,sup,supBy,pCit,sCit,iCit,st,ct,im,fp,fr,rem} (560 records) AND Dissertation long-form {claim_id,section_id,subsection_id,location{line_start,line_end},claim_text,claim_type,logical_role,supports,supported_by,primary_citations_currently_in_text,secondary_citations_currently_in_text,implicit_citations_needed,support_tier,is_coined_term_present,is_interpretive_move,interpretive_flag_present,interpretive_flag_text,remediation} (422) — two dialects inside the one proven layer; Wendt {text,locus}; FCM {id,locus,text} and {claim,id,locus}; Uexküll table Claim|Evidence type|Strength|Page ref; BT table id|claim|premises|targets|status; BCAP three dialects; VR Pedagogy {claim,type,stance,locus,tag}; Uncomfortable six position shapes.
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Name corpus/index/Dissertation/_run-history/2026-05-20T0058/_per-section/*/phase2-claims.json and .../_synthesis/master-citation-report-parsed.json as THE claim-schema precedent, adopt its long-form field names, and forbid the compact dialect except as a storage alias table.

defects.defect: The repair programme, which is supposed to fix the wiring, reproduces the granularity ceiling verbatim. N3.1 defines "a canonical unit record — id, entry, title, locus range, concepts, arguments, claims, edges, provenance" and W5.1 emits "unit records — id, entry, title, locus range, concepts, arguments, claims". `claims` is again an unspecified nested slot, and the addressable object is again the unit. A claim inside a unit record has no id of its own and cannot be retrieved, cited or contradicted.
defects.consequence_observed: Not yet built — but it would re-strand exactly the 982 Dissertation records, 157 VDS rows, 233 VR Pedagogy readings, 108 BT rows, 107 Uexküll rows and 146 BCAP records that the audit identifies as already existing and unaddressable. Its own §M12 note (ADDENDUM:120) concedes that 35 `*-deep.json` files carry "positions, tensions, interlocutors and ratio-catalogs that N3.1's canonical unit record has no slot for."
defects.fix_for_new_plan: Define the CLAIM record and the CLAUSE record as first-class, independently addressable types with their own ids and their own storage table, and define the unit record as a container that references them. Wire claim and clause retrieval, not just unit retrieval.

defects.defect: A render gate with no named tool, no command, and no recorded artifact.
defects.consequence_observed: 67 .mmd files across 15 entries encode 1,544 arrow-edges; only 2 entries carry a render-validation record (Aristotelian Phantasia Secondary and Uncomfortable Situations), so 13 of 15 .mmd-bearing entries passed a gate nobody executed. mmdc 11.14.0 was installed the whole time (ADDENDUM:76). The 1,544 arrow-edges are also a whole edge layer with no adapter and no runtime path.

defects.plan_line: plans/secondary-cluster-index-plan-TEMPLATE-2026-07-15.md:9-10 ("record the choice + reasoning in phase0-overview.md under `## Judgment calls`") and :214
defects.defect: Judgment calls and plan deviations are recorded in free prose in two different files (phase0-overview.md `## Judgment calls`, manifest.planCorrections) with no schema, so they cannot be aggregated across entries or checked for recurrence.
defects.consequence_observed: The same judgment ("what shape should a reading be?") was made independently 55 times inside Boredom Secondary alone, producing 8 reading shapes, and no artifact records that a decision was being repeated.

unspecified_gaps: What a CLAIM is. No plan defines a claim record, a claim id, a claim granularity, or a claim yield. `readings[]` (TEMPLATE:159) and `positions` (uncomfortable:171) are the nearest things and both are one-line array names.

What a CLAUSE is. Nothing in 1,758 files carries a sentence index, a character span or a bbox. No plan asks for one. The finest addresses in the corpus arrived incidentally: Aristotle's Bekker line pairs, In-Game's line ranges into a deleted scratch file, RDR2's VTT cue timestamps, VLE's respondent×item keys.
The element schema of every nested array in the unit JSON — readings, constructs, measures, concepts, interlocutors, sections, tensions, bridges. 42 shapes resulted in one entry.
The tension-edges.json key contract (`node_a`/`node_b`). Never stated anywhere; 55 of 119 records lost.
That `cluster-ontology.json` / `book-level-ontology.json` are read by nothing.
That the parenthetical in a `#### N. Name (X)` heading becomes the `greek` field and enters the global canonicalTerms greedy-match list.
That a node record lacking a `type` bullet silently inherits its `centrality` as its type (compile-corpus-index.py:761) — 73 runtime nodes are affected.
A locus grammar: which numbering system a bare number belongs to, one-address-per-cell, and what to write when no locus exists (961 cells say 'implicit-throughout').
A controlled vocabulary for stance, support tier, evidence type, claim kind, scope, confidence, or disposition. Only object types and edge relations are controlled.
That the FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> key needs a registry. 85 forms including FAITHFUL-B, FAITHFUL-C, FAITHFUL-DB.
That INTERP-med and INTERP-medium are the same tag.
Whether a provenance tag belongs in prose or in a field. It ended up mostly in prose (VR Pedagogy 1,136 prose tokens vs 233 fields).
Id uniqueness, prefix conformance, and a registry. Wendt has 91 claims with no id and 20 colliding.
Page-offset verification between PDF page and printed page, and whether the offset is constant.
Retention, checksumming and versioning of the extracted text layer that all offsets are taken against.
Unicode normalisation and a canonical orthography for author names and non-ASCII lemmas.
What the copyright ceiling means for a clause-level index — the plan says delete, which is the opposite of the goal. No safe representation (hash + address + word count) is offered.
What happens to the gates at N=1. Six of eight are cross-source.
A per-batch schema validation step. The reliability mitigation checks only that three files exist.
A windowed authoring protocol, id pre-allocation, and a merge/dedup step for high-density record production.
Which of the two edge serialisations (per-source *-edges.csv vs _synthesis/global-edges.csv) is authoritative. Four entries disagree between the layers and nothing records which is stale.
What a registration gate must assert beyond node and term counts. Nothing checks that claims, edges, apparatus or tensions arrived.
That corpus/index/Dissertation already holds a working, 982-record, tier-typed, graph-linked claim schema.
design_inputs: ADOPT A CANONICAL CLAIM RECORD — one schema, used by every entry, every unit, every phase, shipped with the plan as claim.schema.json and enforced by a validator whose exit code is the gate. Field-by-field below; every field is justified by the entry that already proves it earns its place.

CLAIM.claim_id — string, `<ENTRY>-<UNIT>-C<nnnn>`, globally unique, registered in a per-entry id-registry.json. PROVEN BY: Dissertation declares `claim_id_format: "DISS-00-C<nnn>"` and achieves 982 records with zero collisions; Being and Time 108 rows / 108 distinct (`BT-D1-U3-P1`); BCAP 146 distinct (`U-FP2a-P1`); VDS 157 distinct (`A-P01`/`B-P02`/`C-C04`). COUNTER-PROOF: Wendt 91 of 139 claim objects have no id and 20 of 28 collide because `C1` restarts per file; Boredom readings collide 37 of 79.
CLAIM.entry_id, CLAIM.unit_id — required. PROVEN BY: compiled-index.json nodes already carry `units[]` and `text`; without them Wendt's per-file `C1` is meaningless.

CLAIM.claim_text — the proposition in one sentence, ≤60 words, the author's paraphrase (not the source's words — those go in CLAIM.verbatim). Canonical name is `claim_text`. PROVEN BY: Dissertation long-form uses `claim_text` on 422 records; the same field is spelled `tx` (560 Dissertation compact), `text` (Wendt 139, FCM 142), `claim` (Uexküll 107, BT 108, BCAP 18, VR Pedagogy 233, Uncomfortable 55), `statement` (VDS 157). Pick one; ship a compact-alias table only if storage size demands it.

CLAIM.claim_kind — CLOSED enum, union-and-dedup of what is in use: assertion | definition | textual-report | interpretation | premise | conclusion | methodological | programmatic | quotation | contrast | open-question. JUSTIFICATION: Dissertation's `claim_type` is populated on 982 of 982 records, so the facet is wanted — and it has 378 distinct values, so it must be closed. BT's `status` supplies the working members (core_book_thesis 42, local_support 36, core_chapter_thesis 11, methodological 5, core_section_thesis 4, local_argument 3, open_question 1) but conflates kind with scope; split them.

CLAIM.scope — CLOSED enum: book-thesis | chapter-thesis | section-thesis | unit-thesis | local-support | transitional. PROVEN BY: Being and Time's status column, the only place in the corpus where argumentative altitude is recorded and the only claim vocabulary that is 94% controlled (101 of 108 rows).

CLAIM.stance — CLOSED enum, the move the claim makes: asserts | defines | classifies | reports | extends | refines | qualifies | concedes | contests | refutes | restates | synthesizes | concludes | self-critiques | defers. DERIVED BY UNION+DEDUP of Boredom Secondary's 170 free values and VR Pedagogy's (top observed: extends, reports, contests, asserts, defines, restates, concedes, qualifies, concludes, classifies, defines/self-critiques). CRITICAL BUG TO DESIGN OUT: Boredom Secondary has `stance: "FE"` 22 times — a provenance tag in the stance field. stance and provenance must be separate required fields with disjoint enums, and the validator must reject cross-contamination.

CLAIM.support_tier — CLOSED 8-value enum, adopted VERBATIM from the only closed, fully-populated tier vocabulary in the corpus (Dissertation `support_tier_legend`): T1-textually-confirmed | T2-textually-supported | T3-interpretive-but-flagged | T4-interpretive-but-unflagged | T5-under-supported | T6-unsupported | T7-overreach | T8-secondary-needed. OBSERVED DISTRIBUTION over 982 records: T3 477, T1 277, T2 78, T5 71, T4 41, T7 22, T6 12, T8 4. This is the field that delivers the user's 'every weakness' — T4/T5/T6/T7 are the weaknesses, machine-selectable. CROSSWALK for migration: Uexküll Strong→T1/T2, Moderate→T3/T5, Weak→T6; BCAP 'Explicitly stated'/'Textually explicit'→T1; BCAP '[INTERP-high] Heidegger's interpretive construction'→T3; VDS tier 1→T1, tier 2→T3.

CLAIM.evidence_type — CLOSED enum: textual-explicit | textual-inferred | philosophical-argument | empirical-experiment | empirical-observation | comparative | analogical | diagrammatic | statistical | anecdotal | authority-citation | methodological-principle. PROVEN BY: Von Uexküll's `Evidence type` column, populated on 107 of 107 rows and the ONLY place in the corpus that separates 'what kind of evidence' from 'how strong'. Its 105 distinct values collapse cleanly into these 12.

CLAIM.strength_rationale — free text, SEPARATE FIELD. JUSTIFICATION: Uexküll glued the rationale to the enum with an em-dash ('Strong — multiple independent examples'), producing ~100 distinct values from a 3-value vocabulary and destroying the facet. BCAP did the same with page numbers ('Textually explicit (pp. 33, 40, 43)'). Never fuse an enum and its prose.

CLAIM.provenance — CLOSED enum + registry-resolved author slot: FE | FE-U | FE-STUDENT | FE-TEACHER | FAITHFUL:<author_key> | P/anticipatory-application | INTERP-low | INTERP-med | INTERP-high | burke-direct | calleja-direct. FULL CORPUS-WIDE COUNTS (this is the complete observed vocabulary): bare tokens FE 2,761 · P/anticipatory-application 1,323 · burke-direct 1,196 · anticipatory-application 524 · INTERP-high 380 · INTERP-low 368 · calleja-direct 180 · FAITHFUL-<Author> 85 distinct keys (top: Slaby 175, Makransky 154, Parong 144, Richardson 132, Keane 130, Yakobi 108, Nacke 102, Tam 102, Seo 98, Kim 94, Holmqvist 88, Mansikka 86); bracketed forms [INTERP-high] 276 · [INTERP-low] 207 · [FE] 43 · [P] 33 · [INTERP-med] 29 · [INTERP-medium] 21 · [FE-STUDENT] 12 · [FE-U] 10. NORMALISATIONS REQUIRED: merge INTERP-med and INTERP-medium; merge bare `anticipatory-application` into `P/anticipatory-application`; FAITHFUL author keys must resolve against a per-entry interlocutor registry, because the free-surname convention has already produced FAITHFUL-B, FAITHFUL-C, FAITHFUL-DB, FAITHFUL-O (O'Gorman), FAITHFUL-De, FAITHFUL-Tu and doubled forms (FAITHFUL-Slaby 175 vs FAITHFUL-Slaby & Thonhauser 8).

CLAIM.locus — an ARRAY OF TYPED LOCATOR OBJECTS (see the CLAUSE/locator model below), required, minimum length 1, never a string. JUSTIFICATION: as a free string it produced 17,287 cells in 10+ formats with 961 carrying no digit at all and 6,961 bare numbers with no declared numbering system.

CLAIM.verbatim — the exact source words the claim is drawn from, plus verbatim_sha256, verbatim_word_count, and verbatim_suppressed:bool. PROVEN BY: the 235 cached verbatims in corpus/index/Dissertation/_run-history/2026-05-20T0058/_synthesis/master-citation-report-parsed.json, whose exact schema is {cache_id, priority_stars(1-4), source{author,year,page,title}, locus, verbatim, pathe_section, subsection_letter, insertion_anchor, use, rationale} on 235 of 235 records. This is the only place in the index where a claim and the words that ground it are both present and linked.

CLAIM.insertion_anchor — a short verbatim phrase of the TARGET text at which the claim attaches (e.g. "they are a *movement* (kinēsis) of the soul, a dynamic reorientation"). PROVEN BY: present on 235 of 235 Dissertation cache entries. It is the corpus's only working content-addressed pointer, and unlike In-Game's line ranges it still resolves today. Adopt it as the clause locator's mandatory fallback.

CLAIM.premises[] — ORDERED ARRAY of {premise_index, premise_text, ref} where ref is a claim_id or a locus object. PROVEN BY: BCAP records enumerated premises with an explicit '→ **conclusion**:' step (phase2-u-fp2a.md, 18 records) and Being and Time carries premises on 108 of 108 rows. BOTH encode them as ONE PROSE CELL ('(1) …; (2) …; (3) …'), which is why nothing can traverse them — the new record must make each premise a separate element.

CLAIM.supports[] / CLAIM.supported_by[] — arrays of claim_id. PROVEN BY: Dissertation puts 76% of 982 claims into an explicit support graph with 841 typed edges; Being and Time's `targets` column is the same idea one step less formal. This is the structure that answers 'every point of connection'.

CLAIM.contests[] / CLAIM.contested_by[] — arrays of claim_id or interlocutor_id. PROVEN BY: Uncomfortable Situations positions carry `contested_by` (us-00-intro, us-03-radcliffe) and Being and Time carries 84 explicit claim-to-tension back-references ('Linked to: BT-D1-U3-P3').
CLAIM.tension_ids[] — links into the tension record set. PROVEN BY: the same 84 BT back-references, plus contested-nodes.md in BT/Uexküll. This is the second half of 'every weakness'.

CLAIM.cites_primary[] / CLAIM.cites_secondary[] / CLAIM.implicit_citations_needed[] — each an array of {locus, tier, rationale}. PROVEN BY: Dissertation's pCit/sCit/iCit populated on 982 of 982, with iCit elements shaped {l: locus, s: tier, r: rationale} — e.g. {l:'DA III.10, 433a13-15 (no motion without orexis)', s:'T2', r:'The thesis is canonical Aristotelian doctrine; should be locus-anchored where the thesis surfaces'}. The third slot is the one that makes the index an instrument rather than a record: it names the citation the prose is MISSING.

CLAIM.interlocutors[] — array of {interlocutor_id, role, locus} with role a CLOSED enum: anchor | corroborating | contested | superseded | background | methodological | definitional. PROVEN BY: Uncomfortable Situations' four loci concordances carry `role` on all 176 records; VDS vds-interlocutor-loci.md carries a `role` column on 24 rows ('Master theoretical anchor', 'corroborating (naming)', 'structural template', 'epigraph / framing') plus a `corpus_index_bridge` column naming the target entry.

CLAIM.coined_terms[] — array of strings. PROVEN BY: Dissertation `ct` / `coined_terms_present` (26 in DISS-03 alone, e.g. ['resonant kinēsis','resonant aisthēma','resonant orexis']) and its coined_term_canonical_definition_sites index. This is what lets the index police the project's own vocabulary.

CLAIM.flag_present:bool + CLAIM.flag_text — the verbatim hedge in the target prose that marks the claim as interpretive. PROVEN BY: Dissertation `fp`/`interpretive_flag_present` (128 of 156 in DISS-03) plus `interpretive_flag_text` carrying the actual words ("'which I designate as occupying A_3'", "'as I established in the preceding section'"). Pairing the boolean with the quoted hedge is what makes T3-interpretive-but-flagged auditable rather than asserted.

CLAIM.disposition — CLOSED 5-value enum: keep-verbatim | re-ground | enrich | supersede | drop. PROVEN BY: Veri(dis)similitude, populated on 157 of 157 rows (re-ground 127, enrich 21, keep 7, supersede 2). This is the only forward-looking field anywhere in the corpus and the one that makes an index actionable during drafting rather than merely descriptive.

CLAIM.analytic_anchor[] — array from a per-project CLOSED enum, the project's own analytical vocabulary the claim attaches to. PROVEN BY: VDS's declared RODA anchor enum — A0-horizon, A1-perception, A2-phantasma, A3-doxa/emotion, A4-action/hexis, A4→A0′(carry-over), union(R1–R7), recalcitrance, rupture, hinge(four-cause), VR↔2D(differential), framing — 12 values, ~240 attachments over 157 rows (A0 37, union 37, hinge 29, rupture 29, framing 28, A4 27, A4→A0′ 22, A1 19, VR↔2D 14, A3 14, recalcitrance 14, A2 12); and by the 'RODA locus' column in every RDR2 beat-map row. This is the corpus-wide generalisation of the concordance idea at TEMPLATE:81-88.

CLAIM.volatility — {is_volatile:bool, depends_on:<decision_id>, resolved_at, resolution_note}. PROVEN BY: VDS's `[V:…]` drift-flags and its resolution stamps in situ ('hinge [resolved 2026-06-24: Part I §A₄ final · RODA v6]', 'union [V:rename]', 'A2 [V:crosswalk-appx]'). Without this the index silently rots as project vocabulary moves; with it, a vocabulary change produces a work queue.

CLAIM.remediation — {action (CLOSED enum), corpus_index_candidates[], chroma_candidates[], external_query, effort ∈ none|small|medium|large}. PROVEN BY: Dissertation `rem` populated on 982 of 982, shaped {a: action, cCorp: corpus_index_candidates, cChrom: chromadb_candidates, cPerp: perplexity_query, eff: effort}, with real routing values like 'RESOLVE_INLINENOTE+ADD_PRIMARY_CITATION' and cCorp ['corpus/index/Aristotle - Complete Works/De Anima III.10'].

CLAIM.extraction — {tool, tool_version, exact_command, source_sha256, text_layer_id, text_sha256, run_id, extracted_at}. JUSTIFICATION: In-Game's 858 line references died with /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt because nothing recorded how to regenerate it. Every offset is meaningless without the identity of the text it indexes.

CLAIM.confidence ∈ high|medium|low and CLAIM.needs_human_review:bool. PROVEN BY: BCAP already emits 30 `- **Confidence**:` bullets, and the '****** UNVERIFIED:' convention (TEMPLATE:10) is the corpus's de-facto review flag with no field to live in.

ADOPT A CANONICAL CLAUSE RECORD — the addressable span of source text, independently id'd, referenced by claims rather than nested inside them (one clause may ground many claims; one claim may span several clauses).
CLAUSE.clause_id — `<DOC>-CL<nnnnn>`, globally unique.

CLAUSE.doc_id — a stable source identity: sha256 of the source file plus an edition_key, NOT a filesystem path. JUSTIFICATION: In-Game addressed /tmp; Uncomfortable and Aristotle address 'the PDF' with no version identity, which is how a superseded offset silently poisoned 33 of 34 Aristotle unit records.

CLAUSE.text_layer_id — the id of the retained extracted-text artifact {tool, tool_version, exact_command, text_sha256}. Two extractions of one PDF give different offsets; without this field every offset is a guess. The text layer is stored UNDER THE ENTRY, never in scratch.

CLAUSE.char_start / char_end and CLAUSE.sentence_index — offsets into that text layer. NET-NEW: nothing in 1,758 files carries a character offset or a sentence index today. This is the single structural addition that turns the corpus from page-level to clause-level.

CLAUSE.line_start / line_end — retained because they are already in use and cheaply recoverable: In-Game records 858 line references, and Dissertation anchors 982 of 982 claims by line (`ln`: '3', or `location:{line_start:5,line_end:5}`).

CLAUSE.quote (verbatim clause text) + quote_sha256 + quote_word_count + normalized_quote (NFC, ligature-repaired, whitespace-collapsed). JUSTIFICATION: the hash and the normalized form are the address that survives re-extraction, which the line ranges did not; normalization is required because the corpus already carries Uexkull/Uexküll/Uexkuell in one entry and the pdfium ligature bug drops fi/ff/fl invisibly.

CLAUSE.citation_address — the EDITION-INDEPENDENT canonical address, a typed union. Each variant is proven by an existing corpus address system: (a) bekker {work, book, chapter, bekker_start, bekker_end} — PROVEN BY corpus/index/Aristotle - Complete Works/aristotle-bekker-index.json, 188 records shaped {bekker, description, concepts[], pdf_page, unit_id, work}, and 3,064 distinct line-anchored Bekker strings across the entry; Bekker line numbers ARE clause-level and the entry already records them. (b) heidegger_h {h_page} — H-numbers appear in BT prose ('H.96', 'H.95–101'). (c) section {section_ref} — '§21', '§9b-β', already used by BT and BCAP outlines. (d) book_page {page_start, page_end, edition_key}. (e) pdf_page {pdf_page_start, pdf_page_end, pdf_sha256, offset_id} where offset_id points at a verified page-offset record. (f) survey_item {cohort, respondent_id, item_id} — PROVEN BY corpus/index/Virtual Learning Environments (King–Salvo), which already uses W25-R089 / W26-R037 / S25-R022 crossed with Q5–Q10. (g) media_time {clip_id, t_start_ms, t_end_ms, fps, frame_start, frame_end, vtt_cue_index} — PROVEN BY RDR2 Playthrough's 44 .vtt files carrying 3,788 millisecond-precision cues plus 1,040 frame ids and 529 timestamps, and by the G&G frame archive (f_00001…f_00609 at 1 fps with the frame↔second rule stated in gg-frame-trace.md). (h) dataset_cell {channel, participant, epoch} for the Boredom Experiment channels.

CLAUSE.resolution_status — CLOSED enum: exact-offset | line-range | quote-match | page-only | unresolvable. JUSTIFICATION: 961 existing loci say 'implicit-throughout' or 'programmatic-throughout'. Those must be typed as unresolvable and counted, not silently mixed with real page numbers. The entry-level gate is a resolution-rate threshold on this field.

CLAUSE.speaker / CLAUSE.voice — CLOSED enum: author | quoted-interlocutor | character | respondent | in-game-npc | narrator | editor. PROVEN BY: Uncomfortable Situations declares a LITERARY-CHARACTER object type (uncomfortable-situations-2017-analysis.md:113); RDR2 beat-maps carry per-speaker dialogue; VLE carries per-respondent free text.

CLAUSE.figure[] and CLAUSE.feature_tags[] — CLOSED per-project vocabulary of rhetorical figures and textual features. PROVEN BY: corpus/index/Uncomfortable Situations' 176 loci records already carry 'specific phrase + rhetorical figure + source and commentary pages' — but packed into ONE prose string (see LIT-001's twelve anchors in a single `specific_anchor`, and RHET-002's 'Tribunal-of-conscience figure'). The clause record splits that string into fields.

CLAUSE.commentary_locus[] — where a commentator discusses this clause, as its own typed address. PROVEN BY: Uncomfortable's loci records already carry the dual address (`specific_anchor` into the primary text plus `first_cited_pdf_page` and `notes_anchor` such as 'Ch.1 n.29' into Gross's commentary). This is what lets the index answer 'who has said what about this exact sentence'.

CLAUSE.suppressed:bool + suppression_reason — when copyright forbids storing the words, store quote_sha256, quote_word_count, the full typed address, and the first and last ≤8 words. NEVER store nothing. JUSTIFICATION: In-Game (ig-10-deep.json content_filter_audit) and Uncomfortable (us-03-radcliffe.json:110) currently delete the clause under the ≥25-word rule at TEMPLATE:44-45, which is in direct contradiction with a clause-level index. A hash plus an address is not a reproduction and preserves addressability.

SHIP THE CONTROLLED VOCABULARIES AS FILES, not as plan prose: support_tier (8, Dissertation verbatim) · provenance (11 + author registry) · stance (15) · evidence_type (12) · claim_kind (11) · scope (6) · disposition (5) · interlocutor_role (7) · resolution_status (5) · speaker (7) · remediation_action · relation. For `relation`: 633 distinct values exist over 19,715 rows but the tail is thin — only 13 are singletons and the top 25 (cites 2,986; defines 1,821; treats-construct 1,000; instances-in-text 928; extends 666; qualifies 570; contests 547; cites-as-support 534; grounds 450; bridges-to-part-iii 397; depends_on 382; bridges-to-pipeline 343; cites-cluster-author 322; treats-game-element 288; shifts-debate-axis 260; instantiates 212; operationalizes-measure 207; refines 196; exemplifies 194; operationalizes 193; concedes 188; awaits-ontological-grounding-in 180; extends-reading-of 180; contrasts_with 178; operationalizes-via-game 174) cover most traffic. Ship a closed core of ~40 with an explicit `x-` extension namespace; the validator rejects anything else. Also normalise the snake/kebab split (depends_on vs contrasts_with vs treats-construct).

GATES THAT BIND AT N=1 AND AT CLAIM SCALE — replace the six cross-source volume gates. Intra-source, all script-computed: (1) claim yield ≥1 record per 150 words of retained text layer for deep units, ≥1 per 400 for map (calibrated from Dissertation's 1-per-58 and VDS's 1-per-59); (2) locus resolution rate — ≥95% of claim records carry ≥1 locus whose resolution_status ≠ unresolvable; (3) quote coverage — ≥80% of T1/T2 claims carry a verbatim or a quote_sha256; (4) premise completeness — 100% of claim_kind=conclusion records have ≥2 premises entries; (5) tier distribution declared and non-degenerate (no entry may be 100% one tier); (6) provenance coverage 100%, all values in-enum, all FAITHFUL keys registry-resolved; (7) graph connectivity — ≥60% of claims appear in supports/supported_by or contests/contested_by (Dissertation achieves 76%); (8) id integrity — zero collisions, zero dangling refs. Group-level gates (debates, citation networks, evolution arcs, concordance completeness) are declared skippable at N<3 with the reason written into the manifest.

MAKE REGISTRATION A ROUND-TRIP GATE, not a count check. Author N claim records and M clause records; recompile; assert that exactly N and M appear in the runtime store keyed by id, and that every authored tension and edge is present. Fail on any authored record that does not appear. JUSTIFICATION: TEMPLATE:198-201 checks only node/term counts, which is why 55 tension records, 36 canonical positions, 9,762 edges and every claim record are invisible while the gates read green, and why Wendt's own quality-gates-report.md declared an unregistered entry complete.

NAME THE CONSUMER OF EVERY ARTIFACT. The plan must state, per output file, the `file:function` that reads it, or mark it human-only. The current total consumer surface is three sites: compile-corpus-index.py:1199/1223 (book-level-ontology.md or cluster-ontology.md), :1267 (tension-edges.json), :1244 (Aristotle's *-cross-pipeline-hooks.md). Everything else the plan commands is written for nobody.

PUBLISH THE PARSER CONTRACT IN THE PLAN, not by exemplar. Specifically: the `## 3A. Canonical Node List` header grammar with the SEMANTICS of each position — forbid parentheticals in `#### N. Name` headings (compile-corpus-index.py:734-736 turns them into the `greek` field and thence into the global canonicalTerms greedy-match list, which is how 'technological' and 'control' entered corpus-wide), require an explicit `type` bullet (:761 silently substitutes `centrality` when it is absent — 73 runtime nodes affected), and require `greek_lemma`/`german_lemma` to be named fields.

REQUIRE A PER-SOURCE page-offset-verification artifact with ≥3 sampled anchors spread across the document, an asserted offset, and an explicit constancy test; a drifting offset becomes a piecewise table and every stored pdf_page carries the offset_id it was computed under. MODEL: corpus/index/Wendt - Design for Dasein/_synthesis/page-offset-verification.md ('book = pdf − 2', four anchors), produced because wendt-design-for-dasein-analysis.md:133 demanded a double locus. COUNTER-CASES to prevent: Aristotle 33/34 records and 101/188 bekker loci wrong; Rickert's declared offset 20 both wrong and non-constant.

RETAIN THE TEXT LAYER. Move extraction out of the scratchpad into the entry (`<entry>/_text/<doc_id>.txt`), record tool+version+exact command+both checksums, and make every offset qualify itself with text_layer_id. Add one explicit recovery task: deterministically re-extract Calleja's PDF and rebind In-Game's ~995 dead line ranges — one step that resurrects the corpus's densest clause-adjacent pointer set.

SPECIFY A WINDOWED AUTHORING PROTOCOL for claim density. Fixed windows over the retained text layer (1,500-3,000 words), an id block pre-allocated per window, a per-window yield floor, schema self-validation before the agent returns, a deterministic merge, and a dedup pass keyed on quote_sha256 plus normalized claim_text. JUSTIFICATION: the current one-agent-per-unit budget (TEMPLATE:205-207) is why BCAP's claim schema survives in 1 of 13 units and Boredom's readings fragmented into 8 shapes.
REPLACE THE EXISTENCE CHECK WITH SCHEMA VALIDATION after every batch (TEMPLATE:208-210 currently checks only that three files exist). Re-dispatch on validation failure, not on absence.

BUILD THE VERBATIM DETECTOR BEFORE THE GATE CITES IT (implementation plan:391 concedes it has never existed and the gate is agent self-attestation), and restate the copyright rule as a REPRESENTATION rule — hash + address + word count + first/last 8 words — rather than a deletion rule.

REQUIRE NFC NORMALISATION ON WRITE plus a per-entry name-forms.json mapping every observed orthographic variant to a canonical key. JUSTIFICATION: three spellings of the author's own name inside corpus/index/Von Uexkull (Uexkull 101 / Uexküll 90 / Uexkuell 36) with the mangled form dominating the runtime artifact (60/4/5).

MAKE ALL DECLARED STATISTICS MACHINE-GENERATED. The validator writes the manifest counts and quality-gates-report.md metrics; authors never type them. JUSTIFICATION: 66 count-mismatch defects; only 6 of 27 manifests declare any count and zero declare an expected node count; BCAP section 3B is wrong in every line; only 2 of 27 entries have a quality-gates-report at all and only 1 has machine-readable metrics.

ADD A LINK-RESOLUTION GATE: every claim_id, clause_id, unit_id, interlocutor_id, anchor-unit id and file pointer must resolve, or be listed in unresolved.json with a reason. A definition field may not consist solely of a pointer. JUSTIFICATION: 44 dangling-reference defects; VDS points at two non-existent files; nine VR Pedagogy runtime nodes have 'See `debate-map.md` DA-0N.' as their entire definition.

DECIDE THE AUTHORITATIVE SERIALISATION BEFORE AUTHORING. Per-source records are authoritative; the synthesis-level file is a generated view, regenerated by script, never hand-edited. JUSTIFICATION: per-source *-edges.csv and _synthesis/global-edges.csv are the same data twice and four entries disagree between the layers (FCM 428 vs 452, Aristotle 246 vs 156, Grammar 878 vs 876, Phantasia 708 vs 706) with nothing recording which is stale.

MIGRATE, DO NOT RE-AUTHOR. The plan's first phase should be a mechanical lift of what already exists into the new schema, since 100% of the following is already on disk and merely unaddressable: Dissertation 982 claims (100% line-anchored, 8-tier, 76% graphed, 841 edges, 235 verbatims with insertion anchors); Veri(dis)similitude 157 rows (ids, tier, disposition, RODA anchors, volatility flags) plus its terminology and interlocutor tables; Boredom Secondary 2,924 sub-items (2,012 of 2,258 dict-shaped already carrying a page locus); FCM 182 structured claim records; BCAP 146; Wendt 139; BT 108 with 299 tension edges and 84 back-references; Uexküll 107; Uncomfortable 55 positions and 176 loci; VR Pedagogy 233 readings; Aristotle 188 bekker-index records over 3,064 line-anchored loci; RDR2 3,788 VTT cues.

PRESERVE THE FILE-LEVEL SHAPE THAT WORKS AND EXTEND IT. Keep one directory per entry, per-source subdirectories, a _synthesis view, a manifest, and the two-gate rhythm (G0 spec sign-off, G1 registration sign-off). Add three files: claims.jsonl, clauses.jsonl, and vocab/*.json — the first two being the addressable substance the goal actually names.
what_to_preserve: The provenance discipline itself (TEMPLATE:38-42). FE / FAITHFUL-<AUTHOR> / P·anticipatory-application is the single most consistently applied idea in the whole corpus — 2,761 FE, 1,323 P/anticipatory-application, 1,196 burke-direct, 85 FAITHFUL keys — and it is exactly the mechanism that keeps 'the source's claim' separate from 'our interpretive link'. Keep the concept; close the vocabulary and move it from prose into a field.

The Dissertation 8-tier support taxonomy, verbatim. It is closed, it is populated on 982 of 982 records, and it is the only thing in the index that mechanically surfaces the user's 'every weakness' — 477 T3-interpretive-but-flagged, 41 T4-unflagged, 71 T5-under-supported, 22 T7-overreach, selectable by query.

The interpretive-flag pair: a boolean plus the actual quoted hedge from the prose (Dissertation `interpretive_flag_present` + `interpretive_flag_text`). Quoting the hedge is what makes a tier claim auditable rather than asserted.

The locus-on-every-edge discipline (TEMPLATE:162,164). It worked: 17,206 of 19,715 edge rows carry a locus column and only 42 are empty. The failure was format, not compliance — so keep the requirement and give it a grammar.

The anchor/bridge discipline (TEMPLATE:30-36): bridge to an existing entry's unit ids, never re-digest, and tag every cross-pipeline claim `anticipatory-application`. This is what keeps the index from becoming N copies of the same argument.
The two-gate rhythm: GATE G0 on the spec before authoring (TEMPLATE:102-103) and GATE G1 before commit (:200-201), each requiring explicit user sign-off, with backups first (:189).
manifest.planCorrections (TEMPLATE:214) — mid-run deviations are recorded, never silent.
'****** UNVERIFIED:' plus the do-not-stall rule (TEMPLATE:9-10). The convention is right; it needs a field to live in and a reconciliation pass.
Pre-extract every source to text and give agents the text path, never the PDF (TEMPLATE:137-140). Right instruction, wrong storage location — move it out of scratch and checksum it.

The depth rubric deep / deep-long / map (TEMPLATE:76-77) as a per-source effort budget, and the de-dup + haystack rubric (:57-67) which correctly collapsed 49 files to 44 units and extracted one paper from a 781-page proceedings.
The reserved `-00-corpus-overview` id and the strand grouping of unit ids (TEMPLATE:73).

The concordance idea (TEMPLATE:81-88): concord every source to the primary objects the dissertation will actually cite. At claim level this becomes CLAIM.analytic_anchor, and the Aristotle/Bekker and Boredom construct×measure grids are the proof it pays.

Veri(dis)similitude's disposition column (keep-verbatim / re-ground / enrich / supersede / drop). 157 of 157 populated. It is the only field in the corpus that makes the index actionable during drafting rather than merely descriptive, and its dedup map ('A-P08 ≈ B-C01 ≈ B-P02/P04/P20 … Canonical: …') is a working model for claim-level deduplication.
Veri(dis)similitude's `[V:…]` volatility flags with in-place resolution stamps. They turn a vocabulary change into a work queue instead of silent rot.
BCAP's explicit premises→conclusion structure and Being and Time's id|claim|premises|targets|status row. Both encode argument shape, not just assertions; formalise the cells and keep the idea.
Being and Time's 84 claim-to-tension back-references and its contested-nodes.md — the corpus's only working weakness graph.
Von Uexküll's separation of Evidence type from Strength. Two facets, correctly distinguished; they just need to be enums with the rationale in its own field.

Uncomfortable Situations' dual address on every locus record — the anchor in the primary text plus the page in the commentary ('Ch.1 n.29'), with author/work/year/edition and `appears_in_units`. That pairing is what will answer 'who has said what about this exact clause'.

Aristotle's bekker-index record shape {bekker, description, concepts[], pdf_page, unit_id, work}: a canonical edition-independent address alongside a rendering-specific one, per record. Adopt it as the general locator pattern.
Wendt's _synthesis/page-offset-verification.md — make it a required artifact for every source.
Wendt's and RDR2 Secondary's quality-gates-report.md as a shape (target / actual / pass per gate) — make it mandatory and validator-generated instead of hand-typed.

The Dissertation's cached-verbatim record {cache_id, priority_stars, source{}, locus, verbatim, pathe_section, insertion_anchor, use ∈ in-text|footnote, rationale} — including `use`, which records how the quotation is meant to be deployed.
The chain-node / RODA anchor vocabulary as the project's analytic spine, already in use in three independent places (VDS claim rows, gg-element-matrix, RDR2 beat-maps).

The plan's own executor discipline: turn every judgment call the plan cannot pre-make into a derivation procedure with a rubric (TEMPLATE:8). That instinct is correct — it simply was not applied to the record schemas, which is where every defect landed.

summary:
The plan family (TEMPLATE-2026-07-15 and its per-book/per-cluster siblings) is a competent PROCESS plan with no DATA MODEL. It specifies phases, folder layouts, agent budgets, human gates and volume targets in detail, and it specifies the shape of a record exactly once — as a list of bare array names inside a unit JSON (TEMPLATE:159-161). That single omission produced most of the 551 audited defects: 42 sub-item shapes in one entry, 6 incompatible position shapes in another, 9 claim dialects corpus-wide, 41 edge-CSV header dialects, 633 relation values, 170 stance values, 85 FAITHFUL-author variants, 10 id-collision and 10 id-prefix defects.

The second structural failure is that the plan tells authors to write artifacts nothing reads. The entire runtime consumer surface is three sites in scripts/compile-corpus-index.py (:1199/:1223 for one .md ontology file, :1267 for tension-edges.json, :1244 for Aristotle's hooks). The plan commands cluster-ontology.json, concordance .json, debate-map.json, concept-matrix.csv, terminology appendices, unit .json and 219 edge CSVs — all unread. Its registration gate checks node and term counts only, so an entry can pass every gate with 46% of its tension records silently discarded (55 of 119, verified), 36 canonical positions unreachable, 19,715 edge rows stranded, and every claim record invisible. Wendt's quality-gates-report.md is the proof: thirteen ticked gates and a declaration that registration is optional.

The third is a granularity ceiling that the repair plan reproduces (index-system-implementation-plan:324, :408 — a canonical UNIT record with `claims` as an unspecified nested slot). Claim-level material already exists in bulk and is unaddressable: Dissertation 982 line-anchored, 8-tier, graph-linked claims with 235 verbatims carrying insertion anchors; Veri(dis)similitude 157 rows with ids, tier, disposition, a 12-value RODA anchor enum and volatility flags; Boredom Secondary 2,924 sub-items; FCM 182; BCAP 146; Wendt 139; BT 108 plus 84 tension back-references; Uexküll 107; Uncomfortable 55 positions and 176 loci; VR Pedagogy 233 readings against 1,136 prose-tagged assertions.

Clause level is genuinely absent — no character offset, no sentence index, no bbox anywhere in 1,758 files — but four working address systems already exist and one was destroyed by the plan's own scratchpad instruction: Aristotle's 188-record bekker-index over 3,064 line-anchored loci, VLE's respondent×item keys (W26-R037 / Q9), RDR2's 3,788 VTT cues plus 1,040 frame ids, and In-Game's ~995 line ranges into /tmp/calleja-fulltext.txt, now deleted because TEMPLATE:137-140 sent the text layer to scratch and recorded neither command nor checksum. Two entries additionally delete the clause text outright under the ≥25-word rule (TEMPLATE:44-45), enforced by a detector that has never existed — a policy in direct opposition to the stated goal.

A new plan should therefore: make the CLAIM and the CLAUSE first-class, independently id'd record types with schemas shipped as files and enforced by a validator; adopt the Dissertation claim schema and its 8-tier taxonomy wholesale rather than inventing one; derive stance, evidence type, provenance, disposition and relation vocabularies by union-and-dedup of what is already in use; make locus a typed object with an edition-independent canonical address plus a rendering-specific one plus a quote hash and insertion anchor as the fallback; retain and checksum the extracted text layer; replace six cross-source volume gates with intra-source, script-computed gates that bind at N=1 (claim yield, locus resolution rate, quote coverage, premise completeness, tier distribution, provenance coverage, graph connectivity, id integrity); and make registration a keyed round-trip diff on the runtime store. The first phase should be migration, not authoring — roughly 2,500 claim-level records already on disk become addressable by schema lift, and one deterministic re-extraction of Calleja resurrects ~995 clause pointers.
